title: Senior Applications Project Specialist Healthy Planet - Kelsey-Seybold Clinic- Pearland, TX
description:
Explore opportunities with Kelsey-Seybold Clinic, part of the Optum family of businesses. Work with one of the nation's leading health care organizations and build your career at one of our 40+ locations throughout Houston. Be part of a team that is nationally recognized for delivering coordinated and accountable care. As a multi-specialty clinic, we offer care from more than 900 medical providers in 65 medical specialties. Take on a rewarding opportunity to help drive higher quality, higher patient satisfaction and lower total costs. Join us and discover the meaning behind Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

Top-level technical expert in one or more highly specialized areas of application, systems analysis, and programming. Acts independently with very little direction. May have duties, such as instructing or leading project application teams. May be asked to work with KS Executive management, in. Shares knowledge and learning with others. Provides technical leadership on complex projects. May act as an expert in a business or functional area. Keeps abreast of new technology. Formulates/defines system scope and objectives. Has full technical knowledge of all phases of application systems analysis. Assists client departments in identifying and designing opportunities for operational improvement, which can be enabled by, improved systems configuration, deployment, acquisition, or development. Provides project management and direction for system related projects. Performs configuration changes and system setup to ensure scope and quality of product. This position plays a key role in advancing population health and value-based care initiatives by designing, optimizing, and maintaining Healthy Planet tools within Epic. This position supports quality improvement, care management workflows, and payer-specific analytics and reporting, with a focus on improving outcomes, closing care gaps, and supporting performance under value-based contracts. The analyst collaborates closely with clinical, care management, quality, and operational stakeholders to ensure accurate data capture, actionable insights, seamless workflows, and compliance with NCQA certified HEDIS measures.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely * from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Healthy Planet Configuration & Optimization
    • Configure, maintain, and enhance build to support closing Care Gaps
    • Develop and customize registries, MyPanel metrics, and population specific dashboards to support value based care initiatives and performance monitoring
    • Build and maintain Campaigns and Compass Rose care management programs to support targeted outreach and care gap closure
  • Value-Based Care Analytics
    • Configure HEDIS reporting tools and ensure alignment with NCQA certified measure standards
    • Apply solid knowledge of clinical vocabularies and coding standards, including LOINC, ICD, and CPT, to ensure data accuracy and measure compliance
    • Partner with quality, reporting, and care management teams to enable timely and accurate quality performance tracking across value-based care contracts
  • Population Health Strategy
    • Contribute to the development of population health strategies that improve outcomes and patient experience across the health system
    • Provide subject matter expertise on Healthy Planet functionality to internal stakeholders
    • Ensure system configuration supports operational goals for chronic disease management, preventive care, and payer performance programs

Essential Duties:

  • Project Management: Define, lead and conduct projects as assigned in accordance with standard KSC project management and documentation standards. Provide consultation for program design, build, interface build/testing, system testing, and documentation. Is a self-starter and resourceful. Provides technical leadership on complex projects
  • Teamwork: Direct and mentor other project team members so that defined objectives and benefits are achieved. Serves as a resource and advocate for assigned user group(s). Establish solid working relationships with members of other application teams/management to ensure proposed system changes are thoroughly vetted and potentially adverse downstream consequences are discovered. Develop and communicate risk mitigation strategies
  • System Development: Work collaboratively or in leading role as part of Application System Project teams. Define and document business/clinical system requirements and workflows. Configure System settings and master files to meet business requirements. Validate system build with business owners through presentations and standardized testing procedures. Provide or lead system go live support, problem resolution and question- and-answer services. Act as technical and project mentor to other less experienced and proficient team members. Assists in development and may be responsible for overseeing testing. Delivers work that is consistently accurate, precise, thorough, neat, ethical, and reliable. Familiar with quality standards and follows all applicable quality guidelines. Understands concepts of process improvement and results to improve the quality of services. Completes all duties as assigned in the required timeframes. Meets deadlines for regular duties and projects
  • System Support: Mentor and coach staff related to ongoing application support, problem resolution and question and answer services. Participate in Application Service Desk duty and 24 x 7 on call program with other team members. Assists Application analysts and Help Desk with escalation of system issues
  • Proficiency: Maintain and share mastery level application knowledge, proficiency and problem solving skills, as well as expert level understanding of standard IT project management, change management/control and service procedures. Serve as technical and application master for other team members, who confront questions and problems, for which assistance is needed
  • Communication/Customer Relations: Maintain effective working relationships with customers, staff, and project sponsors. Assess assigned user areas as needed per project. Maintain direct working relationships with application vendor technical staff, in order to facilitate rapid problem resolution and service delivery, where vendor services are needed. Possesses the ability to effectively communicate relevant information, in a clear and concise manner, at all levels of the organization. Promotes and practices effective listening skills in all interpersonal contacts. Demonstrates competence in grammar and clarity in all oral and written communication
  • Optimization: Leads implementation efforts for system improvements in accordance with KSC standard change control and change management procedures. Communicates system changes to all applicable users. Provides a high level of output and productivity. Meets objectives. Does not waste skills, time and resources. Finds ways to improve processes and control costs
  • Interpersonal Skills: Solid positive attitude, interpersonal and relational skills, ability to make and keep commitments, meet project timelines, and provide outstanding customer service is required. Communication regarding technical matters in language easily understood by non-technical staff is required. Conducts effective meetings and complex IT projects as assigned. Possesses the ability to be flexible in changing situations, meet changing priorities, and solve new and existing problems. Understands the value of adaptability with patients, customers, clinicians and business owners
  • Vendor Relationship: Builds a solid vendor relationship with the systems directly responsible for and/or consulting contracts as needed per project. Ensure contracts are adhered to, maintenance and support SLA's are met, and ensure interfaces are supported per each contract. Responsible to hold vendors responsible when SLA's or maintenance are not met
  • Budget: Helps develop year to year budget with Director each fiscal year. Is responsible to stay within budget
  • Reliability: Can be counted on to arrive and start work on time. Meets expectations for completion of duties as assigned in the required timeframes. Meets deadlines for regular duties and projects without management intervention
  • Certifications: Certification required based on application(s) supported. KSC IT Management will determine if certification is required on an as needed basis
  • Other duties as assigned

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical/application area or 4+ years equivalent work experience
  • Epic Systems Healthy Planet Certification
  • Valid Texas Driver's License
  • 4+ years of experience in applicable healthcare or business operations unit, utilizing Healthy Planet or other KSC healthcare applications
  • Solid understanding of clinical workflows, care management processes, project management experience in IT, and population health programs
  • Technical and analytical aptitude for multiple application points of integration. 4 + years of systems experience with development, analysis, installation and support
  • Demonstrated ability to report writing capability
  • Proven communication, presentation, project management, problem-solving, and technical skills are also required. Candidates must have the ability to assume more than one role on the team, and must have the ability to travel occasionally

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in related field
  • Epic Systems certification in one or more applications
  • 7+ years of experience in applicable healthcare business operations
  • 4+ years or project management/lead experience in IT

*All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $91,700 - $163,700 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

Application Deadline: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. Together, we are shaping the future of healthcare by harnessing technology and innovation to make care simpler to navigate, more affordable and more connected for the people we serve. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, valued, heard and respected, empowering people to bring their authentic selves to work and strengthening our collective impact through diverse talents, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are a drug-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.

title: Paid Ads & Search Specialist (Africa)
description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

About the Role

As a Local Market Digital Specialist (Africa), you’ll drive the way we connect with local users to grow Binance’s active user base. Leveraging your growth digital marketing skill (Paid Ads, SEO, ASO, affiliates traffic, referrals, email marketing,...) you’ll identify opportunities for the local market in order to reach and activate new users.

As the right person for the job, you’ll care deeply about how to leverage all digital media channels to reach new audiences and build an enduring brand, be creative about the deployment of marketing messages, and be rigorous about learning from the data you collect and the experiential campaigns you run. Most importantly, you’ll drive results and significantly grow our customer base.

Responsibilities:

  • Adapt global paid strategy to local reality — transcreate, never translate; own the market narrative for local campaigns, performance creative and the design briefs that deliver it.

  • Provide local channel expertise and activation alongside global platforms.

  • Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly performance and act on anomalies using AppsFlyer, Sensor Tower, and Similarweb; escalate what needs escalating.

  • Drive local SEO with editorial and content teams, including on local search engines where relevant

  • Support SEO activities such as link buildings & content review, and grow visibility in AI-generated answers (AEO/GEO) for local-language queries.

  • Feed local intelligence — competitor moves, cultural shifts, regulatory changes, local user behaviour — back to the global team so it shapes strategy, not just execution.

Requirements:

  • Ideally >3 years of performance marketing experience (paid ads and SEO), in a crypto or FinTech industry

  • Native-level local market fluency: Not just language — consumer psychology, the local competitive and trust landscape, crypto's local reputation and local user behaviour

  • Performance data literacy: Solid understanding of data analytics and online customer acquisition, able to interpret and tell the “why” behind the numbers, not just “it is low/ high”

  • Working knowledge of SEO: on-page, linkbuildings, and such. (Bonus: AIO & GEO working experience)

  • Local platforms/ channels/ campaigns: Managed at least one local channel for paid ads and designed one local campaign

  • Fluent English speaker, with understanding of local language

Why Binance

  • Shape the future of finance
  • Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
  • Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
  • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
  • Competitive salary and company benefits
  • Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

By submitting a job application, you acknowledge that you have read our Candidate Privacy Notice.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Director, Data, Analytics and Reporting
description:
At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold “what if.”
What if your ideas could ignite global innovation?
What if your curiosity could redefine the future?

We invite you to step into the next exciting chapter of your career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it’s like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. Our cloud-first networking and security solutions already protect 70% of the Fortune 500, and we’re looking for creative thinkers ready to push that influence even further. Join us and discover how far your bold “what if” can take the world, your community, and your career.

How we empower our people is extraordinary: we’re recognized as a Glassdoor Best Place to Work 2025, Great Place to Work-Certified in five countries, and honored by Cigna as a Healthy Workforce honors for three consecutive years; And what we build is world class: named CybersecAsia’s Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024 — clear evidence that when first-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So, what if the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next”.

In a world where you can be anything, Be Infoblox.

Senior Director, Data, Analytics and Reporting

We have an opportunity for a Senior Director, Data, Analytics and Reporting to join our IT team in Santa Clara HQ reporting to the CIO. In this mission critical leadership position, you will be responsible for defining and executing a data strategy that fuels Infoblox’s growth, customer success, and operational excellence. Collaborating closely with executive leaders across the organization, including Finance, Operations, Product and Engineering, Business Applications, AI Engineering and Security teams ensuring our data assets are leveraged to their full potential. This role requires a leader who can build and mentor a world-class team while personally driving strategic initiatives and ensuring the integrity of our data foundation. A core part of your responsibility will be to champion and enable our AI strategy and technical foundations, ensuring that clean, trusted, and well-governed data is the foundation for all AI initiatives. You will also be a champion for the data user, focused on building a self-service data platform that empowers all Infoblox employees to make data-driven decisions with confidence.

Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do

  • Lead and Inspire a High-Performing Team: Build, mentor, and scale a diverse, high-performing team of data analysts, data scientists, data & analytics, and Business Intelligence engineers, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning
  • Define and Execute the Data Strategy: Architect a clear, scalable data strategy that aligns with Infoblox’s business goals and product roadmap. Ensure the right data architecture, tools, and processes are in place to deliver trusted, high-quality data at scale
  • Champion AI Enablement: Act as a critical partner to the Business Applications and AI Engineering teams. Ensure that our data and data infrastructure and practices are optimized to support and accelerate AI development and deployment. This includes defining data governance standards, building high-quality training datasets, and developing scalable data pipelines for AI/ML models, and building AI data products for all Infoblox employees
  • Drive Data-Driven Decision-Making: Partner with senior leaders across Finance, Operations, Product & Engineering to identify and deliver actionable insights that inform key business decisions, optimize performance, and unlock new opportunities
  • Advance the Data Foundation: Own the end-to-end data lifecycle for critical business domains, from data ingestion and ETL/ELT pipelines to data modeling, quality assurance, and governance. Ensure a single source of truth for key metrics across the organization
  • Develop and maintain Master data management by establishing standards, data quality rules, matching/merging criteria, survivorship rules, and hierarchy management
  • Enhance Data Security and Governance: Partner with Security leaders to define and implement policies and systems to safeguard data privacy, ensure regulatory compliance, and protect sensitive information. This includes establishing robust data access controls, audit trails, and data retention policies
  • Enable Self-Service and User Experience: Drive the development of a self-service data platform that empowers business users with easy-to-use tools and intuitive dashboards
  • Focus on the end-to-end user experience, from data discovery to insight generation, to ensure our data is not just available but also accessible and understandable to all
  • Lead Enterprise Data Governance Council and establish data governance and quality frameworks to ensure trustworthy, compliant data usage. Implement policies and controls for secure, auditable, and ethical data management

Be Prepared — What You Bring

  • Experience: 12 plus years of progressive experience in data analytics, data science, and data engineering, with at least 5 plus years in a senior leadership role
  • Strategic Leadership: Proven ability to define, communicate, and execute a data vision that drives measurable business outcomes
  • AI Acumen: Demonstrated experience in building data foundations and pipelines specifically to support and accelerate AI and machine learning initiatives
  • Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of modern data stacks, including data warehousing, ETL/ELT pipelines, data modeling, and Tableau. Experience with cloud-based data environments that enable AI use-cases (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Exceptional ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and communicate complex data concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong Data governance and master data management background to build governance organizations and frameworks ground up
  • Team Development: A track record of successfully hiring, mentoring, and leading high-performing data teams

Be Successful — Your Path

First 90 Days:

  • Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long term goals.

Six Months:

  • Launch a scalable data architecture and governance framework to ensure high-quality, trusted, and secure data across the organization
  • Deliver initial AI-enablement capabilities by developing clean training datasets and foundational data pipelines to support early AI/ML initiatives
  • Roll out a self-service data platform prototype with intuitive dashboards, empowering business users to access and utilize data independently
  • Establish a data strategy and define data governance principles for the enterprise
  • Make critical platfrom decisions in line with broader strategic transformation projects

One Year:

  • Operationalize enterprise-wide data governance council and master data management standards, ensuring consistent, compliant, and ethical data usage
  • Demonstrate measurable business impact through data-driven insights that optimize performance and inform strategic decisions across departments
  • Scale the data and analytics team into a world-class organization, fostering a culture of data literacy, innovation, and continuous improvement

Belong— Your Community

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.

Be Rewarded — Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong

  • Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
  • Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops
  • Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy
  • Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks (and the occasional cupcake), plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations
  • Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match

We practice pay transparency and reward performance. Offers reflect role location, internal equity, experience, skills, education, and certifications. Base salary for this position: $208,100.00 - $323,950.00 plus bonus.

Ready to Be the Difference?

Infoblox is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis

title: Mechanical Apprentice
description:
The Mechanical Apprentice position assists with inspections, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, component handling, shop activities, and field service while developing the practical knowledge and competencies required for progression in the mechanical trade. Work must be completed in accordance with Redpath policies, project procedures, manufacturer guidance, client requirements, and applicable safety regulations.

  • Comply with Redpath policies, procedures, manuals, directives, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and project requirements.
  • Perform work in a manner that protects the health and safety of employees, contractors, clients, and the public.
  • Complete pre-task risk assessments, workplace examinations, and required tool and equipment inspections before beginning work.
  • Assist qualified mechanics with inspection, servicing, troubleshooting, repair, and testing of mobile and fixed mining equipment.
  • Perform apprentice-level preventive maintenance tasks such as cleaning, lubrication, filter replacement, fluid checks, and basic adjustments when trained and assigned.
  • Assist with removal, installation, cleaning, and handling of mechanical components, guards, hoses, fittings, tires, batteries, and attachments.
  • Use hand tools, portable power tools, measuring devices, lifting devices, and shop equipment only after receiving required training and authorization.
  • Follow lockout/tagout, blocking, cribbing, isolation, stored-energy, line-of-fire, hot-work, and equipment testing requirements.
  • Assist with equipment inspections and identify visible leaks, wear, damage, loose components, abnormal noise, heat, vibration, or other defects.
  • Maintain tools, parts, consumables, service vehicles, work areas, and maintenance records in a clean, secure, and organized condition.
  • Retrieve, stage, verify, and return parts and materials required for planned and unplanned maintenance work.
  • Read and apply work instructions, service information, parts identification, safety data, and basic drawings within the limits of training.
  • Document completed tasks, inspection findings, parts used, and equipment condition as directed.
  • Coordinate with mechanics, supervisors, planners, warehouse personnel, operators, and other crews to support maintenance priorities.
  • Participate in toolbox talks, safety meetings, technical instruction, task training, and competency evaluations.
  • Maintain regular and reliable attendance and arrive fit for duty and prepared for the assigned shift.
  • Work overtime, rotating shifts, nights, weekends, holidays, and extended project rotations as required.
  • Compliance with Redpath Core Competencies is an essential duty and responsibility.

  • The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all inclusive.

    Minimum Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Perform other duties consistent with the nature and level of the position as assigned.
  • Assist other job functions as trained and directed.
  • Maintain work areas, tools, vehicles, and assigned equipment in a clean and orderly condition.
  • Stop work and notify supervision when an uncontrolled hazard or unsafe condition is identified.

Education:

  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred. Completion of mechanical, diesel, automotive, welding, or industrial coursework is considered an asset.

Work Experience:

  • Entry-level trade position. Prior mining experience is not required.
  • Prior mechanical, automotive, diesel, welding, industrial, mining, construction, agricultural, or shop experience is considered an asset.

Knowledge Required:

  • Strong commitment to health and safety and willingness to intervene when unsafe conditions are observed.
  • Ability to understand and follow verbal and written instructions.
  • Ability to learn safe equipment operation, inspection requirements, and site procedures.
  • Ability to safely use common hand tools, materials, and personal protective equipment.
  • Basic ability to complete written or electronic inspection forms and work records.
  • Ability to communicate clearly by radio, in person, and in writing.
  • Ability to work productively as part of a crew and independently within assigned limits.
  • Dependability, attention to detail, and willingness to accept coaching and feedback.

Licenses and Training:

  • Valid driver's license and an acceptable driving record are required when operation of a company vehicle is part of the assignment.
  • MSHA Part 46 or Part 48 training is preferred and may be provided based on project requirements. Enrollment in, or eligibility for, an applicable apprenticeship or company training program may be required.
  • Additional site-specific qualifications, medical clearances, respirator fit testing, or equipment
    certifications may be required.

title: Wellness Director
description:
Recognized by Newsweek in 2024 and 2025 as one of America's Greatest Workplaces for Diversity

About the Wellness Director Position


As a Wellness Director at Brookdale, you will utilize your leadership qualities to inspire, lead and manage the overall operation of the clinical team to provide the highest quality of care and services for our residents. You will proactively build relationships with residents, families, physicians and other healthcare providers for the coordination of exceptional personalized care. You will consistently collaborate with community leadership, mentor and engage your associates and build resident and family satisfaction.

Brookdale supports our Nurse Leaders through:

  • Structured six-week orientation, a wealth of online resources, local nurse mentors and ongoing collaborative support.
  • Tuition reimbursement to support your clinical expertise and leadership skills development.
  • Network of almost 700 communities in 40 states to support you should relocation be in your future.

This is a great opportunity for a strong nurse leader looking to take the next step in their professional career or for an experienced Director of Nursing looking to join a reputable mission and purpose-driven organization where you can make a contribution.


Qualifications & Skills

  • Education as required to obtain state nursing license and state nursing license (LPN/LVN or RN)
  • Driver’s license
  • Minimum of 3 years relevant experience, and Clinical leadership experience preferred.
  • Strong working knowledge of technology, proficiency in Microsoft office suite and electronic documentation.

Visit to learn more about Brookdale’s culture, see our full list of benefits and find other available job opportunities.

Enriching lives...Together.
At Brookdale, relationships and integrity are the heart of our culture. Do you want to be a part of a welcoming and inclusive community where residents and associates thrive? Our cornerstones of passion, courage, partnership and trust drive everything we do and come to life every day. If this speaks to you, come join our award winning team.

Make Lives Better Including Your Own. If you want to work in an environment where you can become your best possible self, join us! You’ll earn more than a paycheck; you can find opportunities to grow your career through professional development, as well as ongoing programs catered to your overall health and wellness. Full suite of health insurance, life insurance and retirement plans are available and vary by employment status.

Part and Full Time Benefits Eligibility

  • Medical, Dental, Vision insurance
  • 401(k)
  • Associate assistance program
  • Employee discounts
  • Referral program
  • Early access to earned wages for hourly associates (outside of CA)
  • Optional voluntary benefits including ID theft protection and pet insurance

Full Time Only Benefits Eligibility

  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid holidays
  • Company provided life insurance
  • Adoption benefit
  • Disability (short and long term)
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Health Savings Account
  • Optional life and dependent life insurance
  • Optional voluntary benefits including accident, critical illness and hospital indemnity Insurance, and legal plan
  • Tuition reimbursement

Base pay in range will be determined by applicant’s skills and experience. Full-time associates in role are eligible for an annual bonus incentive and sales referral bonuses. Temporary associates are not benefits eligible but may participate in the company’s 401(k) program.

Veterans, transitioning active duty military personnel, and military spouses are encouraged to apply. To support our associates in their journey to become a U.S. citizen, Brookdale offers to advance fees for naturalization (Form N-400) application costs, up to $725, less applicable taxes and withholding, for qualified associates who have been with us for at least a year.

The application window is anticipated to close within 30 days of the date of the posting.

Manages the day-to-day clinical services of a more complex community to ensure residents’ healthcare needs are met. Ensures residents are treated with respect and dignity and ensures quality care as residents’ healthcare needs change. Supervises and provides leadership, as well as coaching, to licensed nurses and other direct care staff within the community. May be responsible for leading additional clinical leadership team up to five members. The HWD level for each community is determined based on the total complexity of the role. title: Supervisor Part-time
description:
Global Connections to Employment (GCE) is a nationwide team providing jobs for people with significant disabilities, including our war-wounded veterans. Since its establishment in 1986, GCE has helped match team members to fulfilling careers, from custodial services to facilities maintenance and food services, plus other business lines in between. Working with customers from the U.S. military, commercial business and community partners – as well as federal, state and local governments – GCE is one of the country’s largest private employers of persons with disabilities. Learn more at GCE.org.

Overview

The Supervisor is responsible for assisting management in the oversight and management of assigned governmental contracts. This position is responsible for safely overseeing and performing duties as detailed in the PWS or other contracted services. Quality customer service is expected to be provided to the customer at all times. Knowledge and willingness to learn all aspects of the job is a requirement of the position.

Role Requirements:

  • Must have a minimum of one (1) year of experience in custodial services.
  • Must have a minimum of one (1) year of experience in a supervisory or lead role.
  • Must have experience dealing with government personnel/customers concerning contracted services.
  • Must have basic computer knowledge (Excel, Microsoft Word, etc.).
  • Must interact appropriately with customers and team members.
  • Must have good management communication (writing and verbal) and people skills. •
  • Must possess a valid driver’s license in the state they reside, have a satisfactory driving record, and be insurable under the corporate policy.
  • Must meet eligibility requirements for work assignment on the specified contract(s).
  • Must be able to pass organization screening requirements, including state or federal background screenings, as appropriate.

Physical Requirements

May travel to and from various locations and buildings throughout the year and in various weather conditions. Most work will take place indoors. May work with cleaning chemicals. Will be required to follow the Emergency Operations Work Assignment per customer requirements. Schedules are subject to change. title: Principal Scientist - Analytical Development, Synthetics
description:
About Hemab

Hemab is building preventative treatments for serious, underserved bleeding disorders. These are therapies designed to work with the body's own biology and stop bleeds before they start, instead of treating them after they happen. We're patient-first, science-led and clinical-stage - with a pipeline that takes different scientific approaches to different patient needs.

We went public via our 2026 IPO, and we're scaling across two homes: Cambridge, MA, USA, and Copenhagen, Denmark.

The role

As Principal Scientist, Analytical Development, you'll use your extensive experience in the analysis of synthetic therapeutics, including peptides and oligonucleotides, to serve as the analytical lead supporting our synthetics programs from first-in-human through commercial readiness.

You will support both early- and late-stage development, including phase-appropriate method validations and Quality Control activities, setting and justifying specifications, process and product characterization, and preparation of CMC regulatory submissions, including NDAs and MAAs. You will drive analytical strategies and manage analytical activities across multiple CROs and CDMOs, helping to ensure smooth progression from clinical manufacturing to commercial readiness.

What you'll do

  • Own analytical strategy for synthetics programs, particularly peptides and oligonucleotides, from first-in-human through commercial readiness.
  • Establish phase-appropriate analytical approaches, including setting and justifying specifications, product characterization, impurity marker synthesis and qualification, reference standards, stability protocols, comparability assessments and risk assessments.
  • Provide technical input to CDMOs on method development and validation (especially for purity methods), as well as product characterization.
  • Manage analytical method transfer, optimization and validation with external partners, including in support of commercial readiness.
  • If appropriate, ensure an appropriate mechanism of action-based potency assay is in place to support Phase 3 readiness.
  • Provide analytical expertise on CMC sub-teams, working closely with Drug Substance, Drug Product, Research, Quality and Regulatory colleagues.
  • Provide analytical support for process characterization, including determination of Critical Quality Attributes and appropriate validation of methods for testing In-Process Controls.
  • Lead and manage analytical CROs/CDMOs, material suppliers, consultants, vendors and collaborators; monitor regulatory trends, integrate new analytical approaches, identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce costs, and advise colleagues on data interpretation.
  • Author and review analytical sections of regulatory submissions, from first-in-human through NDAs and MAAs, and represent Hemab as an analytical expert in regulatory interactions when needed.

What you'll bring to Hemab

  • Proven industry experience setting analytical strategy for synthetic therapeutics, particularly peptides and oligonucleotides, with substantial exposure to late-stage development through commercialization.
  • Strong working knowledge of phase-appropriate analytical method development and validations, setting and justifying specifications, product characterization, impurity marker synthesis and qualification, comparability assessments and regulatory submissions, especially NDAs/MAAs supporting late-stage synthetic programs.
  • Significant experience managing CROs/CDMOs, including navigating technical problems where an external partner needs hands-on guidance.
  • Strong understanding of ICH expectations for stability and method validation, together with experience producing analytical content for regulatory submissions.
  • Flexibility, a proactive approach and comfort operating in a fast-paced biotech environment spanning multiple time zones.
  • A relevant scientific degree, with a PhD preferred, and the technical depth to operate as an independent analytical expert.

Nice to have

  • Experience with mechanism of action-based potency assays.
  • Experience establishing reference standards.

What to expect, honestly

Hemab is still building a lot of its own structure. Systems here tend to get created as we need them, not handed down in advance. You will likely build some of your own tools and processes instead of inheriting finished products. We work across two hubs and multiple time zones - bridging that well takes real, deliberate effort. And because we're growing quickly, priorities can shift with less notice than they would at a larger, more established company.

This position spans early- and late-stage development and works across multiple internal teams, CROs, CDMOs, suppliers, consultants, vendors and collaborators. Hemab operates across multiple time zones.

Why Hemab

At Hemab, your work ultimately connects back to something simple. People living with serious bleeding disorders get something they've never had before - the chance to prevent a bleed, instead of reacting to one after it happens. You'll be joining at a stage where individual decisions still carry real weight, and where your work can help turn promising science into a preventative treatment that actually reaches patients.

How we treat our people is meant to be an extension of how we think about patients: with care, honesty, and respect. We're still building the consistency to back that up across every hiring process, every time. We'd say that plainly instead of pretending otherwise. If any part of your experience with us falls short of it, tell us.

Hemab builds balanced candidate slates and assesses everyone against a single standard. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, please tell us.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Hemab Therapeutics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sex, marital status, gender expression or identity, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

Please answer in your application:

Have you managed external CDMOs delivering analytical testing for synthetic drugs?

Derfor søger vi en kollega, der kan tage ansvar for centrale rapporterings- og dokumentationsopgaver og fungere som bindeled mellem Sustainability, Økonomi og revision i forbindelse med ESG‑rapporteringen.

Specialist i EU-taksonomien

Som en del af Sustainability‑teamet bliver du den ansvarlige specialist på EU‑taksonomien.

Du får stor selvstændighed og ansvar for at identificere og vurdere de aktiviteter, der er omfattet af taksonomien, sparre med Økonomi om opgørelse af relevante nøgletal og analysere, om aktiviteterne lever op til taksonomiens ESG‑kriterier, herunder udarbejdelse af klimarisikoanalyser.

Fortolkning af komplekse lovkrav

Du får en central rolle i at sikre, at vores rapportering lever op til gældende krav. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du trives med og har flair for at fordybe dig i juridiske tekster og omsætte dem til praksis.

Samtidig trives du i rollen som udadgående projektleder med mange kontaktflader på tværs af organisationen.

Samlingspunkt for ESG-data

Derudover bliver du nøgleperson i vores essentielle arbejde med data. På S&G-området får du en særlig rolle, da du vil være ansvarlig for indsamling, strukturering og kvalitetssikring af S&G‑data.

På tværs af E, S og G – gældende for både CSRD og EU-taksonomien – vil du være ansvarlig for udarbejdelse af data- og regnskabsmanualer, at sikre overblik over øvrig dokumentation samt koordinering af pre‑assurance‑forløb med ekstern revision.

Hvem er du?

Vi leder efter en analytisk og struktureret profil, der motiveres af at skabe overblik i komplekse krav og sikre, at data og dokumentation kan holde til et kritisk eftersyn. Du har lyst til at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem data, regulering og bæredygtighed og trives med at omsætte regler og krav til konkrete processer og rapportering.

Måske kommer du fra et revisionshus, hvor du har arbejdet med revision, dokumentation og regnskabsmæssige problemstillinger. Alternativt sidder du i dag som controller eller i en lignende rolle med ansvar for rapportering, dokumentation og datakvalitet.

Fagligt forestiller vi os, at du især bringer erfaring inden for:

  • data, økonomi, regnskab, controlling eller revision
  • fordybelse i juridiske tekster og fortolkning af komplekse krav
  • erfaring med eller interesse for ESG og bæredygtighedsrapportering

Vi forestiller os, at du har et par års relevant erfaring, så du kan tage selvstændigt ansvar for området. ESG-erfaring er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har den datamæssige og juridiske erfaring, arbejder struktureret og systematisk og har lyst til at blive specialist inden for et område, der udvikler sig hurtigt.

Derfor skal du vælge NRGi

Hos NRGi får du mulighed for at tage ansvar for et område, der er højt prioriteret i hele koncernen. Du bliver en central del af arbejdet med at sikre, at vores rapportering efter EU-taksonomien og CSRD lever op til både nuværende og fremtidige krav, og du får stor indflydelse på de processer og den dokumentation, der understøtter rapporteringen.

Samtidig bliver du en del af et engageret team på 11 medarbejdere, hvor faglig sparring, samarbejde og udvikling er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Her får du mulighed for at arbejde tæt sammen med kolleger på tværs af organisationen og opbygge en specialiseret viden inden for et område, der får stadig større betydning.

Praktisk information

Stillingen er en projektansættelse med en forventet varighed på 1,5-2 år, da ansættelsen er knyttet til arbejdet med rapportering efter EU-taksonomien og CSRD, herunder årsrapporten for 2027.

Ansættelsen løber derfor som minimum til 31. marts 2028 og forventes at vare frem til 30. juni 2028. Opstart ønskes hurtigst muligt.

Interesseret?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte Head of Sustainability Line Brok Mogensen på telefon 28 25 14 70 eller på mail limo@nrgi.dk.

The Recycling Associate is responsible for operating heavy equipment including cardboard balers, pallet jacks, stock pickers, foam densifiers, shredders, and other recycling equipment.

Recycling Associate’s are also quality control inspectors and remove unwanted or harmful materials while sorting recyclables. title: Bilingual Print Production Lead
description:

Working across retail, eCommerce, B2B, print fulfilment partners, production facilities, and approved vendor-supported work, the Controller provides clear ownership, visibility, and workflow discipline from intake through completion.

Take early action where possible and escalate as required to the Manager, hub managers, or other operational leaders.

  • Maintain accurate documentation of routing decisions, job status, exceptions, ownership changes, escalations, and resolution steps using approved workflow and ticketing processes.

  • Reinforce standard intake, routing, documentation, escalation, and communication practices across the Print Control Center.

  • Identify recurring issues, process gaps, handoff challenges, routing constraints, and improvement opportunities; share findings with Production Control leadership; and escalate issues as needed to support timely, documented, and communicated resolution.

Some of what you need:

  • College or technical diploma in graphic communications, print production, business, operations, or a related discipline preferred.

  • Strong understanding of production readiness, intake quality, print specifications, file readiness, finishing options, routing, job movement, documentation requirements, and common production risks.

  • Ability to interpret approved estimates, job specifications, sourcing decisions, costing information, and production requirements within defined decision rights and escalation criteria.

  • Ability to collaborate with Print Estimating and operational partners to support complete handoffs, accurate routing, workflow control, and production execution.

  • Strong proactive monitoring, prioritization, issue resolution, workload visibility, and early risk identification skills.

  • Sound judgment to resolve routine production issues and recognize when decisions, exceptions, or risks require escalation to Production Control leadership.

  • Strong attention to detail, organization, documentation discipline, follow-through, and comfort with production systems, workflow tools, ticketing logic, CRM, order management, quoting tools, and Microsoft Office.

  • 2–4 years of experience in print production, production coordination, print support, sales support, estimating, customer service operations, or a related operational role.

  • Experience with print specifications, production workflows, job routing, intake, escalations, approved vendor coordination, or production facility environments preferred.

  • Experience supporting B2B print, print fulfilment partners, retail print, eCommerce print, commercial print, centralized production, or multi-site production networks is an asset.

  • Experience with workflow, ServiceNow, CRM, order management, or production tracking tools is an asset.

  • French language proficiency is required.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Key Responsibilities:
  • Analyse large operational datasets to identify patterns, anomalies, outliers and risk indicators.
  • Develop approaches for anomaly detection, clustering, segmentation and risk scoring.
  • Build supervised machine-learning models where historical outcomes or labelled cases are available.
  • Perform feature engineering using structured and unstructured data.
  • Design evaluation approaches to assess model performance, including precision, recall, false positives and false negatives.
  • Work with domain experts to determine how analytical outputs should be incorporated into operational workflows.
  • Build and maintain data-processing and feature pipelines to support modelling at scale.
  • Develop production-ready model or scoring pipelines and integrate them with applications built by the delivery teams.
  • Monitor model performance, data quality and data drift after deployment.
  • Conduct exploratory analysis to identify new opportunities for workflow redesign and automation.
  • Support the use of LLMs and other AI techniques alongside traditional statistical and machine-learning approaches where appropriate.
  • Develop reusable analytical approaches and components that can be applied across multiple project engagements.
Requirements & Qualifications
A. Educational Qualification & Experience
  • Education: Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Data Analytics or Information Systems preferred.
Experience:
  • Experience working with large, messy operational or transactional datasets.
  • Experience in applied data science, including statistics, feature engineering, machine learning and model evaluation.
  • Experience with techniques such as anomaly detection, classification, clustering or risk modelling.
  • Experience building data pipelines and taking models beyond experimentation into production environments.
B. Technical & Professional Competencies
Essential (Must-Have)
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Able to translate a business or operational problem into an analytical problem and determine the appropriate modelling approach.
  • Familiarity with software engineering practices including Git, automated testing and APIs.
  • Comfortable assessing model trade-offs and explaining them clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Preferred (Advantageous)
  • Familiarity with containers, CI/CD or other DevOps / ModelOps practices would be advantageous.
C. Soft Skills & Communication Attributes
  • Able to work independently in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and collaborate closely with engineers, product teams and domain experts.
  • Strong sense of ownership for turning analysis into something that is used in an operational workflow.

title: Racker/Unracker (1st and 2nd Shift)
description:
JOB SUMMARY:

This position is responsible to properly rack, unrack and inspect a wide variety of aluminum parts on and off carriers at a steady and consistent pace that is compatible with Stylmark standards and expectations for work quantity and quality.

ESSENTIALS DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Identifies and selects proper load for racking.
  2. Receives load information from Anodizing desk.
  3. Reviews tag to identify part numbers, load number, and colors.
  4. References parts catalog, as required for parts identification.
  5. Locates and identifies specific load as indicated on tag.
  6. Selects proper racking equipment for load to be assembled.
  7. Pulls carrier to loading area, with or without assistance.
  8. For 12' stock length racking, determines quantity and size of plastics, bolt-ons and/or clips required for proper extrusion support and electrical connection.
  9. For short length racking, designs most effective loading method, determines type, quantity and size of uprights, twist-ons, clips, and bolt-ons.
  10. Checks integrity of racking equipment as each racking device is removed from walls; checks clips for tension, bolt-ons for tightness; repairs racking devices as needed or takes them to rack repair for service.
  11. Chemically strips splines by hand, when necessary.
  12. Places racks on carriers.
  13. Lifts racks weighing up to 40 pounds and hangs on carrier at a 6' height. For racks weighing over 40 pounds, assistance is required.
  14. Manually sands racking device hooks and carrier bars where conducting materials touch to ensure proper contact.
  15. Loads extrusions onto racks, ensuring the most effective loading method is applied and that material is not damaged during racking.
  16. Visually inspects each part for defects (scratches, gouges, and pits) or excessive grease; cleans or returns to buffing as required.
  17. Cleans end cap extrusions before racking.
  18. Lifts each extrusion, with or without assistance, onto the racking device.
  19. Attaches and tightens extrusion to racks; uses ratchet on bolt-ons, pliers on clips, and manual attachment on twist-ons and uprights.
  20. Inspects and ensures that all extrusions are fastened to the racking apparatus for maximum conductivity.
  21. Checks tag, verifies everything is on load according to tag, initials completion.
  22. Pushes or pulls carrier, with assistance, over to anodizing area.
  23. Ensures safe racking equipment and safe racking area.
  24. Takes unusable racking devices to rack repair as needed.
  25. Replaces stripped nuts as needed.
  26. Ensures plastics are in good working condition.
  27. Cleans and picks up area floors, work tables, etc. as needed for safe and well-maintained area.
  28. Identifies and selects proper load for unracking.
  29. Pulls anodized loads according to priority to the unracking area.
  30. Checks tag against load, ensures that load is complete, and marks tag accordingly.
  31. Visually inspects materials on rack for color and quality of processing; performs dye stain seal test.
  32. Unloads extrusions onto cart and inspects for damage, scratches, dye lines, and other defects. Fills out rework slip and returns defective pieces to appropriate area for solution.
  33. Completes unloading log in Excel. Enters information in the ERP system.
  34. Initials and dates job paperwork.
  35. Unhooks racks and returns them to proper storage areas for reuse.
  36. Transports material to appropriate location in the Packing department
  37. Returns empty carriers to the Anodizing bay.
  38. Inspection of parts.
  39. Must ensure that all parts to be shipped or moved to stock location meet all Stylmark quality specifications.
  40. Informs Lead, Quality Assurance or Supervisor if there are any quality concerns.
  41. Completes tasks delegated by supervisor

An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the essential duties and responsibilities listed above. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

The above list reflects the general details necessary to describe the principle and essential functions of the position and shall not be construed as the only duties that may be assigned for the position.

title: Principal, Retirement Product
description:
At AustralianSuper, we truly care about our colleagues.​ We know work and life are intertwined. Your New Role

The Principal, Retirement Product is accountable for leading the development, management and continuous improvement of the Fund's retirement products. The role will drive innovation and continuous improvement across new product development, product performance, governance and risk management.


This senior position comes at a very exciting point in time. With more members approaching retirement and living longer than ever before, you can be part of the retirement team in largest super fund in the country, helping to directly improve the retirement outcomes for members. This is a rare and important opportunity to drive change and make a very tangible difference the lives of millions of Australians.


Key duties include but are not limited to:

  • Supporting the delivery of AustralianSuper’s retirement income strategy.
  • Lead the retirement product strategy and roadmap, using member insights, market trends, product performance and Fund priorities to set direction, drive innovation, enhance competitive positioning and make investment and prioritisation decisions.
  • Own the end-to-end retirement product portfolio, including new product development, product enhancements, lifecycle management and delivery of strong member, commercial and operational outcomes.
  • Translate strategy into execution, setting clear priorities, accountabilities and delivery plans, while proactively managing dependencies, risks and performance outcomes.
  • Build and lead a high-performing team, providing direction, coaching and development to foster innovation, accountability and succession capability.
  • Maintain strong product governance and reporting, representing retirement at internal Executive and Board committees and providing subject matter expertise input as required.
  • Drive stakeholder alignment across the Fund and promote effective prioritisation and decision making to support retirement and broader Member Domain growth objectives.


What You’ll Need

  • Extensive senior leadership experience within financial services, with a strong track record leading product portfolios in superannuation, retirement or other highly regulated environments.
  • Deep product management expertise, including strategy, pricing, new product development, product enhancement and end-to-end product lifecycle management.
  • Strong strategic, commercial and change leadership capability, with the proven ability to set direction, influence outcomes and lead complex cross-functional initiatives.
  • Comprehensive understanding of the retirement market, including member needs, competitive dynamics and relevant regulatory, governance and risk requirements.
  • Exceptional stakeholder and people leadership skills, with a proven ability to influence senior leaders, navigate ambiguity, build high-performing teams and deliver results in a changing environment.

Life at AustralianSuper

AustralianSuper is committed to colleague development, and we support our people with ongoing learning, coaching and training, as well as career opportunities across our expanding global organisation. We offer generous leave entitlements and promote a blended working environment in which all roles can flex, and we’re happy to discuss what this looks like for you.

We cultivate a workplace that champions safety, respect, inclusiveness and diversity. We are committed to supporting our diverse workforce in a way that is inclusive and embraces diversity in all its forms. If you require any reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process or the role, please let our recruitment team know.

What’s Next

Apply now, if you share our values of Energy, Integrity, Generosity of Spirit and Excellent Outcomes and would like the opportunity to work in a challenging, growing and rapidly evolving team to deliver outstanding results.

Position Overview

The Revenue Cloud Solution Architect will lead the design, development, and implementation of Revenue Cloud and Revenue Lifecycle Management (RLM) / Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA) solutions for digital transformation initiatives. This role involves close collaboration with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to ensure the delivery of tailored solutions that meet specific business requirements.

You will play a key role in modernizing Quote-to-Cash processes, driving efficiencies, improving sales performance, and scaling revenue operations. Your responsibilities will span both strategic vision and hands-on technical execution, ensuring that projects deliver measurable value and align with long-term business objectives.

Additionally, you will serve as a thought leader in the areas of Revenue Lifecycle Management, platform enablement, and systems integration, driving innovation and best practices across multiple initiatives.

Solution Design and Architecture

Stakeholder Collaboration and Management

  • Ensure Alignment: Act as the primary liaison between technical and business teams, fostering effective communication and shared understanding of project objectives.

Implementation Leadership

  • Guide Projects: Lead the implementation of Salesforce Revenue Cloud solutions, ensuring that projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the satisfaction of all stakeholders.
  • Oversee Technical Execution: Provide strategic direction and manage all phases of the implementation process, including design, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.

Customization and Integration

  • Manage Integrations: Oversee the integration of Salesforce with other enterprise systems (e.g., Netsuite, Avalara, Stripe, DocuSign) and ensure data integrity during migrations.

Continuous Improvement and Innovation

  • Stay Current: Keep up with Salesforce updates and industry trends, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement and innovation.
  • Recommend Solutions: Evaluate and introduce new features, tools, and processes to enhance Salesforce-based workflows and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

Experience

  • Salesforce Expertise: A minimum of 4+ years working with Salesforce, with at least 3 years specializing in CPQ and Billing projects.
  • Proven Track Record: Experience leading large-scale transformation projects, particularly in enterprise settings.
  • Financial Knowledge: Solid understanding of accounting operations, including billing, invoicing, payment processing, and revenue recognition fundamentals.
  • Metrics Mastery: Familiarity with financial metrics such as ACV, TCV, ARR, and other performance indicators, with the ability to model and explain calculations effectively.
  • CLM & E-Signature Tools: Hands-on experience with tools like Document Generation, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), and e-signature solutions.
  • Integration Skills: Knowledge of integrating Salesforce with third-party platforms, including Netsuite, Avalara, Stripe, DocuSign, SureTax, Chargent, or Dynamics 365.

Technical Skills

  • Salesforce Configuration: Proficient in Salesforce configuration, including objects, flows, Lightning components, and customizations.
  • Custom Solutions: Experience in building and extending custom quoting and pricing solutions on the Salesforce platform.
  • Development Skills: Familiarity with Apex and Omniscript is a plus.
  • Data Analytics: Expertise in Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and sales performance analytics.
  • Integration Tools: Knowledge of integration concepts and tools like MuleSoft, Workato, and REST/SOAP APIs.

Leadership & Communication

  • Effective Communication: Strong ability to present complex technical concepts in a clear, relatable manner to diverse audiences.
  • Team Leadership: Proven skills in mentoring and guiding cross-functional teams, including analysts, developers, and consultants.
  • Risk Management: Capable of identifying potential risks and communicating timeline adjustments effectively to stakeholders.

Business Acumen

  • Process Expertise: In-depth knowledge of Sales, Product Management, Billing, and Accounting workflows, and their interdependencies.
  • Go-to-Market Knowledge: Familiarity with Channel, Partner, and Marketplace go-to-market strategies.
  • Results-Driven: Proven ability to align Salesforce solutions with business objectives to deliver measurable performance improvements.

title: Operations Development Engineer (Starlink)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

OPERATIONS DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER (STARLINK)

As an Operations Development Engineer, you will be responsible for engineering the operational systems and processes used to support the Starlink network as it scales to millions of users around the globe. Join the team operating the network that is revolutionizing global connectivity and internet access. A successful Operations Development Engineer will create the tools, technology and processes to maintain, operate and evolve the most advanced network in the solar system. You will utilize operational data to identify and prioritize various improvements that improve our operational efficiency and maintain the overall health of operations. You will work with subsystem responsible engineers, software engineers, and network engineers to develop alerts, mitigations, and terrestrial assets and drive improvements to core Starlink systems. Through continuous improvement, you will drive process and automation upgrades to the point of minimal manual intervention. You will be responsible for the complete lifecycle of the projects you own, including development, testing, deployment and support.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop, implement and scale Starlink Network Operations processes, automation, and tools that provide global internet access
  • Design operational workflows from first principles and implement the resulting procedure, automation, and tooling
  • Work with development engineering teams to drive design for operations: assess how proposed workflow and system changes affect operations health and efficiency, catch scaling issues early in the development lifecycle, and incorporate debugging tools and strategies so handover to operations is effective
  • Interact with key stakeholders to identify their desired outcomes, take their inputs and deliver improvements to Network Operations owned processes
  • Work with the diverse teams across the Starlink program to develop monitoring, detection and response processes that drive quick resolution to emergent network events
  • Define and develop projects, milestones, and maintain roadmaps, practicing flexible prioritization and scope management to deliver on program directives
  • Take extreme ownership of deliverables and make risk-conscious decisions under pressure
  • Design operational systems end-to-end: alerting, detection, triage paths, handoffs, automation, and the interfaces between tools and operators
  • Build and maintain scoped software and internal tooling (Python, scripting, APIs, workflow orchestration) whose customer is the live operation
  • Implement AI in production operations workflows (investigation assistants, procedure retrieval, alert/ticket triage, vendor and API copilots); measure the result on toil, error rate, and time-to-restore
  • Write operational specifications and success criteria for new products and services; partner with software engineering when required

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.
  • Experience in Python and SQL
  • Experience building automation or operational tooling in a NOC, SOC, SRE, sysadmin, or network engineering environment

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 2+ years of experience developing software, automation, processes, or projects in a rapidly changing, highly demanding environment, with the ability to run these projects independently
  • Experience designing or implementing operational systems that other operators use (procedures, automation, alerting, or internal tooling)
  • Strong system design and first-principles problem solving, with a focus on operations at scale
  • Familiarity with operational open-source technologies such as Prometheus, Grafana, PostgreSQL, and workflow orchestration
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with operations, engineering and supply chain teams
  • Experience creating detailed documentation and procedures from scratch
  • Experience in optimizing and automating operational processes and workflows
  • Familiarity with technology and operational concepts of internet service providers, mobile network operators, or content delivery networks
  • Experience working within complex, software defined networking (SDN) and/or network function virtualization (NFV) environments
  • Experience implementing AI tooling into production workflows (agents, LLM-assisted triage, retrieval over procedures/runbooks, copilots on existing ops tools)
  • Experience with Linux, Git, and operational infrastructure (services, APIs, scheduling, observability)

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be able to participate in on-call rotation to support critical operations as needed

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $105,000.00 - $145,000.00
Level 2: $120,000.00 - $175,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Solution Engineer - Channel
description:
Description

Solution Engineer (Channel)

Location: East Region (Remote / Home Office)

Reports to: Director of Solutions Engineering

About Us

Novee is the AI penetration testing platform built for a world where attackers operate at machine speed. Founded in Tel Aviv in May 2025 by a team with decades of nation-state offensive security experience - including veterans of Unit 8200, Iron Dome, and elite zero-day research - we're turning that expertise into a platform that thinks like a real attacker, runs continuously, and uncovers the novel vulnerabilities that manual testers and scanners miss.

We raised $51.5M in four months, backed by top investors YL Ventures, Canaan Partners, and Oren Zeev - one of the fastest funding trajectories in offensive security. Our proprietary AI model outperforms frontier LLMs by over 55% on real exploitation benchmarks, and we're just getting started.

We're looking for exceptional people to join our mission: making continuous, intelligent offensive security the new standard.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Solution Engineer to help build and scale the technical side of Novee's channel partner activity across the Eastern US.

In this role, you will combine technical partner enablement with hands-on support for partner-led sales opportunities. You will train and support partner technical teams, help them build confidence in positioning and demonstrating Novee, and work alongside them to lead customer demonstrations and POVs.

You will collaborate closely with our Channel Manager, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams across the US and Israel.

This is a highly hands-on role with significant ownership, cross-functional impact, and direct access to leadership.

Responsibilities

  • Train and enable partner technical teams to position, demonstrate, and evaluate Novee's platform.
  • Deliver technical onboarding, workshops, and ongoing guidance to help partners develop their expertise and independence.
  • Lead product demonstrations with partners and articulate Novee's value to technical and non-technical customer audiences.
  • Own and execute customer POVs alongside partners, including defining success criteria, setup, troubleshooting, and demonstrating successful outcomes.
  • Serve as a trusted cybersecurity and technical advisor to partners and prospects throughout the sales cycle.
  • Collaborate closely with the Channel Manager and account teams to support partner-led opportunities and drive technical success.
  • Create partner demo scripts, POV playbooks, training resources, and technical enablement materials.
  • Support integration discussions, API evaluations, and security considerations.
  • Share partner and customer insights with Product and Engineering to influence roadmap decisions.
  • Develop and improve technical partner enablement processes and best practices in collaboration with the broader Solutions Engineering team.
  • Represent Novee at partner meetings, joint customer engagements, industry events, and conferences.

Requirements

  • Based in the Eastern US, within a two-hour drive of a major airport.
  • 4+ years of experience as a Solution Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Pre-Sales Engineer, working directly with prospects on sales opportunities.
  • Previous experience working directly with channel partners in a technical pre-sales capacity, including partner enablement and support for joint customer opportunities.
  • Strong technical understanding of cybersecurity, SaaS, and cloud environments.
  • Experience in Offensive Security and/or Application Security.
  • Hands-on experience leading POVs for enterprise customers, with a demonstrated track record of success.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical topics.
  • Ability to train and guide technical audiences through product demonstrations, workshops, and hands-on evaluations.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, early-stage environment.
  • Strong collaboration skills across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success.
  • Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
  • Willingness to travel for partner meetings, customer engagements, technical workshops, industry events, and conferences.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with APIs, integrations, and cloud architectures.
  • Familiarity with GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket workflows.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, containers, and DevOps workflows.
  • Experience with scripting or programming languages such as Python, Bash, or JavaScript.
  • Experience using LLMs in offensive security workflows.
  • Experience building technical playbooks, training resources, or enablement processes in a startup environment.

What We Offer

  • A high-impact role helping build and scale Novee's technical channel capabilities.
  • Direct influence on how partners learn, demonstrate, and position our technology with customers.
  • Close collaboration with world-class engineers, security researchers, product leaders, and teams across the US and Israel.
  • The opportunity to develop partner training, playbooks, and technical sales methodologies.
  • A front-row seat in a fast-growing cybersecurity startup backed by top-tier investors.
  • A competitive compensation package, including meaningful equity.
  • A chance to work on cutting-edge technology in cybersecurity and AI, solving real and complex customer challenges.
