title: Google Ads Grants Specialist (Volunteer)
description:
About This Role

Location: Remote

Commitment: Part-time volunteer, pro bono role

Contribution Requirements: Minimum 10–15 hours per week; minimum 3-month commitment

Professional Volunteering

Professional volunteering is skills-based service performed with the same reliability, accountability, and quality expected in a paid professional role. Volunteers are core contributors whose work directly supports our mission of global compassion, collaboration, and action. Expectations include consistent weekly availability, timely communication, ownership and follow-through on assigned work, participation in team meetings, and alignment with our values and processes.

About Solution Community: We are an international 501(c)(3) non-profit organization, pioneering an innovative social platform dedicated to enabling actionable change. With volunteers from over 70 countries, we demonstrate the power of global collaboration. Our team members bring experiences from some of the world’s most successful companies, including Apple, Toyota, Google, Netflix, Walmart, Meta, and many others, creating a rich tapestry of knowledge and passion.

Our Mission: To foster a global community of compassion that unites individuals and organizations to solve the world’s social problems. We bridge non-profits, businesses, philanthropists, and volunteers, empowering them to create meaningful change for current and future generations.

Our Vision: Imagine a world where every person has the opportunity to thrive - a world united by collaboration, compassion, and action. At Solution Community, we are turning that vision into reality, driving transformative change that reshapes the future.

Position Overview: As our Google Ad Grants Specialist, you will play a critical role in expanding the reach of Solution Community's mission through strategic management of our Google Ad Grants account. Leveraging up to $10,000 per month in Google Search advertising, you will help connect volunteers, nonprofit partners, donors, philanthropists, and changemakers with our global community and initiatives.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage Google Ad Grants Campaigns: Create, monitor, and optimize search campaigns utilizing our $10,000/month Google Ad Grants budget.

  • Increase Mission Visibility: Develop keyword strategies and compelling ad copy that drive awareness, engagement, volunteer recruitment, nonprofit partnerships, and donor interest.

  • Optimize Performance: Monitor campaign metrics including impressions, click-through rates, conversions, and quality scores to maximize impact and maintain grant compliance.

  • Ensure Grant Compliance: Maintain adherence to Google Ad Grants policies and best practices to keep the account active and performing effectively.

  • Conduct Keyword Research: Identify high-impact search opportunities that align with our mission, programs, and global initiatives.

  • Analyze and Report Results: Track performance and provide recommendations that improve campaign effectiveness and organizational reach.

Who Are We Looking For?

  • Mission-Driven Professionals: You are passionate about using digital marketing to create meaningful social impact.

  • Google Ads Enthusiasts: Experience with Google Ads or Google Ad Grants is preferred but not required. We welcome motivated learners eager to build expertise.

  • Analytical Thinkers: You enjoy interpreting data and using insights to improve campaign performance.

  • Detail-Oriented Contributors: You understand the importance of compliance, optimization, and continuous improvement.

  • Strong Communicators: You can work effectively with diverse, multicultural teams and translate campaign insights into actionable recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, or related digital marketing tools.

  • Experience managing or supporting nonprofit Google Ad Grants accounts is a plus.

  • Understanding of SEO, keyword research, landing page optimization, or conversion tracking is beneficial.

  • Strong willingness to learn and contribute in a collaborative volunteer environment.

What We Offer

  • Global collaboration with leaders and strategists from top global companies

  • Meaningful impact on global causes and communities

  • A vibrant, multicultural team spanning 70+ countries

  • A supportive environment rooted in compassion, integrity, innovation, and collaboration

  • Flexible work-life with full autonomy

  • Opportunities for personal and professional growth

  • A formal recommendation upon successful completion of your volunteer term.

About the Role Within Our Culture

At Solution Community, we value fostering a positive workplace where every member can contribute meaningfully. This is a volunteer, unpaid position for someone deeply committed to our mission and eager to help scale a values-driven organization. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a global people function, influence organizational culture, and leave a lasting impact on countless lives around the world.

title: APS6 LIMS System Administrator
description:
Australian Citizens residing in Australia only respond.

Job details

We are seeking a motivated, proactive, personable, and skilled LIMS Administrator (APS6 equivalent). Our ideal candidate will have proven system administration experience preferably managing a LIMS system such as Sample Manager or a similar, relevant to the functioning of a commercial analytical/scientific laboratory. The role is very critical to supporting the Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) for the National Measurement Institute (NMI). You will work very closely with the business area to troubleshoot and provide support.

The successful candidate will have:

  • Practical knowledge of, or experience in LIMS administration such as Sample Manager or a similar system relevant to the functioning of a commercial analytical/scientific laboratory.
  • Demonstrated experience in one or more of the following computer programming and scripting languages:
    • VGL
    • LIMS Basics
    • .Net C#
    • Visual Basics
    • Java and HTML.
    • SQL
  • Sound knowledge of database administration. The use of SQL to extract information from database or to correct errors in the database.
  • Sound knowledge of scientific laboratory environments and the role of LIMS in laboratory operations.
  • Familiarity with standard IT applications and the ability to rapidly develop a high level of understanding of new application or systems.
  • Experience in processing data and the use of standard desktop applications.
  • Demonstrated problem solving skills with the ability to analyse and resolve complex issues.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new systems and technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to build productive relationships and work collaboratively and effectively in a team environment and with business stakeholders.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • A high level of commitment, self-motivation, and initiative.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgement in a dynamic environment.
  • Good organisational skills and ability to prioritise workloads.

This role is preferred in Melbourne, but strong applicants in Sydney & Canberra will also be considered.

Key duties and responsibilities

As a LIMS Administrator, you will be managing and supporting the LIMS system, Sample Manager operated by the Analytical Services Brach (Melbourne and Sydney) and several groups within Chembio & Biological Branch (Sydney). You will be developing /enhancing functionality using its proprietary language VGL, configuring software, testing, troubleshooting, and producing technical documentation. You will also work as part of a team of LIMS admins and Developers, liaising with internal / external stakeholders and collaborating with ICT colleagues where required.

Duties:

  1. Liaise with business areas to gather requirements to develop enhancements and new functionality in the LIMS system.
  2. Address enquires from staff and senior management regarding LIMS data and system with the aim of contributing towards the business objectives.
  3. Provide technical support to staff, including troubleshooting, bug fixing and managing LIMS user accounts and access.
  • Undertake training of NMI staff in the use of the LIMS.
  • Specify requirements and prepare specifications for amendments and undertake testing of the programs developed.
  • Carry out system enhancements under the direction of the LIMS Technical Manager, ensuring appropriate change control and associated procedures are adhered to.
  • Implement and maintain quality control measures.
  • Develop and maintain interfaces to facilitate data exchange between LIMS and other systems.
  • Develop and maintain documentation SOPs, procedures, and test plans.
  • Perform routine maintenance tasks such as committing or archiving of the LIMS data, backups, review and update users and their access under the direction of NMI managers.
  • Liaise with LIMS vendor to troubleshoot core system issues.
  • Generate Financial, Management and statistical reports for senior management.
  • Utilise the following personal qualities in your day-to-day work:
  • communicate effectively.
  • ability to work as a part of a team and operate with a degree of independence where required.
  • build relationships with colleagues and take a collaborative approach.
  • plan and manage implementation tasks.
  • solve problems quickly, appropriately, and efficiently.
  • Work across ICT (including Database, Server, security, and Network teams) to deliver business outcomes, upgrades, undertake testing, manage issues and outages.
  • Apply an understanding of and commitment to workplace diversity, workplace participation, safe working environment and access and equity principles.

Note that duties are similar between APS5 and APS6 however, APS5 will receive higher level of support, guidance, and training to undertake tasks. APS6 is expected to take more responsibility and undertake work with a high degree of independence where required.

title: Project Assistant
description:

The Project Assistant provides essential administrative and project coordination support to construction teams to ensure projects run efficiently and documentation is accurate and complete. This role is responsible for managing project records, tracking key deliverables, coordinating communication with subcontractors and internal teams, and supporting contract and compliance processes. The Project Assistant plays a critical role in maintaining organization, driving timely follow-up, and upholding Layton’s standards of quality, integrity, and operational excellence throughout the project lifecycle.

Duties

  • Assists in buyout of projects by verifying prequalification of subcontractors to include completion of safety and financial review.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • Has the ability to perform essential duties and responsibilities efficiently, accurately, and safely, with or without reasonable accommodation, and without posing a threat of harm to self or others.

  • Knowledge of basic work methods, techniques and systems used by Layton Construction preferred.

title: Software Data Engineer (AWS)
description:
DISCOVER PIRELLI

We are a global leader in the tire industry, specialized in designing, developing, manufacturing, and marketing high-performance tires for cars, motorcycles, and bicycles. In 2022, Pirelli established its Digital Solutions Center in Bari, a hub dedicated to driving digital innovation and strengthening key capabilities across the company. The center focuses on developing advanced software, data platforms, and algorithms supporting core business processes, from product development to manufacturing and commercial performance. Working with cutting-edge technologies such as Big Data, AI, Digital Twin and Industrial IoT, the center drives innovation across the entire value chain, improving process efficiency, enhancing performance and enabling new digital services in a highly connected international ecosystem.

DRIVE YOUR FUTURE

The Software Data Engineer (AWS) will be involved in the Data Platform project, with the goal of developing data ingestion processes through Kafka and integrating all manufacturing systems present in the plants and will be part of the AMS team, responsible for handling user-reported issues worldwide and addressing improvement requests related to the ingestion process.

They will focus on analyzing and implementing big data solutions, particularly in a cloud environment. The projects will address digital transformation, transitioning from traditional and legacy solutions to data management and analysis aligned with a data-driven strategy. The candidate will collaborate with the Milan team to share requirements, design, and model loading chains. Responsibilities include documenting developments, conducting integration tests and deployments in the AWS environment, and managing the handover of the implemented solution to the support team for governance.

WHY JOIN US
  • Ticket restaurant.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Hybrid Remote Working.
  • Employee benefits.
MAIN ACTIVITIES
  • Design and build streaming data pipelines: Kafka-MSK, stream processing (Flink/Spark Streaming), and routing into curated storage.
  • Develop batch transformation pipelines into a medallion lakehouse (bronze/silver/gold) on S3, with table formats like Iceberg.
  • Manage data storage across relational (Aurora/RDS PostgreSQL), NoSQL (DynamoDB), and object/lakehouse layers.
  • Design, deploy, and manage AWS infrastructure for data and ML workloads via Infrastructure as Code (EKS, Fargate, Lambda, VPC).
  • Take solutions from prototype to production: refactor, optimize, and apply CI/CD and engineering best practices.
  • Ensure observability, monitoring, data quality, and maintenance of pipelines in production.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
  • Master's in Computer Science/Engineering (PhD a plus).
  • Strong SQL and Python
  • Streaming pipelines with Kafka/MSK and Flink (or Spark Streaming).
  • AWS hands-on: EKS, Fargate, Lambda, S3, Aurora/RDS, DynamoDB, VPC.
  • Big-data stack (Spark, Hive, HDFS) and lakehouse formats (Iceberg/Parquet).
  • Git, CI/CD, Docker, IaC (Terraform), REST APIs; agile/scrum.
NICE TO HAVE
  • Iceberg/Delta, CDC and schema evolution at scale; Scala.
  • Strong communication, curiosity, and good organizational skills.
WHAT PUTS YOU IN POLE POSITION
  • Curiosity, interest of learning new technologies/new product/features.
  • Strong communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented with good organizational and time management skills.

title: Principal SoC Performance Architect – Next-Generation Server Platforms (Silent)

  • Proven expertise in benchmarking methodologies and development of custom microbenchmarks
  • Solid experience with performance analysis tools, profiling, and (ideally) simulation environments
  • Proficiency in SystemC, TLM, C++, and Python
  • Ability to navigate and contribute effectively within large, complex codebases

“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience:

title: Sr Data Analyst
description:
The Senior Data Analyst is responsible for extracting, managing, validating, and analyzing large datasets from federal government enterprise systems within a highly secure government data environment. The position develops and maintains SQL queries, ETL/ELT workflows, and structured datasets to support reporting, research, statistical analysis, and AI/ML and non-AI/ML modeling initiatives. The Senior Data Analyst also applies advanced analytical and statistical techniques to identify trends, anomalies, and actionable insights, develops data visualizations and analytical models, and ensures the accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and security of data ingestion processes. The role requires strong expertise in Python and/or R, SQL, and Databricks or similar platforms. The Senior Data Analyst collaborates with government stakeholders and technical teams to translate mission and business requirements into accurate, reliable, and actionable data-driven solutions.


Responsibilities:

  • Work with large datasets and various types of data (customer, operational, transactional) found in federal government enterprise systems to develop, maintain and enhance reports, analysis and models
  • Extract data from various IT systems using SQL and other programming languages
  • Manage, review, validate, and secure data ingestion processes to ensure the accurate, complete, timely, and controlled transfer of data into a highly secure government data environment.
  • Create clean, structured data sets for use in reports, analyses, studies and both AI/ML and non-AI/ML models.
  • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT workflows for structured and unstructured data.
  • Conduct both qualitative and quantitative research using client data, formulate hypotheses, test them and present the results in a clear and concise manner.
  • Use advanced statistical techniques to identify and measure trends, anomalies and determine other relevant insight.
  • Create visualizations and other tools that allow users to interact with data.

title: AVP-Editorial Strategy
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.


Skills and Competencies

  • 6–10 years of experience in editorial strategy, content strategy, corporate communications, or a related field, with a demonstrated track record in a managing editor or equivalent enterprise content leadership capacity
  • Proven ability to step back from individual line-of-business messaging campaigns and identify opportunities for larger, cross-company storytelling with the potential to span multiple platforms and audiences
  • Strong creative and editorial judgment, with experience shaping story concept, tone, and narrative arc across long-form video, podcasts, written, social and other formats
  • Track record managing multiple internal and external partners with competing needs and timelines across concurrent content franchises, campaigns, and channels
  • Skilled at building and maintaining editorial calendars, production pipelines, and cross-functional workflows that keep multiple projects moving on schedule and on brand
  • Experience partnering with creative, video, design, and data/insights teams to translate research and expertise into audience-ready content
  • Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to brief, direct, and give constructive creative feedback to writers, producers, and designers

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, English, or a related field required; equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree

Responsibilities

Serves as Moody's enterprise managing editor, setting editorial strategy and turning research and business-line storytelling into large-scale, cross-platform narratives.

  • Owns the managing editor function for Moody's enterprise editorial calendar, setting the content pipeline across all series, channels, and business lines and prioritizing initiatives with the greatest storytelling and business impact
  • Identifies which research, expertise, and corporate moments warrant large-scale, cross-platform treatment versus lighter, channel-specific coverage
  • Steps back from individual line-of-business requests to surface and build storytelling opportunities that connect multiple business units into a single enterprise narrative
  • Develops creative briefs in partnership with content and campaign leads, setting narrative direction, tone, and audience goals before production begins
  • Manages relationships with multiple internal partners and external creative vendors simultaneously, balancing competing needs, timelines, and priorities across concurrent franchises
  • Directs production planning and cross-functional coordination among writers, producers, designers, and data and insights partners to keep concurrent projects on track
  • Applies AI-enabled project, workflow, and agent tools to plan, template, and scale content production and derivative-asset creation
  • Partners with the Social Media and Communications Intelligence functions to ensure story selection and channel strategy remain insight-informed
  • Time allocation (approximate): Creative direction and storytelling strategy — 35%; Partner and stakeholder management — 35%; Process, project, and AI-workflow management — 30%

About the Team

Our Content Strategy & Communications Intelligence team is responsible for closing the loop between what Moody's puts out editorially and what audiences actually absorb — combining editorial strategy, multi-channel storytelling, and communications intelligence into a single, connected function. We turn Moody's research and expertise into stories that travel across platforms, translate audience and performance signals into content strategy, and give employees and external stakeholders a clear, coherent view of how Moody's shows up in the world. By joining our team, you will be part of exciting work building enterprise-scale storytelling and AI-enabled content workflows across Corporate Affairs — partnering with editorial, creative, and data professionals to shape how one of the world's leading risk-intelligence firms is understood.

title: Insider Risk Analyst
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

INSIDER RISK ANALYST

SpaceX is seeking a dynamic and driven individual with a demonstrated ability to work independently and as a member of a team in a fast-paced, high-tech environment. Our goal is to protect some of the world’s most advanced technologies including rockets, Dragon capsules for human transport, inter-planetary transport vehicles, the world's largest satellite communications network, etc. As an industry leader, we are a target of adversaries, both foreign and domestic, focused on slowing us down and accessing our proprietary technology. The work we do will literally safeguard mankind becoming an interplanetary species.

You will be responsible for the research, analysis, production, and dissemination of information relevant to protecting the safety and security of personnel, brand, global assets, intellectual property, and operations at SpaceX. This role will triage anomalous event data and analyze insider threat program datasets to respond to threats posed to SpaceX. You will use comprehensive understanding of various collection methods and platforms to explore new data sources, build effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Conduct comprehensive investigations and analysis in support of SpaceX intellectual property and security
  • Uphold investigation and analytic tradecraft standards including confidentiality, objectivity, lawfulness, timeliness, and use of all available sources of information
  • Collect and analyze available program data to evaluate insider threat risk to SpaceX infrastructure, programs, and operations
  • Triage anomalous event data associated with indicators of data exfiltration, data destruction and other key indicators of concern
  • Conduct internal investigations working with Information Security, HR, Legal, Government Security, Physical Security, and external partners based on information derived from internal and external sources
  • Utilize network monitoring, data analytic, and other tools (DLP/SIEM/UEBA) to identify anomalous activity, initiate investigations and decipher underlying trends
  • Extract and organize insider threat program data to build metrics, reports and case studies addressing mission requirements and timelines
  • Communicate findings in a timely and accurate manner to team members, management, and relevant stakeholders
  • Support employee training and briefings for internal and external audiences
  • Liaise with external industry and government partners to benchmark insider threat program, share threat intelligence, and further investigations
  • Continuously identify and help implement program improvement methods
  • Manage and safeguard sensitive information, including case files, employee PII, and intelligence reports

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of professional experience in internal investigations, information security, or counterintelligence; OR 4+ years professional experience in information security, internal investigations, or counterintelligence in lieu of a degree

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 1+ year using a SIEM and/or conducting digital forensic investigations in a government or corporate environment
  • Working level understanding of insider threat program missions, internal stakeholders, and manifestations of insider threats
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Purview for eDiscovery
  • Experience performing business process automation or constructing data pipelines
  • Familiarity with risk-based alerting, detection, and tuning concepts for insider risk
  • Experience conducting preliminary assessments, determining scope, investigation planning, evidence collection/handling, interviewing and reporting findings to internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to conduct interviews on short notice according to established internal guidelines.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to produce clear and concise reports
  • Highly organized with a strong attention to detail
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines
  • Can swiftly adapt to new technical environments and workflows
  • Ability to exercise discretion when conducting confidential investigations

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be able to work extended hours and weekends as needed to support critical efforts and operations
  • Must be willing to travel ad hoc
  • Active TS/SCI clearance, or ability to obtain one. With an active clearance, candidates will be subject to pre-employment screening including background check and drug/alcohol test as well as random drug and alcohol testing during employment

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $85,000 - $110,000
Level 2: $100,000 - $135,000

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Platform Engineer to support the stability, reliability, security, governance, and continuous optimisation of enterprise Data and AI platforms.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Group Data Team to manage and enhance three core platforms:

  • Unified Data Platform (UDP)
  • Common Agentic Platform
  • Clinical Interoperability Platform

This is a hands-on technical role focusing on Day 2 operations, cloud platform engineering, infrastructure governance, DevOps/DevSecOps, operational resilience, security, observability, and vendor management.

The role involves providing technical leadership, resolving complex platform issues, implementing engineering improvements, and ensuring enterprise platforms remain secure, scalable, and operationally efficient.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Operations & Optimisation

  • Provide hands-on engineering support for Azure-based data platforms, including Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, and related cloud services.
  • Maintain platform performance, availability, reliability, scalability, and operational resilience.
  • Support the operational readiness, governance, and reliability of enterprise AI and agentic platforms.
  • Monitor AI platform health, performance, utilisation, and operational effectiveness.
  • Support AI agent lifecycle management, orchestration services, and operational governance.
  • Enhance AI observability, agent monitoring, and platform reliability capabilities.
  • Support clinical interoperability services, including FHIR servers, APIs, and enterprise integration services.
  • Facilitate onboarding of new systems, data sources, and integration services.
  • Drive platform modernisation, performance optimisation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Day 2 Operations & Reliability Engineering

  • Establish and enhance Day 2 operational practices across cloud, data, AI, and integration platforms.
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability standards.
  • Develop operational runbooks, support procedures, and incident recovery processes.
  • Review platform resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, and service recoverability requirements.
  • Identify reliability bottlenecks, recurring incidents, technical debt, and operational risks.
  • Lead root cause analysis and implement remediation measures for recurring production issues.
  • Provide advanced technical troubleshooting and escalation support during critical incidents.
  • Support capacity planning, cloud cost optimisation, and FinOps initiatives.
  • Cloud Infrastructure, Integration & Connectivity
  • Support Azure networking, cloud security, infrastructure, and platform connectivity.
  • Design, implement, and optimise integration patterns across enterprise applications, data sources, and platforms.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot APIs, connectivity services, and integration components.
  • Support onboarding of new source systems into data and interoperability platforms.
  • Review and implement cloud infrastructure enhancements and platform engineering improvements.
  • Develop reusable integration, infrastructure, and deployment patterns.

DevOps, DevSecOps & Automation

  • Establish platform engineering standards, best practices, and operational controls.
  • Design, implement, and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform or equivalent tools.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimise CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
  • Implement deployment automation, release governance, and engineering quality controls.
  • Integrate security practices into CI/CD pipelines, including automated code scanning and dependency vulnerability management.
  • Implement infrastructure security validation, secrets management, certificate management, and Policy-as-Code controls.
  • Improve operational efficiency through automation and continuous engineering enhancements.

Security, Governance & Compliance

  • Maintain and enhance security controls across enterprise cloud, data, and AI platforms.
  • Review identity and access management, platform permissions, and security configurations.
  • Implement security baselines, governance standards, and cloud security guardrails.
  • Ensure platform compliance with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data governance, and regulatory requirements.
  • Support security audits, risk assessments, vulnerability remediation, and compliance activities.
  • Collaborate with security and governance teams to strengthen platform security and operational controls.

Vendor Management & Technical Governance

  • Provide technical oversight and engineering assurance for vendor-delivered platform services.
  • Review technical architecture, solution designs, implementation quality, and operational readiness.
  • Ensure vendor deliverables align with enterprise architecture standards and platform governance requirements.
  • Coordinate technical remediation, platform optimisation, and risk mitigation activities.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for complex platform engineering issues.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, engineering governance discussions, and technical decision-making.

Technical Advisory & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Provide technical guidance to Data, Infrastructure, Security, Product, and Application teams.
  • Support project teams in adopting standard platform services, engineering practices, and integration patterns.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, external vendors, and cloud service providers.
  • Contribute to platform roadmap planning, technology evaluations, and operational readiness assessments.
  • Recommend engineering improvements to enhance platform scalability, security, reliability, and operational efficiency.

Requirements

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or enterprise platform operations.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Strong experience supporting enterprise-scale cloud, data, analytics, or AI platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, including Unity Catalog and platform governance.
  • Proficiency in Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipeline development, and Infrastructure-as-Code, preferably Terraform.
  • Strong understanding of Azure networking, connectivity, cloud infrastructure, and security services.
  • Experience implementing DevOps, DevSecOps, automation, and infrastructure security practices.
  • Strong knowledge of platform observability, monitoring, alerting, incident management, and operational reliability.
  • Experience with API Management, API security, and enterprise integration architectures.
  • Familiarity with data integration and streaming technologies such as Kafka, Confluent, or Azure Event Hubs.
  • Experience supporting production data, analytics, or AI workloads.
  • Strong troubleshooting, incident resolution, and root cause analysis capabilities.
  • Experience working with multiple vendors and cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Strong communication, technical leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric and Microsoft Foundry (formerly Azure AI Foundry).
  • Knowledge of AI and agentic platform operations, including LLMOps and AI observability.
  • Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio and enterprise AI agent platforms.
  • Familiarity with FHIR, clinical interoperability platforms, and healthcare integration standards.
  • Experience implementing FinOps, cloud cost optimisation, and capacity management practices.
  • Exposure to enterprise architecture governance, security compliance, and disaster recovery planning.

title: Adhoc Vendor Surveillance Inspector - Washington
description:
Part Time Adhoc Quality Inspector – Olympia, Washington and its surrounding areas

Intertek, a leading provider of quality and safety solutions to many of the world’s top-recognized brands and companies, is actively seeking a Part Time Adhoc Quality Inspector to join our Technical Inspection Services team in Washington. This is a fantastic opportunity to grow a versatile career in Inspection Services!

Intertek Technical Inspection Services (TIS) is a partner to clients in diverse industries such as oil & gas, renewable energy, engineering, chemical, and transportation. Intertek supports our clients striving to meet the growing global infrastructure requirements and demands for secure and sustainable sources of energy through services such as inspection, expediting, technical auditing, and site construction support.

What are we looking for?

The Part Time Adhoc Quality Inspector is responsible for performing visual inspection of materials and/or fabricated equipment at vendor shops or on-site fabrication or testing facilities. The ideal candidate must be well versed in quality control inspections and tests, including nondestructive testing techniques, mechanical testing, dimensional inspection, pressure testing and coating inspections. This position will travel at least 50% of the time.

Shift/Schedule: All inspectors are utilized on an Adhoc basis and are not provided daily duties. All needs are based on our clients’ needs and we source inspectors based on availability, location, taxonomy approvals, and specific client requests.

Salary & Benefits Information

The base wage hourly range for this position is $35.00- $45.00. Individual compensation packages are based on a variety of factors unique to each candidate including skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

What you’ll do:

  • Perform inspections or audits and reviewing testing for conformance to Client specifications, industry standards, and approved procedures and reporting of results
  • Review material test reports to conformance with applicable codes and standards
  • Perform the follow-up of dispositions and corrective actions related to non-conformances
  • Document inspection activities in electronic formats
  • Evaluate and agree upon project quality procedures, standards, and specifications ensuring that all parties (engineering, procurement, manufacturing) are adhering to them
  • Review Inspection & Testing Plans to ensure a standardized minimum level of surveillance in accordance with the contractual requirements. Identify the critical inspections and tests to be witnessed by the Owner
  • Carry out inspection visits as per ITP’s either personally or through 3rd party resource

This position outline is a general guideline and does not represent all encompassing details. The position assumes that the incumbent has both the mental and physical requirements to carry out the above defined duties.

Minimum Requirements & Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or GED, Trade School, On-The-Job Training or University Diploma
  • 5+ years of third-party vendor inspection, expediting or auditing experience
  • Experience in quality control inspections and tests, including nondestructive testing techniques, mechanical testing, dimensional inspection, pressure testing and coating inspections
  • Technical training in subjects, such as, but not limited to quality, NDT, blueprint reading, industry standards, auditing, expediting, materials, welding, coatings, electrical components, instrumentation, pressure testing, well control, equipment operation and assembly
  • Must have basic knowledge of material properties
  • Possess clear understanding of basic procurement and fabrication processes with knowledge of relevant codes and specifications for the oil and gas industry
  • Ability to travel frequently throughout the continental US
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable driving record is required
  • Proficient in MS Office programs and Outlook

Preferred Requirements & Qualifications:

  • Valid Industry Certification preferred – Examples of such certifications include, but not limited to: AWS CWI, API 510, 570, SI, (Source Inspector), Electrical Journeyman License, NACE CIP 1, 2, 3, EMA (Expediting Management Association) Basic, Advanced, ASNT NDT Level II, III, and ASQ or IRCA Certified Auditor

    • Collaborate with Product Owners and Business Stakeholders to convert user needs into practical application experiences
    • Improve application usability, performance, accessibility, and maintainability
  • API and Microservices Development
    • Design and develop secure REST APIs and microservices using .NET Core and C#
    • Integrate applications with enterprise platforms, databases, analytics solutions, AI services, and workflow systems
    • Develop modular back-end services that support scalable application architecture
    • Support API performance optimization, exception handling, logging, security, and production monitoring
    • Troubleshoot integration issues across front-end, back-end, database, and cloud components
    • Contribute to modernization of monolithic applications through service-based architecture and reusable APIs
  • Database Design and Performance

    • Experience in Azure Databricks

    • Apply Entity Framework Core and ADO.NET for database access and application integration
    • Support data validation, troubleshooting, and database-related production issues

  • Azure Cloud and DevOps Engineering

    • Implement and maintain Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for automated builds, testing, deployment, and release management

    • Collaborate with platform and engineering teams to improve deployment reliability and release quality

    • Develop or support Power BI dashboards, matrix reports, and interactive visualizations where required
    • Enable users to access operational insights and AI-generated recommendations through integrated application experiences
    • Collaborate with analytics teams to incorporate business metrics and reporting outputs into applications
    • Ensure analytics features align with user workflows and business requirements
  • Agile and Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, UI designers, AI Engineers, Data Engineers, and Platform Teams
    • Convert requirements into technical specifications, development tasks, and implementation plans
    • Provide transparent status updates on delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and technical decisions

title: Senior Devops Engineer (Remote - EU)
description:
This is a remote position.

The employer develops a breakthrough high-performance onchain exchange that delivers institutional grade execution, whilst delivering superior speed, security and reliability guarantees to users. Their revolutionary decentralized exchange operates as the world's first trading-specific Based Rollup on Ethereum offering core competitive advantage : Unlike traditional Layer 2 solutions that rely on single sequencers, Based Rollup grants transaction sequencing rights directly to Ethereum validators, achieving true decentralization.

This design delivers significant benefits:
- Speed:
- Security: verifiable order execution and settlement, via zk-proofs, with executed trades settling on Ethereum. over 950,000 Ethereum validators securing every transaction. Transaction data ultimately settles on Ethereum mainnet, inheriting all L1 security guarantees.
- Reliability: no single point of failure, with the rollup design having multiple rotating L2 nodes (unlike generation-1 rollups)

Their custom trading engine is written in Rust, achieving deterministic execution. Their engine is cross-compiled into zero-knowledge circuits, allowing the network to generate validity proofs for each state transition, ensuring provably correct order execution.

They’re looking for a Senior Devops Engineer based anywhere in Europe (Remote), to join their team
As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in building and maintaining the infrastructure that powers the company's DeX and Network. Your mission is to ensure systems are secure, scalable, and highly available — enabling the team to deliver quickly without sacrificing reliability.
You thrive in a small, highly skilled team dealing with complexity, unknowns, and rapid iteration.
You enjoy automating away toil and creating scalable, self-healing systems.
You are excited by the opportunity to help shape the future of finance through reliable, secure infrastructure.
You embrace end-to-end ownership of systems, from design to monitoring to incident response.

MISSIONS

Infrastructure Design & Automation:
Design, implement, and maintain cloud-native infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Build scalable, reproducible environments that support high-throughput, low-latency trading systems.
CI/CD & Developer Experience:
Own and improve the CI/CD pipelines for backend, frontend, and smart contract codebases. Ensure fast, reliable builds and deployments with strong observability and rollback mechanisms.
Monitoring, Observability & Reliability:
Define and implement monitoring, logging, and alerting strategies to achieve maximum system reliability and early incident detection. Drive SLO/SLI/SLAs and participate in on-call rotations.
Scalability & Performance:
Optimize infrastructure for latency-sensitive workloads. Tune autoscaling policies, network configurations, and resource utilization to ensure consistent performance during peak loads.
Security & Compliance:
Implement robust security practices across infrastructure, CI/CD, and runtime environments. Protect systems from evolving threats through network segmentation, secret management, and runtime hardening.
Incident Response & Disaster Recovery:
Establish and maintain playbooks, failover mechanisms, and disaster recovery plans. Lead post-incident reviews and proactively address root causes.
Cost Management:
Continuously monitor and optimize cloud costs while ensuring performance and redundancy requirements are met.
Technological Evaluation:
Stay current on infrastructure tooling, orchestration frameworks, and security best practices. Evaluate new technologies for potential adoption to improve performance and resilience.
Documentation & Knowledge Sharing:
Maintain clear, detailed documentation for infrastructure, processes, and runbooks. Mentor engineers and help foster a culture of reliability and automation across the team.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering roles in high-availability, mission-critical systems with prior Web3 and trading experience
  • 6+ years of experience with major cloud platforms (AWS and GCP)
  • Experience supporting low-latency trading systems or other real-time financial applications
  • Familiarity with blockchain infrastructure, node operations, and Web3 tooling
  • Strong proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation)
  • Expertise with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with Kubernetes cluster tuning for high performance (e.g., custom schedulers, CNI tuning)
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD, etc.)
  • Advanced knowledge of monitoring, logging, and alerting tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, OpenTelemetry)
  • Hands-on experience with secrets management and security best practices (HashiCorp Vault, KMS, IAM policies)
  • Proven ability to manage and tune production infrastructure supporting latency-sensitive workloads
  • Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, Go, or similar)
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a focus on reliability and continuous improvement

Preferred Qualifications :
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • Experience supporting low-latency trading systems or other real-time financial applications
  • Familiarity with service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd)
  • Knowledge of zero-downtime deployment strategies (blue/green, canary)
  • Experience with Kubernetes cluster tuning for high performance (e.g., custom schedulers, CNI tuning)
  • Familiarity with blockchain infrastructure, node operations, and Web3 tooling
  • Understanding of financial systems, derivatives trading, and risk controls

title: Ergoterapeut til børneområdet i Allerød Kommune
description:
Engageret ergoterapeut til børneområdet søges pr. 1. december 2026. Stillingen er på 20 timer om ugen.

Vi søger en ergoterapeut som brænder for at arbejde med børn og som evner at tænke kreativt og selvstændigt i arbejdets tilrettelæggelse og udførelse. Derudover søger vi en medarbejder som værdsætter betydningen af tværfagligt samarbejde, herunder med fysio- og ergoterapeuter, lærere, pædagoger, medhjælpere og talepædagoger.

Stillingen er en kombineret stilling, hvor opgaverne vil være delt mellem Allerød kommunes børneterapi og Centerklasserne, begge på Lillevang skole.

Om opgaven i børneterapien:
Her skal du primært arbejde med kommunens børn i alderen inden for 0-18 år og deres familier inden for almenområdet samt varetage genoptræningsplaner der kommer fra hospitalet.

Vi kan tilbyde dig et spændende og selvstændigt arbejde, med god mulighed for medindflydelse på dine opgaver. Du vil blive en del af et team med både fysioterapeuter og ergoterapeuter.

Hverdagen byder på mange samarbejdsflader og kommunikation med mange mennesker, hvilket kræver, at du har et godt overblik og kan finde dig godt tilpas i det felt. Du vil være ansvarlig for den ergoterapeutiske behandling og rådgivning omkring børnene i tæt samarbejde med forældrene og koordinerende terapeut.

Stillingen i børneterapien indebærer opgaver inden for:

  • Genoptræningsplaner
  • Udarbejdelse af CPOP-protokoller
  • Råd og vejledningsopgaver til børn med finmotoriske udfordringer
  • Rådgivning i forhold til børn med sansemotoriske udfordringer
  • Oralmotorisk udredning og behandling

Om opgaven i Centerklasserne:
Centerklasserne er et integreret skole- og terapeutisk tilbud for normaltbegavede børn med bevægehandicap og evt. medfølgende specifikke vanskeligheder. Centerklasserne har elever fra 0.-9. årgang. Lillevang Skole er en distriktsskole med to afdelinger, 0.-5. klasse på afd. Skovvang og 6.-9. klasse på afd. Lillerød og med centerklasserne fordelt på begge matrikler. Du vil blive en del af en terapeutgruppe bestående af to fysioterapeuter og to ergoterapeuter, med arbejdsopgaver på begge matrikler.

Det er en forudsætning for varetagelsen af arbejdet, at du har erfaring med træning af børn og gerne også børn med bevægehandicap. Du vil bl.a. komme til at arbejde med følgende opgaver:

  • Finmotorisk undersøgelse og træning
  • Oralmotorisk undersøgelse og træning
  • Sanseprofil samt sansemotorisk træning
  • Vejledning ift. skolerelaterede hjælpemidler, bl.a. skriveredskaber, hjælpemidler til madlavning mm
  • Deltagelse i kreative fag, bl.a. madkundskab og billedkunst
  • Genoptræningsforløb, fx. efter botox behandling
  • Arbejdes med CPOP (led måling og registrering i protokollen)

Vi søger dig som:

  • Er uddannet ergoterapeut og med erfaring eller interesse inden for børneområdet
  • Er positiv, udadvendt, fleksibel, engageret samt evner at gøre træningen motiverende og sjov
  • Er god til at kommunikere og samarbejde med børn og forældre
  • Er nysgerrig på udvikling inden for eget fag og holder dig ajour
  • Har et godt klinisk blik og er reflekterende ift. egen praksis
  • Trives med mange og vekslende opgaver, som kræver gode planlægningsevner
  • Har viden eller erfaring med oralmotorik fx FOTT, OPT eller CM
  • Er god til at arbejde selvstændigt, har gode samarbejdsevner og kan se værdien i det tværfaglige arbejde

Vi kan tilbyde:

  • En spændende og dynamisk hverdag med plads til udvikling
  • Mulighed for at sætte præg på eget arbejde
  • Tværfaglig læring, udvikling og samarbejde
  • Gode fysiske rammer
  • Et arbejdsmiljø med plads til sjov blandt børn og personale

Du vil blive ansat på Lillevang skole, hvor både centerklasserne og børneterapien er forankret. Vi er kendt for at have et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde både på skolen og i kommunen og deraf et positivt arbejdsmiljø.

Om Lillevang Skole:
På Lillevang Skole går faglighed, trivsel og fællesskab hånd i hånd. Det er i fællesskabet, at vi inspireres og udvikles og bliver til dem, vi er. Vi ruster eleverne fagligt til fremtiden, og til at indgå positivt i de fællesskaber den byder på.

I skolens hverdag vægter vi den demokratiske dannelse, og ønsker at bidrage til en forbedring af klodens fremtid – det betyder bl.a. at vi arbejder strategisk med FN’s verdensmål og børnekonventionen som en del af skolens hverdag.

Lillevang Skole er en mangfoldig arbejdsplads, og vi vil gerne afspejle det omkringliggende samfund. Vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset alder, køn, religion eller etnisk oprindelse til at søge stillingen.

Allerød Kommune er en arbejdsplads med en høj social kapital. Vi vægter tværfagligt samarbejde, kompetence- og jobudvikling og ikke mindst medindflydelse på egen hverdag højt. Det vigtigste for os er vores kerneopgave – at skabe værdi for borgeren.

I Allerød Kommune arbejder vi ud fra vores Børne- og ungepolitik med dertilhørende underliggende børne- og læringssyn.

Er du interesseret?
Du er velkommen til at kontakte Thomas Castøe Jacobsen på 29 72 42 16, thcj@alleroed.dk eller Kirsten Gottschalck-Hansen på 23 29 85 03 for at høre nærmere om stillingen. Du uploader din ansøgning sammen med dit CV og uddannelsesbevis via linket i annoncen senest den 27. oktober 2026. Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler løbende og i uge 44 og indhenter referencer og straffeoplysninger forud for endelig ansættelse. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår vil blive fastsat efter gældende overenskomst.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

Kommunen har ca. 2.000 medarbejdere, der arbejder ud fra et fælles Leder- og Medarbejdergrundlag, hvor værdier som dialog, samarbejde, respekt og faglighed er hjørnesten. Her kan du læse Allerød Kommunes Leder- og Medarbejdergrundlag_.

Organisationen baserer sig på flade strukturer, stor medindflydelse og gode udviklingsmuligheder. Allerød Kommune er en røgfri arbejdsplads med røgfri arbejdstid.

Vi tror på, at mangfoldighed hos vores medarbejdere styrker vores organisation og løsningen af den fælles kerneopgave. Vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede ansøgere til at søge stillingen uanset køn, kønsidentitet, alder, handicap, etnisk baggrund eller seksuel orientering.

Allerød Kommune ligger i hjertet af Nordsjælland i en smuk og varieret natur. Kommunen har tæt på 26.000 indbyggere og byder på et aktivt forenings- og erhvervsliv med gode idræts- og fritidsmuligheder.

Der er flere gode transportmuligheder både til og fra kommunen, og der går S-tog hvert 10. minut fra Allerød Station.

title: Fire Suppression Technician
description:
Up to a $10,000 sign-on bonus is available!!! If you hold ICC, FEX1, and E4 certifications along with pipe threading and piping installation experience, we’ve been looking for you.
We’re on the lookout for a skilled Kitchen Fire Suppression System Technician who’s ready to help keep commercial kitchens safe. In this role, you’ll inspect, repair, and install kitchen fire suppression systems, ensuring everything is running safely, smoothly, and fully compliant.
Experience with industry-leading manufacturers like Ansul, Amerex, Pyro-Chem, and Range Guard is essential, and your expertise will play a key role in protecting people, property, and a lot of busy kitchens.

JOB SUMMARY:

The purpose of the Fire Suppression Technician is to provide installation, inspection, service and/or repair of Fire Extinguishers, Emergency Exit Lights and/or any Pre-Engineered Suppression Systems including any associated Detection & Control Systems with minimal supervision.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES:

  • Use required tools and test equipment such as power machines groovers, cutters, band saw, lifts, etc. to repair or replace fire extinguishers, pre-engineered systems, and/or Detection & Control systems components.
  • Comprehensive working knowledge of NFPA codes, standards, and systems such as all types of fire extinguishers, pre-engineered suppression systems and/or Detection & Control systems.
  • Troubleshoot and identify defective components of pre-engineered suppression systems.
  • Repair or replace damaged components of pre-engineered suppression systems as well as fire extinguishers and/or Detection & Control systems.
  • Communicate with internal and external customers in a professional manner.
  • Required to be punctual to required work locations and complete scheduled projects in timely manner.
  • Use Field Service Lightning to track work orders, materials needed, time on job, etc.
  • Complete documentation on work orders.
  • Understand and follow SFS’s Safety program, SDS book, Hazardous communication program, policies and procedures. Participate in weekly Toolbox talks. Employee must always know location all related safety documentation on each project.
  • Ensure company provided vehicle is clean and well maintained as required by company policies.
  • Periodically attend seminars or similar education/training sessions to stay abreast of latest technology, codes, and standards changes.
  • Other duties may be assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

The qualifications listed below are representative of the elements required to perform the job successfully, however in some cases, an equivalent combination of Education, Training, Certifications and Experience may meet the job qualifications.

Education, Training, Certifications:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent, required.
  • State or any required certification.

Experience, Knowledge, Skill Requirements:

  • 2 Fire Life Safety Industry experience specifically within Fire Suppression.
  • 2 years of professional computer skills.

Communication Skills:

  • Must have the ability to effectively read, write and communicate in English with employees and customers.

Other Qualifications:

  • Valid driver’s license with acceptable driving record required.
  • Must be able to comply with SFS’s Drug and Alcohol policy and Background screening requirements, which may also include customer specific requirements based on contractual agreement.

PHYSICAL & WORK ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform Essential Job Duties.

Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to bend, ascend and descend step stools, ladders and stairs, kneel, lift <50lbs, reach above and below shoulders, stand and walk for extended periods of time. Employee is required to see in color, close and far distances, peripheral, depth, and adjust focus. Employee will occasional be required to balance, crouch, drive, kneel, lift >50lbs, sit, stoop, twist, and work at heights.

Work Environment:

title: Supervisor, Healthcare Services
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Summary

Leads and supervises a multidisciplinary team of healthcare services professionals in some or all of the following functions: care management, utilization management, behavioral health, care transitions, long-term services and supports (LTSS), and/or special programs. Ensures members reach desired outcomes through integrated delivery and coordination of care across the continuum, and contributes to overarching strategy to provide quality and cost-effective member care.

*PST Hours*

Essential Job Duties

• Oversees team performance for one or more of the following healthcare services functions: care management, utilization management (prior authorizations, inpatient/outpatient medical necessity, etc.), transition of care, behavioral health, long-term services and supports (LTSS), and/or special programs.
• Facilitates integrated, proactive healthcare services management - ensuring compliance with state and federal regulatory and accrediting standards and implementation of the Molina clinical model.
• Functions as a “hands-on” leader - assisting with assessing and evaluation of systems, day-to-day operations and efficiency of services/care delivery.
• Ensures adequate staffing and service levels and maintains customer satisfaction by implementing and monitoring staff productivity and other performance indicators.
• Assists in implementing care management, utilization management, behavioral health, care transitions, LTSS and other program activities in accordance with regulatory, contract standards and accreditation compliance.
• Ensures delivery of member care and services are aligned with Molina's established standards of customer service excellence.
• Ensures high-risk, complex members are adequately supported.

• Analyzes and reports on care access and monitoring statistics including plan utilization, staff productivity, cost-effective utilization of services, management of targeted member population, and triage activities.
• Ensures completion of staff quality audit reviews evaluates services provided, outcomes achieved and recommends enhancements/improvements for programs and staff development to ensure consistent cost-effectiveness and compliance with all state and federal regulations and guidelines.
• Maintains professional relationships with provider community, internal and external customers, and state agencies as appropriate.

Required Qualifications

• At least 5 years of health care experience, including at least 2 years of managed care experienced in one or more of the following areas: utilization management, care management, care transitions, behavioral health, long-term services and supports (LTSS), or special programs, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

• Strong customer service skills/member-centric focus.
• Ability to work within a variety of settings and adjust style as needed, including ability to work with diverse populations, various personalities and personal situations.
• Ability to prioritize and manage multiple deadlines.
• Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to collaborate cross-functionally within a highly matrixed organization.

title: Tree Worker
description:
Position Title: Tree Worker

Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent

Employer: The Purple Lion Group Pty Ltd T/A Dural Christmas Tree Farm

Location: Dural, NSW

Salary: $75,000 - $85,000 per annum plus superannuation

About the Company

Established in 2000, Dural Christmas Tree Farm is Sydney's largest fresh Christmas tree farm. The business supplies fresh Christmas trees directly from the farm, as well as pre-cut Christmas trees, and provides services including netting, delivery, installation in Cinco Christmas tree stands, collection, and recycling. The Purple Lion Group Pty Ltd operates and manages Christmas tree plantations and requires an experienced Tree Worker to assist with the hands-on care, maintenance, treatment, and removal of trees across its plantation operations.

About the Role

Dural Christmas Tree Farm is seeking a full-time Tree Worker to carry out the practical, hands-on care and maintenance of Christmas trees and other tree assets across the plantation. Reporting to the Manager, the Tree Worker will prune and shape trees, treat trees for pests and disease, remove dead or decaying trees, access trees at height where required, and maintain the plantation growing environment. This role is suited to a practical tree-care worker with strong skills in pruning, safe equipment use, chemical handling, and plantation-based tree maintenance.

Key Responsibilities

• Prune limbs and shape branches of Christmas trees and other trees using chainsaws and handsaws to promote healthy growth, safety, presentation, and commercial quality.

• Maintain and care for trees and shrubs, including planting young trees, watering, fertilising, and weed control.

• Treat trees for pests, diseases, and nutrient deficiencies, including the safe application of sprays, chemicals, and fertilisers.

• Examine trees to assess their condition and identify risks associated with falling limbs or trees, and carry out the required treatment.

• Remove dead, decaying, damaged, or unsuitable trees, and grind out tree stumps.

• Access trees at height using rope access, harnesses, and elevated work platforms where required.

• Maintain irrigation systems, tools, machinery, and plantation areas to ensure safe and effective tree management operations.

• Manage, recycle, or dispose of tree waste in accordance with business and safety requirements.

• Assist with general plantation and farm maintenance duties as required.

• Supervise and train casual staff in safe tree care, pruning, chemical handling, maintenance, and recycling practices.

Skills

• Practical skill in pruning, trimming, shaping, planting, and maintaining trees safely and effectively.

• Competent and safe use of arboriculture and horticultural tools and equipment, including chainsaws, handsaws, pruning equipment, spraying equipment, and irrigation tools.

• Ability to access and work on trees at height using rope access, harnesses, or elevated work platforms.

• Knowledge of tree health, common pests and diseases, and appropriate treatment methods.

• Understanding of safe chemical handling and the application of sprays and fertilisers.

• Knowledge of watering, irrigation, soil management, weed control, and plantation maintenance practices.

• Strong risk awareness and the ability to identify hazards associated with tree work, equipment use, chemicals, and outdoor plantation environments.

• Good communication skills and the ability to supervise, train, and coordinate casual staff.

Experience

• Demonstrated experience in tree care, pruning, tree maintenance, plantation tree management, or arboriculture.

• Experience working safely with chainsaws and tree-care equipment.

• Experience in plantation, nursery, horticulture, or outdoor tree-based work (desirable).

Qualifications

• A relevant qualification in Arboriculture, Horticulture, or a closely related field, such as an AQF Certificate III, Certificate IV, or equivalent; or relevant work experience in lieu of formal qualifications.

• At least 1 year of relevant work experience in tree care, pruning, tree maintenance, or arboriculture.

• Knowledge of safe chemical handling and willingness to maintain relevant training and certifications.

• Physical fitness and capacity to perform outdoor work, including pruning, planting, lifting, operating equipment, working at heights, and working in varying weather conditions.

• Current driver's licence is desirable.

• Chainsaw, chemical handling, first aid, working at heights, or related safety tickets are desirable.

Important Eligibility Requirement

To be considered for this role, applicants must have full-time, unrestricted working rights in Australia for the duration of the employment period. Applicants who do not hold unrestricted work rights will not be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

This position is advertised by At Ease Solutions on behalf of The Purple Lion Group Pty Ltd T/A Dural Christmas Tree Farm.

title: Software Engineer (Open Source Contributor)

Role Type: Contractor

You'll create realistic, interesting and challenging coding tasks for AI to solve involving feature implementation and bug fixes, and implement deterministic verifiers that accept reasonable valid solutions and reject everything else.



What we're looking for

  1. Strong backend experience in Java, Node.js, Go, Rust, Typescript, Python, C++ or similar

  3. Comfort with debugging, performance work and automated testing

  7. Interest in or curiosity about AI and its technical challenges (previous AI experience not required).


Process:

  1. Apply to the role, filling out the screening questions
  2. Complete AI interview (aprox. 20 minutes)

  4. Hiring Manager review

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.


Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

title: Full-Stack Developer (Junior to Mid-Level)
description:
Junior to Mid-Level Full-Stack Developer

Remote, Philippines · Full-time independent contractor · 7:00 PM – 4:00 AM PHT, Monday to Friday · USD 1,000 – 1,300 per month

BloomGuarden is a U.S.-based HR company. Alongside our recruiting and HR services, we build our own software, in two product lines:

  • GuardenLabs: a suite of web-based HR tools that help HR and finance teams plan their workforce and make better people decisions.
  • Audelle: a mobile app and API that helps families run their household and manage the staff who work in it.

We are a small team. You join as our second developer and work directly with our senior developer, who reviews your work and helps you grow. From day one you pick up real tasks across both product lines: screens, API endpoints and bug fixes.

You do not need to know everything listed below. You need solid basics, care for detail, and the drive to learn fast.

What You'll Do

Build and ship

  • Build screens in the Audelle mobile app (React Native with Expo) and the API endpoints behind them (Node.js with Express).
  • Fix bugs and add features in the GuardenLabs HR tools (React, Next.js, Vite).
  • Build reusable, responsive React components from a design, and connect them to APIs.
  • Deploy and monitor apps on Vercel, and investigate production errors reported through Sentry.

Work to a quality standard

  • For any business rule (a calculation, a permission, a limit), write the test first, then the code that makes it pass.
  • Check your work the way a user sees it: phone-sized screen first, then desktop, and on the Android emulator for the mobile app.
  • Open a pull request on GitHub for every change, and work through review comments with the senior developer.

Communicate and own your work

  • Keep your tasks current on our Monday.com board with short, plain-English updates, the same day.
  • Ask clear questions early, flag blockers, and write pull request notes another developer can follow.

What You Bring

Non-negotiable tools

  • React.js: you can build a screen from a design and connect it to an API.
  • GitHub: branches, pull requests, code review and merge conflicts.
  • Vercel: you have deployed and managed at least one app on Vercel.

Must-haves

  • About 1 to 3 years of professional experience building web or mobile apps, or equivalent shipped projects (freelance, open source or production side projects you can show us).
  • Good JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript, and good React.
  • Some backend experience: you have written REST endpoints and SQL queries against a real database (PostgreSQL preferred).
  • Experience writing automated tests (Jest, Vitest or similar).
  • Responsive, mobile-first web development, and solid debugging skills.
  • Clear written English. We work remotely and mostly in writing, so your updates and questions must be easy to follow.

Big bonus

  • You use AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot) with judgment: you read and test what they produce before you ship it, and you can explain every line you submit.

Nice-to-haves

  • React Native with Expo, or Next.js.
  • Supabase, including row-level security (database rules that decide who can see which rows).
  • Express and Zod; Tailwind CSS or NativeWind; TanStack Query.
  • Stripe payments; Sentry; CI/CD pipelines.
  • Authentication (OAuth, JWT, Supabase Auth, Clerk or similar).
  • Comfort with numbers and spreadsheets. Some of our HR tools are calculation-heavy.
  • Startup or SaaS product experience.

Our Stack

TypeScript · React · Next.js · Vite · React Native / Expo · Node.js / Express · PostgreSQL / Supabase · Tailwind CSS / NativeWind · Vitest / Jest · Stripe · Sentry · Vercel · GitHub · Monday.com

How We Work

  • Code is split into clear layers: routes, controllers and services on the backend; pages, hooks and components on the frontend.
  • Small files, small functions, clear names.
  • Mobile first: every screen works at phone width before desktop.
  • A change is done only when its tests pass and it has been checked by hand in the browser or emulator.
  • Every caught error is reported, never silently ignored.

Our Culture

We hire for the three virtues of the Ideal Team Player (Patrick Lencioni), plus the way BloomGuarden works:

  • Humble: you welcome code review, admit mistakes quickly, and give credit to others.
  • Hungry: you own your tasks end to end, learn fast, and follow through without reminders.
  • People smart: you read the room in writing: you know when to ask, when to update and how to give feedback kindly.
  • BloomGuarden values: integrity (honest status, even when it is bad news), quality over speed, care for the people who use our products, and protecting the data entrusted to us.

Your First Three Months

  • Month 1: set up every project locally, learn the codebase, ship your first small fixes.
  • Month 2: own small features end to end, from board task to merged pull request.
  • Month 3: own a full screen or feature, including its tests, with light review.

Work Setup and Pay

  • Fully remote. You must be based in the Philippines.
  • Working hours: 7:00 PM to 4:00 AM Philippine time, Monday to Friday, the same hours as our senior developer.
  • Full-time engagement as an independent contractor, with no other job or clients during these hours.
  • Pay: USD 1,000 to 1,300 per month. Where you land in the range is set by our structured evaluation: the interview rubric and a short technical exercise.
  • Equipment: a computer that can run the Android emulator, a stable internet connection, a backup power source and a quiet place to work.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Written application: resume, a GitHub or portfolio link, and answers to the three questions below.
  2. Screening call (20–30 min): availability, setup and basics.
  3. Technical exercise: a short take-home task (capped at about 2–3 hours) or a live pairing session, scored on the same criteria for everyone.
  4. Structured interview: same questions for every candidate, scored on a written rubric. Includes a walkthrough of your exercise.
  5. Decision and offer: we aim to decide within 3 business days of your final interview.

To Apply

Answer these three questions in writing (3–5 sentences each):

  1. Describe a feature you built end to end. What was your part, what stack did you use, and how did you test it?
  2. Tell us about a bug that was hard to find. How did you track it down?
  3. How do you use AI coding tools today, and how do you check what they produce?

Equal Opportunity

BloomGuarden is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based only on job-related skills, experience and the needs of the work. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital or family status, pregnancy, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, disability, health condition, political belief, or any other status protected by law. Every candidate is assessed with the same structured process and rubric.

If you need an accommodation at any stage of the process, tell us and we will work with you. Please do not include a photo, your age, date of birth, marital status or religion on your resume; we do not use them.
