title: UN Women Project Manager, Homebased, IPSA-11
description:
Background:

UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security.

UN Women continues to advance its digital transformation agenda through the implementation, enhancement and integration of enterprise platforms and digital solutions that support organizational effectiveness, business process simplification, data-driven decision-making, and improved user experience. These initiatives require coordinated project management across business stakeholders, as well as effective governance, planning, risk management, quality assurance, change management, and stakeholder engagement.

PRISM, UN Women’s new corporate platform to support strategic planning, results management, and monitoring and reporting of Strategic Plan, Strategic Notes, workplans and projects, has been successfully deployed during 2025-2026 across the organization, with ensuring its integration with Quantum, UN Women’s ERP system. The priority in 2027 will be to support system stabilization and sustained adoption, deliver prioritized enhancements, optimize existing functionalities and business processes, and strengthen integrations and reporting capabilities.

The Project Manager will be responsible for leading these corporate technology and digital transformation projects in accordance with organizational priorities. The role is therefore not limited to PRISM and is expected to develop strategies, manage project planning, and implement change management initiatives to transform business processes and improve efficiency in the scope of the projects assigned. This role involves managing resources and risks, and ensuring a cohesive, cross-functional approach.
Under the overall guidance of the Digital Governance Board and direct supervision by Chief Information Systems and Telecommunications (IST), the Project Manager will primarily be responsible for the effective management of assigned projects. This includes ensuring that project objectives, scope, timelines, resources, budgets, risks, dependencies, and governance arrangements are effectively managed and that decisions and escalations are brought to the appropriate governance bodies in a timely manner.

The Project Manager will work in close consultation and collaboration with a wide range of clients and stakeholders across the UN Women, such as key Business Process Owners (including Strategic Planning Unit and Programme Support Management Unit in SPRED), Information Technology teams, key end-users in the country, regional and corporate levels, as well as external partners, as applicable. The goal is to promote critical thinking and innovation to design simplified and streamlined processes that will support the delivery of practical, sustainable, and user-centered solutions and will enhance organizational performance and efficiency.

Note: Prior to starting their assignment, home based international PPSA are responsible for holding a work permit valid for the homebased location during the entire IPPSA duration.

Scope of Work

1. Lead the strategic direction and management of assigned digital transformation projects, including PRISM
• Provide strategic vision and project management leadership for the assigned projects in collaboration with the Chief, IST, relevant Business Process Owner, and Digital Governance Board.
• Coordinate the technical implementation of PRISM enhancements and stabilization roadmap during 2027, supporting prioritization of improvements, resolution of post-go-live issues, platform optimization, and adoption in collaboration with the Chief, IST and Chief, SPU.
• Act as a trusted and neutral project manager across all business processes and workstreams; oversee and facilitate process improvement discussions between business owners, build project momentum, and manage escalations to the Senior leadership and governance bodies;
• Engage and coordinate business owners and focal points across the Organization globally and provide them with updates on the project;
• Ensure that project objectives and proposed solutions remain aligned with Organization’s goals, priorities, policies and capitalize on UN System and industry best practices;
• Provide high-level analysis and advice on project options, priorities, trade-offs, implementation approaches, risks, dependencies, and resource implications to support timely decision-making.
• Monitor, track, and control technical outcomes to resolve issues, conflicts, dependencies, and critical path deliverables.

2. Plan and coordinate project delivery across business and technical teams
• Develop, maintain and monitor integrated project plans, including scope, deliverables, timelines, milestones, and resource allocation.
• Coordinate with various departments to ensure that all aspects of the project are aligned and progressing as planned.
• Monitor project delivery, identify variances and constraints, and coordinate corrective actions and recovery plans where required.
• Provide input to and review implementation plans, component plans, contingency plans, milestones, dependencies etc. attached to the project’s high-level deliverables;
• Provide input to and review project budgets to ensure they are based on outputs and deliverables and clearly linked to milestones and project phases.


3. Engage and manage stakeholders at all levels
• Engage with stakeholders at all levels, including senior management, business process owners, technical teams, regional and country offices, end-users, vendors, and external partners.
• Provide regular progress reports to Digital Governance Board and other stakeholders as needed
• Ensure that stakeholders are appropriately informed, involved, consulted, and supportive of the project's goals and progress.
• Coordinate cross-functional discussions to resolve competing priorities, clarify ownership, and facilitate timely decisions.


4. Manage Project Scope, Changes, Risks and Dependencies
• Establish and maintain effective mechanisms for managing project scope, requirements, changes, risks, issues, assumptions,and dependencies.
• Ensure proposed changes are assessed for business value, cost, schedule, and dependency impacts and are submitted to the appropriate governance body for decision.
• Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies related to the implementation of the projects.
• Monitor risks throughout the project lifecycle and take proactive measures to address any issues that arise.
• Monitor and report on effectiveness of project risk framework, related controls, and indicators to the Digital Governance Board.
• Identify and manage dependencies across business streams and other corporate initiatives.


5. Plan and Monitor Project Resources and Budgets
• Support the development and monitoring of project budgets, ensuring costs are linked to approved scope, outputs, milestones, and project phases.
• Manage these resources efficiently to avoid delays and cost overruns.
• Plan and coordinate the efficient and effective deployment of human and financial resources required for project delivery including necessary recruitment and procurement of additional resources.
• Monitor resource constraints and capacity risks and recommend to governance bodies on resource allocation and priorities.
• Identify opportunities for efficiency and cost optimization wherever possible.


6. Ensure Quality Assurance and Testing of Project Deliverables
• Ensure appropriate quality assurance processes are integrated into project deliverables to meet the required standards and specifications.
• Coordinate with business and technical teams on requirements validation, UAT, defect resolution, sign-off and release readiness, as applicable.
• Monitor critical defects and issues through resolution, including post-go-live stabilization activities.


7. Coordinate Project Communication and Change Management
• Develop and coordinate regular communication with the project team, Digital Governance Board, and stakeholders during project implementation.
• Provide updates on project status, progress, and any issues that need attention.
• Support change management activities required to facilitate adoption of new or enhanced systems, business processes, and ways of working.
• Establish and coordinate necessary collaboration with other UN System Organizations and UN Women partners.


8. Coordinate Knowledge Management and End-User Training and Support
• Lead and coordinate the organization and facilitation of workshops and training to ensure ongoing business transformation, process changes, and system evolution is understood and appropriately used by stakeholders
• Ensure that end-users are trained and supported during the rollout of the new system.
• Coordinate training sessions and provide support to ensure a smooth transition.
• Coordinate the maintenance of a dedicated site of UN Women Intranet to ensure all the relevant documents and training materials are available and accessible to all UN Women personnel in user-friendly manner.
• Promote reuse of lessons learned, templates and project management practices across future initiatives.


9. Coordinate Project Closure, Transition and Continuous Improvement
• Coordinate PRISM closure, including confirmation of deliverables, outstanding actions, financial status, documentation, lessons learned and transition arrangements.
• Support post-implementation reviews and audits
• Identify opportunities and lessons learned to strengthen project management governance and practices within IST and across UN Women.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Competencies :

Core Values:

  • Integrity;
  • Professionalism;
  • Respect for Diversity.

Core Competencies:

  • Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues;
  • Accountability;
  • Creative Problem Solving;
  • Effective Communication;
  • Inclusive Collaboration;
  • Stakeholder Engagement;
  • Leading by Example.

Please visit this link for more information on UN Women’s Values and Competencies Framework:

Functional Competencies:

  • Demonstrated technical leadership and project management skills in international and multi-cultural settings at the global level.
  • Excellent project formulation, implementation, monitoring, reporting, and evaluation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross-functional technology and digital transformation initiatives involving business, technical and external stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of Results-Based Management principles and approaches.
  • Demonstrated capacity for strategic thinking, prioritization, problem solving, and strategy development.
  • Ability to translate complex business and technical matters into clear recommendations and executive level communications.
  • Ability to develop a clear operational plan for business transformation, process improvement, and system implementation strategy.
  • Ability to stay focused under pressure, manage ambiguity and competing priorities, and drive timely decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships with strategic partners, with highly developed communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Knowledge of organizational change management, user adoption, training, and knowledge-management approaches.
  • Ability to create a knowledge-sharing environment.
  • Ability to ensure effective teamwork, with excellent managerial and technical leadership skills and the ability to delegate appropriate responsibility, accountability, and decision-making authority.
  • Expert understanding of enterprise technology environments, including ERP systems, system integration, data and reporting, cloud services, and related digital solutions.
  • Ability to support project portfolio and PMO functions, consolidate information across multiple initiatives, and translate portfolio data into clear management-level reporting and decision support

Education and Certification:

  • A Master’s degree in business administration, management, project management, Information Technology, or other related fields is required.
  • A first-level university degree in combination with two additional years of qualifying experience may be accepted in lieu of the advanced university degree.
  • The following qualifications are desirable:
    o Project Management Certification (Prince2; PMI)
    o Agile/ SCRUM Certification

Experience

  • A minimum of 7 years of experience that combines strategic and managerial leadership in complex IT, digital transformation projects, including planning, design development, and implementation, in large and/or international organizations is required.
  • Experience in successfully running software development and product implementation projects is required.
  • Experience in organizational change management, risk mitigation, and conflict management is required.
  • Experience in roles as a Programme Manager, Project Manager, and/or Business Analyst is required.
  • Experience in the development and management of project budgeting, and tracking is required.
  • Experience leading a cross-functional team is required.
  • Experience working within the United Nations or at a global/corporate level is highly desirable.
  • Experience with quality assurance and testing is desirable.
  • Experience in data integration across different technical platforms is required.
  • Experience with enterprise services like Microsoft 365, Oracle Cloud ERP (or any ERP platform), SaaS, IaaS, and PaaS models is required.
  • Experience in the use of standard office software packages (MS Word, Excel, Power Point, etc.), spreadsheet and database packages is required.

Languages

  • Fluency in English is required, including excellent drafting and editing skills.
  • Knowledge of another official UN language is desirable (French, Arabic, Chinese, Russian or Spanish).

Statements :

In July 2010, the United Nations General Assembly created UN Women, the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women. The creation of UN Women came about as part of the UN reform agenda, bringing together resources and mandates for greater impact. It merges and builds on the important work of four previously distinct parts of the UN system (DAW, OSAGI, INSTRAW and UNIFEM), which focused exclusively on gender equality and women's empowerment.

Diversity and inclusion:

At UN Women, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment of mutual respect. UN Women recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, national origin, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, competence, integrity and organizational need.

If you need any reasonable accommodation to support your participation in the recruitment and selection process, please include this information in your application.

UN Women has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UN Women, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to UN Women’s policies and procedures and the standards of conduct expected of UN Women personnel and will therefore undergo rigorous reference and background checks. (Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check.)

Note: Applicants must ensure that all sections of the application form, including the sections on education and employment history, are completed. If all sections are not completed the application may be disqualified from the recruitment and selection process.

title: Software engineer
description:
Purpose Of The Role

At Dis-Chem Life, we are building systems that protect lives, accelerate innovation, and drive digital transformation at scale. As our Software Engineer, you will design and build the core services, platforms, and APIs that power every product we deliver and every life we cover. This is not a role for the average engineer – we are looking for someone who blends elite backend architecture with craftsmanship, operational excellence, and a startup-hardened mindset. Your mission: to architect, implement, and operate secure, scalable, and high-performance backend systems that enable faster, safer, and smarter product delivery.

Role Summary

This role is responsible for designing, developing, and operating Dis-Chem Life’s backend platforms and services to enable rapid, reliable, and scalable software delivery. The Software Engineer will lead the implementation of domain-driven, cloud-native architectures; define and evolve service boundaries; and deliver high-quality APIs and data pipelines that underpin the resilience and efficiency of our technology landscape.

Key Responsibilities Backend Architecture and Development Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and high‑performing backend services and APIs. Lead the adoption of domain‑driven design, clean architecture, and SOLID principles. Implement robust data models and persistence strategies with strong consistency and performance characteristics. Build event‑driven and asynchronous workflows using messaging/streaming platforms. Establish API standards, versioning strategies, and documentation practices. Reliability, Performance and Operations Drive performance optimisation through profiling, caching, indexing, and query optimisation. Embed observability across services: structured logging, metrics, tracing, SLI/SLOs, and error budgets. Champion testing excellence: unit, property‑based, contract, integration, and load testing. Own production readiness: blue/green or canary releases, graceful degradation, and robust rollback paths. Partner with SRE/Dev Ops to ensure secure, automated deployments and operational excellence. Security and Compliance Implement secure coding practices and threat‑aware designs. Manage identity, auth, and access patterns (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, m TLS, fine‑grained authorisation). Ensure data governance and privacy controls aligned to regulatory and internal standards. Collaboration and Delivery Work closely with product and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical designs and iterative delivery plans. Mentor engineers, conduct code and design reviews, and raise the quality bar across the codebase. Drive continuous improvement of engineering practices, tooling, and standards. Technical Skills Strong proficiency in one or more backend languages and ecosystems (e.g., Java/Kotlin with Spring Boot, C#/. NET, Go, or Python/Fast API). Deep experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and building resilient, idempotent endpoints; exposure to g RPC or Graph QL. Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts: consistency, partitioning, resiliency patterns (circuit breakers, retries, backoff), eventual consistency. Data stores: relational databases (e.g., Postgre SQL, My SQL) and at least one No SQL store (e.g., Dynamo DB, Mongo DB, Redis); schema design, indexing, and migration strategies. Messaging and streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, SQS/SNS, Rabbit MQ) and event‑driven architecture. Testing: unit, integration, contract (e.g., Pact), end‑to‑end, and performance/load testing. Observability: metrics, logs, and tracing (e.g., Open Telemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Cloud Watch/X‑Ray). Secure development practices, secrets management, and API security patterns. Serve as the on-site point of contact for volunteers during scheduled activities, ensuring smooth setup, facilitation, and clean-up

Facilitate or co-facilitate activities directly when volunteer coverage is unavailable

Promote activities to residents and encourage participation, tailoring outreach to residents' interests and needs

Maintain attendance records and basic participation data for activities offered

Ensure all activities comply with facility safety protocols, licensing requirements, and any applicable NC Medicaid or residential program standards

Coordinate necessary supplies, materials, and space setup/breakdown for each activity

Communicate regularly with residential staff and leadership regarding the enrichment calendar, resident engagement, and any volunteer-related needs or concerns

Conduct basic background/safety checks or coordinate with HR for volunteer vetting, as required by agency policy

Maintain a welcoming, respectful, and inclusive environment for residents of varying backgrounds, faiths, and abilities

Perform other duties as assigned to support resident engagement and quality of life

Work Environment

Work is performed primarily in a 24-hour residential substance use disorder and behavioral health treatment environment. Activities may occur in resident common areas, meeting rooms, outdoor spaces, community locations, faith-based settings, or other approved environments.

Regular interaction with residents, volunteers, clinical staff, residential staff, community partners, instructors, and visitors is expected. The position works primarily during evenings and weekends and requires flexibility based on resident programming needs and volunteer availability.

Disclaimer

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed by employees assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Duties and responsibilities may change based on organizational needs.

title: Operations Associate
description:
Operations Associate | Purview

About HealthMark Group & Purview

HealthMark Group is a leading provider of health IT solutions for healthcare providers across the country. By leveraging technology to reimagine the business of healthcare, HealthMark transforms administrative processes into seamless digital solutions. HealthMark Group was founded in 2006 with corporate headquarters in Dallas, TX and has been named to both the Dallas 100 and the Inc. 5000 for multiple years in a row as one of the fastest growing companies in the region and in the country.

Purview is a software-driven healthcare company committed to increasing health equity and improving patient outcomes by enabling secure, flexible, and scalable access to medical images and records. Its suite of products, including Horos, Purview Image, and Expert View, empowers physicians, radiologists, veterinarians, and other providers around the world to view, share, and analyze medical imaging data. Acquired by HealthMark Group, Purview now operates as a dedicated business unit, maintaining its mission-driven culture and product focus while benefiting from HealthMark’s scale and operational infrastructure.

We are seeking an organized, proactive Operations Associate to lead customer-facing implementation, deployment, and cross-functional initiatives for Purview. This role will focus on project planning, coordination, communication, risk management, and successful delivery across customers, internal teams, partners, and third-party vendors.

Role Overview

As a Operations Associate at Purview, you will own projects from initial discovery through planning, execution, launch, and closeout. You will establish clear scope and success criteria, maintain schedules and documentation, coordinate stakeholders, identify and manage risks, and keep teams aligned throughout the project lifecycle.

The Operations Associate will serve as a central point of coordination for customers and internal teams, including Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, and Sales. Success in this role requires strong organization, sound judgment, clear communication, customer focus, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving healthcare technology environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Use a formal project-management lifecycle—initiating, planning, executing, monitoring and controlling, and closing—to manage customer implementation, deployment, internal improvement, and cross-functional initiatives from start to finish.
  • Define project scope, requirements, deliverables, milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, risks, timelines, resources, and success criteria in partnership with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Perform technical assessments and planning activities, including evaluation of customer network, PACS, EMR, imaging archive, configuration, integration approach, dependencies, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams, customers, internal Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, Sales, and third-party vendors to ensure alignment, integration success, action-item ownership, and on-time delivery.
  • Manage project risks, issues, changes, escalations, and change requests, bringing the right stakeholders together to resolve blockers, protect delivery timelines, and maintain customer confidence.
  • Provide customer-facing technical leadership and clear, timely, audience-appropriate communication by clarifying integration scope, reporting status, managing issues, and keeping customers, leadership, project teams, and partners informed.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable medical imaging and healthcare interoperability standards, including DICOM, HL7, FHIR, or other requirements, while supporting secure image and data handling and proper workflow integration with EMRs, RIS, PACS, and related systems.
  • Manage data migration projects, including transfer of large imaging archives, metadata, and configuration data, while ensuring data integrity, minimal downtime, appropriate documentation, validation, backups, and launch readiness.
  • Deliver training, documentation, and post-go-live support, including configuration guides, integration specifications, runbooks, user training coordination, troubleshooting support, and handoff to the support team.
  • Handle multiple concurrent projects by prioritizing, re-scheduling, balancing deliverables, refining templates and processes, documenting lessons learned, and adapting to changing customer requirements, business needs, or technical challenges.

Qualifications & Skills

Required / Core

  • Ability to manage both external customer projects and Purview product implementations, as well as internal operational, cross-functional, and process-improvement initiatives.
  • Project management experience in software implementation, healthcare technology, SaaS, technical operations, or another delivery environment involving external customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage the full project lifecycle for customer-facing and internal initiatives, including scope, schedules, dependencies, risks, issues, changes, deliverables, and stakeholder communication.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical information for customers, leaders, internal teams, and cross-functional partners.
  • Strong organization, planning, prioritization, facilitation, documentation, and follow-through skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent external and internal projects while maintaining accuracy, urgency, and attention to detail in a changing environment.
  • Customer-focused, accountable, and collaborative approach to problem solving, issue resolution, and decision making.
  • Comfort partnering with Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, Sales, customers, and vendors to coordinate technical work without being the sole subject-matter expert.

Preferred

  • Formal project management training or certification, such as PMP, CAPM, PMI coursework, or an equivalent credential.
  • Experience managing technical integration, software deployment, API integration, configuration, or data migration projects.
  • Experience coordinating technical discovery, requirements gathering, environment assessment, dependency tracking, and acceptance criteria.
  • Working knowledge of medical imaging systems and workflows, including DICOM, PACS, VNA, RIS, image sharing, storage, and archive migration.
  • Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards and secure healthcare data workflows, including HL7, FHIR, IHE, EMR integration, and related privacy or compliance considerations.
  • Experience with imaging, EMR, veterinary practice, or archive platforms such as Epic, Ambra, ezyVet, PACS, VNAs, or similar systems.
  • Experience coordinating network configuration, secure data transfer, cloud-based imaging systems, archive systems, or large imaging dataset migrations.
  • Ability to support implementation documentation, integration specifications, runbooks, troubleshooting, data validation, go-live readiness, and post-launch handoff.
  • Prior experience in healthcare, radiology IT, medical imaging, health IT, or another regulated technology environment.

Why Join HealthMark Group & Purview

  • Contribute to a mission-driven organization improving access to medical information and supporting better patient care.
  • Work with Purview Image and Expert View on real-world initiatives that support clinicians, radiologists, veterinarians, and other providers.
  • Build broad cross-functional experience across project delivery, customer engagement, healthcare technology, and operational improvement.
  • Engage directly with customers and partners while making a visible impact on successful adoption and long-term value.
  • Collaborate with a dedicated team where ownership, initiative, and thoughtful project leadership are valued.

title: Electrical Engineering Associate, Energy Storage
description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.


Position Summary:

The Electrical Engineering Associate, Energy Storage supports Redwood's next-generation Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) program by performing hands-on technical tasks. This is a fully on-site role at 2800 Lockheed Way, Carson City. You will perform a broad variety of hands-on technical tasks in support of Redwood’s next-generation Battery Energy Storage System (BESS). In this role, you will primarily work with engineers to create sophisticated printed circuit board (PCB) designs using software tools and use your technical abilities to build, test, and fix PCB prototypes. Additional responsibilities include management of an electronics laboratory, installing and running tests on power equipment in the field, assisting mechanical engineers, and a variety of miscellaneous technical tasks.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Create and manage a library of electronics component symbols and footprints for PCB designs using Altium CAD software.
  • Hand-soldering and rework of PCB components, including fine-pitch surface mount parts with rework station/hot air, and connectors; cable harness assembly.
  • Running functional/bring-up tests on new board revisions, flashing firmware, verifying power rails. Bench-level troubleshooting of prototype and production boards down to component level.
  • Managing an electronics lab, including lab equipment and tool purchasing, organization, maintenance, and cleaning. Keeping the lab organized, stocked with consumables and ESD/safety compliant.
  • Setting up electrical test equipment for field testing support at outdoor project sites.

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • Degree in Electronics Engineering Technology, Electrical Engineering Technology, or related field (or equivalent military/technical training)
  • Relevant coursework or certification in electronics fundamentals, circuit theory, or digital/analog systems
  • Ability to read schematics, datasheets, and basic PCB layouts
  • Familiarity with hand soldering (THT and SMT) to IPC-A-610 or IPC J-STD-001 workmanship standards, or willingness to be certified
  • Basic proficiency with lab equipment: multimeter, oscilloscope, bench power supply, function generator
  • Comfortable with basic hand tools and ESD-safe handling practices, as well as machinery and power equipment
  • Exposure to CAD/EDA tools (Altium, KiCad, Eagle) a plus, even from coursework or personal projects

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

We collect personal information (PI) from you in connection with your application for employment with Redwood Materials, including the following categories of PI: identifiers, personal records, professional or employment information, and inferences drawn from your PI. We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. If you have additional privacy-related questions, please contact us at privacy@redwoodmaterials.com.

As we grow to expand our impact to protect 500 million people from violence, we are seeking a Sr. Officer, U.S. Philanthropy to cultivate deep, trust-based relationships with existing donors to inspire continued and increased giving, while also identifying and engaging new supporters through strategic networking and regional connections. title: Børne- og ungerådgivere til Familieteamet i Center for Børne- og Ungerådgivning
description:
Drømmer du om at blive, eller er du allerede, en virkelig dygtig myndighedsrådgiver? Og ser du samtidig fællesskaber og dialog som en naturlig del af dit virke? Så kan du være lige præcis den, vi leder efter.

Hos os får du mulighed for at bruge din faglighed dér, hvor den virkelig betyder noget og samtidig være en del af en arbejdsplads med tæt kollegafælleskab og høj medarbejdertrivsel.

Vi har fået tildelt flere ressourcer til myndighedsområdet for at forfølge vores mål om et sagstal på ca. 25 sager pr rådgiver samt for at styrke myndighedsarbejdet for udsatte børn og unge.

Derfor søger vi nu tre børne- og ungerådgivere til faste stillinger 37 timer ugentligt.

Dine vigtigste opgaver
Som børne- og ungerådgiver i Familieteamet får du ansvar for myndighedsopgaver efter barnets lov. Du skal være med til at sikre, at det i samarbejde med børn, unge og familier bliver afklaret, hvilken støtte familien og barnet eller den unge har brug for.

Arbejdet indebærer blandt andet:

  • Råd og vejledning til børn, unge og deres forældre
  • At du foretager screeninger, afdækninger og børnefaglige undersøgelser
  • At du behandler ansøgninger og foretager opfølgninger vedrørende handicapkompenserende ydelser som fx kompensationsydelser, tabt arbejdsfortjeneste og aflastning
  • At du iværksætter og følger op på støttende indsatser, hvor det sikres, at målene for barnets eller den unges udvikling opnås
  • Deltagelse i møder med børn, forældre og samarbejdspartnere, herunder at du er mødeleder.
  • Skriftlig dokumentation af sagens processer og afgørelser.

Dine kompetencer

  • Er uddannet socialrådgiver eller socialformidler og brænder for arbejdet med børn, unge og deres familier
  • Har mod på at arbejde med både sociale- og handicaprelaterede problemstillinger
  • Er empatisk og løsningsfokuseret i mødet med både borgere, samarbejdspartnere og kolleger
  • Er socialfagligt ambitiøs og vil bidrage til vores fortsatte udvikling i afdelingen
  • Arbejder, eller gerne vil lære, at arbejde tværfagligt og tværsektorielt
  • Gerne vil arbejde på, at alle børn skal være en del af almene fællesskaber
  • Er en holdspiller med fokus på, hvordan du kan bidrage til afdelingen
  • Har flair for den administrative del af arbejdet og kan arbejde systematisk. Vi arbejder i DUBU.
  • Har god energi og en masse gåpåmod.

Det får du hos os

  • En ambitiøs, alsidig og kreativ arbejdsplads
  • Løbende kompetenceudvikling fx via fælles faglige dage med ekstern underviser
  • Gode kolleger, der glæder sig til at byde dig velkommen
  • En introduktionsplan, mentorordning og oplæring efter behov
  • Et tæt samarbejde med ledelsen
  • En travl og spændende hverdag, hvor der også er højt humør og sjove fælles aktiviteter
  • Løbende ekstern supervision
  • Fleksibel arbejdstid med mulighed for hjemmearbejde
  • En virkelig god kantine
  • Trænings- og badefaciliteter.

Hvem er vi
I Ballerup Kommune har vi en Børne- og Ungepolitik, som danner grundlag for vores daglige arbejde. Ord som fællesskab, uddannelse og fritidsliv er gennemgående i det nære arbejde og de faglige vurderinger.

Vi er ambitiøse og vi sætter barren højt i arbejdet med børn, unge og familier. Vi tror på, at hvis vi er i tæt dialog med dem det handler om og tager udgangspunkt i deres ønsker og behov, så skaber vi de bedste forudsætninger for, at børnene og de unge kan udvikle sig positivt. Vi har derfor også et stort fokus på inddragelse af børnene og de unge i deres egen sag, både i møderne med dem og i den skriftlige dokumentation.

Vi samarbejder tværfagligt for at finde løsninger sammen med børnene, de unge og familierne og lader ikke faglige og organisatoriske opdelinger bremse de gode løsninger. Ballerup Kommune arbejder med Sammenhængende Borgerforløb som metode på tværs af kommunen, hvori det tværfaglige samarbejde blandt andet foregår.

I Familieteamet arbejder vi i fem mindre distriktsteams, som hver består at 7-9 rådgivere tilkoblet to teamledere. Det har vi valgt for at sikre tættere kollegiale fællesskaber og mere nærværende ledelse.

Børne- og Ungerådgiverne i Familieteamet sidder med alle typer af sager og opgaverne spænder derfor bredt. Det har vi valgt for at forsøge at undgå unødige rådgiverskift i tråd med intentionerne i barnets lov, men også fordi vi tror på, at det er med til at skabe dygtige børne- og ungerådgivere.

Vil du vide mere
Hvis ovenstående har vakt din interesse, skal du ikke tøve med at ringe til os. Vi vil glæde os til at høre fra dig.

Du kan få mere at vide om stillingerne ved at kontakte teamleder Louise Gabrielsen på telefon 2384 5347 eller teamleder Henrik Hjortlund på telefon 2144 3372. Du må gerne sende en sms, så finder vi sammen et tidspunkt vi kan tales ved.

Læs mere om Ballerup Kommune som arbejdsplads på

Ansættelsesproces og løn
Ansættelsesdatoen er den 1. januar 2027.

Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler den 19. november 2026.

Stillingerne er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer og er faste stillinger.

Ansøgningsfrist: den 11. november 2026.

Vi tilbyder løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter overenskomst for socialrådgivere og socialformidlere i kommunerne.

Ansættelse sker efter principperne om lokal løndannelse og efter aftale med den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Lønintervallet for stillingen er 36.020 kr. – 49.178 kr. pr. måned uden pension ved fuldtidsansættelse (37 timer ugentligt).

Den endelige løn fastsættes efter forhandling mellem arbejdsgiver og den faglige organisation, der har forhandlingsretten på det relevante overenskomstområde. Lønnen afhænger blandt andet af din uddannelse, dokumenterede anciennitet og kvalifikationer.

Vi indhenter straffe- og børneattester.

Ballerup Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Læs mere her.

Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke. Derfor opfordrer vi alle uanset køn, alder, handicap, religion, seksuel orientering eller etnisk baggrund til at søge job hos os.

Send din ansøgning online. Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor og vedhæft din ansøgning, CV og uddannelsesbevis.

Vi glæder os til at møde dig.

title: Senior Product Engineer
location: Albania, Andorra, Armenia, Austria, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Belgium, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Georgia, Germany, Greece, Holy See (Vatican City State), Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Italy, Kosovo, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Moldova, Monaco, Montenegro, Netherlands, North Macedonia, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Russian Federation, San Marino, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey, Ukraine, United Kingdom
description:
About us

Talkie builds AI Agents for healthcare. Our agents handle patient-clinic communication end-to-end over voice calls, web chat, and SMS, so patients get 24/7 access to care and busy practices never miss a conversation. Every month, our AI Agents handle close to a million real patient conversations across the US and Poland. Our customers include primary care and specialty practices, and hospitals.

The role

We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join our Platform team. You'll build the features that power our AI Agents, in the backend and the UI. Much of that work touches telephony, clinical systems such as EHRs, and LLMs.

You'll own features until they run in production. You research the problem and shape requirements with our CPO. You propose the interaction and UI, design the architecture, build it across the stack, ship it, and watch how it behaves with real patients on real calls. You'll work alongside other Engineers, take requests from our Customer Success and Conversation Design teams, and work with many people across the product organisation.

Our engineers work with many AI agents at once. One agent implements a feature, another reviews it, and a third digs through logs or researches an unfamiliar API. This role requires fluency in that way of working.

What you'll do

  • Own product features end-to-end. Research the problem, refine requirements with the CPO, propose the user interaction, and design a clean, usable UI. Then build it, ship it, and monitor it.

  • Build across the stack. You'll write backend services and APIs in TypeScript and Node.js, frontend in React, and AWS infrastructure as code.

  • Integrate LLMs into the product. Design how our agents use models and tools. Build evals that show whether a change made things better, and trade off quality, latency, and cost on purpose.

  • Integrate with outside systems. Our agents depend on SIP telephony and call routing, EHR systems, LLM providers, and other services.

  • Shape technical and architectural decisions. Take part in the team's design discussions, write and review technical proposals, and help set the direction of the platform. Keep it easy to change and maintain, and make sure it handles real-time calls efficiently.

  • Mentor other engineers. Review their designs and code, pair with them on hard problems, and help them grow, including in how they work with agents.

  • Turn open questions into plans. When a new problem or technology comes up, form a hypothesis, build a prototype, and measure it. Then come back with a list of trade-offs and a proposal the team can build on.

  • Keep production healthy. Monitor what you ship, cut alert noise, and find and fix performance bottlenecks.

AI-native development

This is how we work every day, and we expect you to help us improve it.

  • Orchestrate agents. You run several coding agents in parallel for implementation, code review, log and incident investigation, and research. You know how to direct them, check their output, and correct it.

  • Improve the codebase for agents. You know what makes a codebase easy for agents to work in, such as clear module boundaries, good agent instructions in AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, and fast feedback loops. You make ours better.

  • Build skills and agent workflows. You write and maintain reusable skills, commands, and workflows that encode how the team works, so agents get it right the first time.

  • Share what works. You teach the team effective agent workflows, and you know when not to trust the output.

Job requirements

We care less about years of experience and more about what you've shipped, owned, and learned.

Must have

  • Product ownership. You've shipped and owned a product or major features in production, end-to-end. When the path isn't clear, you find one.

  • Strong architectural experience. You build software that stays easy to change and maintain as it grows, and you can explain the trade-offs behind your decisions.

  • Fullstack TypeScript. You have solid hands-on experience with Node.js on the backend, React on the frontend, and MongoDB or another database.

  • Cloud and infrastructure as code. You have hands-on experience with AWS or another major cloud provider, and with IaC tools. We use Terraform and Pulumi.

  • AI-native development. Coding agents are your main way of working, as described above, and you can show us how you use them.

  • LLM integration in production. You've built LLM-powered features with evals, and made informed latency and cost trade-offs.

  • Healthcare compliance awareness. You understand what building software under SOC2 and HIPAA means in practice, and how it shapes decisions about data, access, and logging.

  • Product sense for UI. You can propose a user interaction and design a clean UI without a detailed mockup.

  • English. You speak and write English at C1 level or above. Most of our written work is in English, and our customers are in the US.

Nice to have

  • Telecom. You've worked with SIP, call routing, or VoIP. If you haven't, that's fine. When you hear "SIP integration", we want your reaction to be "I'll learn it", followed by a plan for a prototype.

  • EHR or other healthcare integrations. You've worked with clinical systems or other regulated domains with many integrations.

This role is not for you if...

  • You want detailed specs before you start.

  • You see coding agents as autocomplete, or as a fad.

  • You only want to work on one side of the stack.

  • "I've never done SIP" ends the conversation for you instead of starting a prototype.

  • You find it hard to judge when to debate a decision and when to build a quick prototype and measure it.

Your goals in this role

Short term, first 3 months

  • Learn how a patient call or chat travels through our platform end-to-end, across telephony, the AI Agent, LLMs, and the EHR.

  • Ship your first features end-to-end, from research through review with the CPO to production.

  • Take on production health. Reduce the number of alerts in our Slack monitoring channel and suggest performance improvements.

  • Make improvements to our codebase or agent workflows that the rest of the team adopts.

Longer term, first 12 months

  • Understand the core parts of the platform in depth and drive feature work across them.

  • Lead architectural decisions that improve the platform and make sure it handles real-time calls efficiently.

  • Mentor other engineers on the team, so your knowledge of the platform and of agent workflows spreads beyond you.

  • Become the person the team goes to for turning troubleshooting findings and internal issues into clear implementation plans. Those plans come with prototypes, trade-off lists, and walking skeletons that deliver value and that we can build on.

What we offer

  • Competitive pay with your choice of employment contract or B2B contract.

  • A role with real purpose. We're changing how patients access healthcare in the US and Poland.

  • Flexible working arrangements. Work remotely from anywhere in Europe, from the office, or hybrid.

  • Work equipment for both home and office, including a comfy chair.

  • Benefits include private medical care, a Multisport card, an annual offsite, and a training budget.

  • A structured onboarding, plus mentoring and support as you get into AI and conversation design.

  • Work on AI products that help real patients reach care.

What are we like as a company?

We are friendly, direct, curious, and ambitious. We value a growth mindset and treat failure as a chance to learn. Asking questions is the standard here, and we expect thorough investigation. When something's broken, we say so, propose a fix, and fix it. We also like to have fun. Dancing till the early hours, karaoke nights, board games, and team sports are a long-standing tradition at Talkie.

Our recruitment process

We want our recruitment process to be respectful and collaborative, so you can be yourself and get to know us. The whole process usually takes 2 to 4 weeks.

What to expect

  1. Intro call. A short intro of 10 to 15 minutes.

  2. First interview. A 30-minute online conversation about mutual fit.

title: Construction Project Manager
description:
Gordian is the leader in facility and construction cost data, software, and services for all phases of the building lifecycle. As the pioneer of Job Order Contracting (JOC), Gordian delivers innovative solutions including proprietary RSMeans data and Facility Intelligence tools. Our mission is to help customers maximize efficiency, optimize cost savings, and improve building quality – from planning and design to procurement, construction, and operations.

As a Project Manager at Gordian, you will play a critical role in overseeing the administrative and operational aspects of construction and facility-related projects. You will ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with customer specifications and company standards. This role requires strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills, along with a solid understanding of construction processes and project management best practices.

This role supports Gordian’s partnership with the The New York City Department of Education (DOE) and involves managing renovation and modernization projects across school buildings in all five boroughs of NYC. This is a full-time, on-site position.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Planning & Pre-Construction

  • Ensure all project prerequisites are completed, verified, and documented prior to construction start.
  • Assist in developing scopes of work, reviewing proposals, and confirming contract compliance.
  • Implement project procedures from identification through execution.
  • Perform constructability reviews during the design process and provide input to help fast-track projects.

Stakeholder Engagement & Meetings

  • Facilitate and lead key meetings, including:
    • Pre-Construction Meetings – Align scope, schedule, logistics, and safety protocols.
    • Progress Meetings – Review milestones, resolve issues, and maintain momentum.
    • Punch List Meetings – Conduct final walkthroughs to identify and close outstanding items.
  • Document and distribute meeting minutes to ensure transparency and accountability.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, contractors, and stakeholders.
  • Coordinate work with schools and SCA/DOE stakeholders to minimize disruption and ensure compliance.

Site Oversight & Quality Assurance

  • Conduct regular site visits to monitor progress, verify compliance, and ensure construction quality standards.
  • Identify and mitigate risks and delays through proactive site assessments and reporting.
  • Schedule and perform compliance inspections as required by SCA/DOE and NYC regulatory agencies.
  • Knowledge of General Construction, Mechanical and Electrical Systems, building products, construction details / design and relevant rules, regulations, and quality standards
  • Knowledge of Project estimating scheduling and cost control
  • Coordinate with plan examiners and agency representatives regarding code compliance and document requirements

Documentation & Communication

  • Review permit application documents for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with submission requirements
  • Review and manage comprehensive project documentation, including:
    • Project requirements
    • Schedule of values
    • Submittals and RFIs
    • Project schedules (preliminary, final, baseline updates)
    • Two-week look-aheads
    • Contractor pay applications
  • Compile and deliver final project binders for customer records.
  • Manage material take-offs from plans and specifications and review detailed construction line-item estimates and proposals.

Contract & Customer Compliance

  • Uphold customer-specific procedures and ensure alignment with contractual obligations and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide responsive support to resolve issues and maintain project continuity.
  • Review and process change orders; manage scope changes due to unforeseen conditions with proper documentation and approvals.
  • Understand compliance with NYC regulatory agencies (DOB, BEC, FDNY, DOT, DEP) for permitting, inspections, and closeout.
  • Familiar with DOB NOW and BISWEB filing systems required

Scheduling & Budget Management

  • Maintain detailed activity schedules to meet procurement and project timelines.
  • Monitor budgets and review contractor invoices in alignment with financial controls.

Risk & Safety Mitigation

  • Proactively identify potential risks and implement mitigation strategies to minimize delays, disruptions, and safety incidents.
  • Apply experience in safety and risk management to ensure compliance and maintain a secure project environment.

Change & Issue Management

  • Manage changes to project scope, schedule, or budget with proper documentation, stakeholder communication, and formal authorization.
  • Address and resolve issues or conflicts that arise during construction using negotiation and mediation skills to maintain project momentum.
  • Ensure all changes and issues are tracked, assessed for impact, and resolved efficiently to keep the project on track.

Training & Cross-Team Support

  • Train contractors on Gordian software and customer-specific procedures.
  • Support customers during contract bidding processes.
  • Facilitate communication between customers, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure alignment on goals and deliverables.

KEY SKILLS – The ideal candidate for this role will excel in the following areas.

  • Customer Obsessed – Builds strong relationships through clear communication and proactive support.
  • Collaboration – Works well with others, encourages teamwork, and values diverse input.
  • Organization – Skilled in managing project documentation and workflows with accuracy and efficiency.
  • Initiative – Takes ownership, anticipates needs, and acts without requiring direction.
  • Adaptability – Responds well to change, learns quickly, and embraces feedback.
  • Problem Solving – Thinks creatively, explores options, and resolves issues effectively.
  • Professionalism – Maintains confidentiality and always acts with integrity.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Proficient in reading construction plans and specifications; experienced in comprehensive price proposal reviews.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or related field; equivalent work experience may be considered.
  • 3-5+ years in construction procurement, management, or general contracting, with experience in both horizontal and vertical construction preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial public construction operations, pricing, contracting, scope development, and estimating.
  • Strong knowledge of NYC regulatory agency requirements for project filing, permitting, inspection, and closeout (DOB, FDNY, DOT, DEP).
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills; capable of managing multiple concurrent projects in both planning and execution phases.
  • Exceptional communication, customer service, and teamwork skills; flexible, strategic, results-driven, and highly organized.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel); able to create custom tracking tools and reports.
  • Skilled in construction management platforms such as Procore and MS Project.
  • Experience with Job Order Contracting (JOC) or IDIQ preferred, and a solid understanding of public procurement and delivery methods.
  • Experience with Smartsheet work management software is a plus but not required.
  • Ability to travel 100% locally within the five boroughs and work primarily on-site at the NYC Long Island City office and DOE project locations.

title: Field Specialist - Tubular Running Services
description:

FINANCIAL

Experience & Education

REQUIRED

· High School Diploma

PREFERRED

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

REQUIRED

· Fundamentals of Mechanics, Electricity, Electronics, Pneumatics, and/or Hydraulics

· Mathematics

· Basic Physics and Chemistry

· Computer fundamentals

· Critical thinking, active learning & listening, complex problem solving

· Good reading and writing skills, strong judgment, and decision-making to be in line with policies & procedures

· Time management

· Quality Control Analysis to ensure the product meets required standards

· Service Orientation

· Physically capable to undertake the tasks required to perform the role

· Information & task ordering & ability to identify when a problem may occur and, where possible, to understand the solution

title: Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel?
company: Havarikommissionen for Civil Luftfart og Jernbane
description:
Hos Havarikommissionen for Civil Luftfart og Jernbane søger vi en engageret teknisk undersøger med stærk luftfartsfaglig indsigt, der vil være med til at forebygge flyvehavarier og alvorlige hændelser.

Teamet, som du bliver en del af

Havarikommissionen for Civil Luftfart og Jernbane er en uafhængig statslig myndighed under By-, Land- og Transportministeriet, der har til opgave at undersøge havarier, ulykker og alvorlige hændelser inden for både civil luftfart og jernbane – med det klare formål at forebygge fremtidige begivenheder.

Vi holder til i Ringsted og består af et lille, specialiseret team på 11 medarbejdere (administration, jernbane og luftfart). I din dagligdag bliver du en del af Luftfartsenheden med fem undersøgere foruden dig, hvoraf én fungerer som faglig leder.

Som luftfartsundersøger får du en enestående mulighed for at arbejde i spændingsfeltet mellem avanceret teknik, dybdegående analyse og internationalt samarbejde. Du kommer til at stå i front, når det handler om at skabe indsigt, dele viden og styrke flysikkerheden – både herhjemme og ude i verden.

Vi tilbyder et meningsfuldt og samfundsvigtigt job, hvor du får ansvar, faglig variation og mulighed for at udvikle dig i et stærkt og engageret miljø.

Et job med både dybde og variation

Hvis du trives med en hverdag, hvor komplekse og udfordrende opgaver går hånd i hånd med de mere rutineprægede, så læs endelig videre.

Som luftfartsundersøger bliver du en central del af arbejdet med at undersøge begivenheder inden for kommerciel luftfart og privatflyvning. Opgaverne kan foregå i Danmark, Grønland, Færøerne og udlandet. På havari- eller hændelsesstedet får du en vigtig rolle i at skabe overblik, indsamle relevant information og samarbejde med de involverede parter, hvilket typisk omfatte politi og redningsberedskab, luftfartsselskaber, operatører, privatpiloter, flyproducenter og medier.

Du kommer både til at lede og deltage aktivt i undersøgelsesarbejdet, som kan føre dig vidt omkring – geografisk og fagligt. Det giver dig en bred kontaktflade, både nationalt og internationalt. Dit arbejde har ét klart formål: at forebygge fremtidige begivenheder gennem grundige analyser og målrettede sikkerhedsanbefalinger til myndigheder, producenter og operatører i luftfartsbranchen.

Resultaterne af dine undersøgelser formidles i rapporter og redegørelser, så erfaringerne kan komme hele branchen og offentligheden til gavn.

Ud over selve undersøgelsesarbejdet vil du også bidrage til vores løbende opgaver, herunder samarbejdet i det europæiske netværk af havarikommissioner og vores øvrige internationale forpligtelser.

Sådan ser vi vores nye kollega

Vi søger en erfaren teknisk undersøger med luftfartsteknisk baggrund.

Har du en stærk teknisk eller ingeniørfaglig baggrund og erfaring fra luftfartsbranchen? Så er du måske den tekniske undersøger, vi søger. Vi leder efter en profil med bred teknisk forståelse af luftfartøjer og deres systemer, herunder fly med fly-by-wire, analoge og digitale cockpits samt stempelmotorer, turboprop- og turbofanmotorer. Du skal kunne analysere komplekse tekniske problemstillinger og omsætte tekniske data til undersøgelsesresultater. Kendskab til luftfartens tekniske og operative regelværk er en fordel, ligesom erfaring med droneoperationer, projektledelse og digital behandling af store datamængder vil være en styrke. Du trives i et mindre team, hvor samarbejde vægtes højt, og hvor den interne arbejdstone er uformel, åben og præget af gensidig respekt.

Du skal kunne holde hovedet koldt, også når det gælder.

Undersøgelsesarbejdet kræver, at du kan træffe beslutninger under pres og bevare overblikket i komplekse situationer. Du skal kunne samarbejde med mange forskellige aktører og være både analytisk, kreativ og systematisk i din tilgang. Det er vigtigt, at du kommunikerer klart og præcist – både på dansk og engelsk, i skrift og tale.

Rekrutteringsproces og ansættelse

Sådan foregår processen:

Vi forventer at afholde første samtalerunde d. 19. november og anden samtalerunde 24. november 2026. Som en del af udvælgelsen vil du blive bedt om at gennemføre både en personlighedstest og en skriftlig opgave inden anden samtalerunde.

Ansættelse og introduktion

Stillingen ønskes besat pr. 1. januar 2027 eller snarest derefter. Som en del af din introduktion til jobbet skal du deltage i et treugers grundkursus i havariundersøgelser på Cranfield University i England, som finder sted fra den 11. til den 29. januar 2027.

Ansættelsen sker i henhold til gældende cirkulære om organisationsaftale for Visse specialister og ledere på By-, Land- og Transportsministeriets område (Perst.nr. 055-26). Når du har gennemført grunduddannelsen og den efterfølgende oplæring, vil du indgå i en rådighedstjeneste, som honoreres med et tillæg.

Det er en forudsætning, at du har kørekort til personbil og kan sikkerhedsgodkendes til niveauet "Hemmeligt" i henhold til Statens Sikkerhedscirkulære.

Sådan søger du

Send din ansøgning, CV og evt. relevante bilag senest den 9. november 2026 til HR@havarikommissionen.dk. Angiv “Ansøgning” i emnefeltet.

title: Vice President of Product, AI & Product Office - Optum Health
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

The Vice President of Product, AI & Product Office owns the office's hardest and most ambiguous product bets, helping the Chief AI & Product Officer (CAIPO) drive Optum Health's enterprise AI-enabled product strategy, Agenix solutions portfolio and product capability agenda. Serving as strategist, builder and owner of the outcome, this role defines the problem with the people who do the work, decides what gets built and why and takes each product from first prototype through deployment and measurement.

This individual is accountable for measurable enterprise value: whether what shipped changed care for patients and care teams, whether it did so appropriately and whether it earns the return required to scale. The VP of Product keeps the work focused on the smallest version that can prove or disprove a bet, and brings clinical, operational, technology and governance partners into one team rather than a chain of handoffs.

This is a job for a builder. The team is just starting, and you will help build it and shape how it innovates, at the highest level. The office is small today, and that is by design: its leverage is the enterprise AI investment it drives across Optum Health. You will write, prototype and analyze with AI tools every day, and you will be where care is delivered, not only in meetings about it.

The AI & Product Office is building a small, cross-functional product team: product management, engineering, product design, service design, deployment and clinical, working alongside care team members from each local market team. The team embeds with a local Optum Health market team to find problems with the people who do the work, then design, build, deploy and measure the products that fix them. What the team learns in the first market is written down as the method for the next one.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely * from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

Primary Responsibilities:

Problem Definition & Discovery

  • Embed with local market teams in primary care, specialty, home and community and virtual settings to understand how care is delivered, and turn what you observe into written problem statements ranked by the people who do the work

  • Define, before build begins, the smallest version of a product that can prove or disprove the bet, the outcome measure that will decide it and the business case it must meet to scale

  • Partner with care team members as design partners from the first conversation, not as reviewers at the end

  • Determine which problems belong to a single market and which belong to the enterprise, and shape each product accordingly

Build & Delivery

  • Own the roadmap and backlog for your products, making tradeoffs across scope, speed, risk, and cost and write each decision down with its reasoning and what would change it

  • Run the work as one team rather than a chain of handoffs, with cycle time measured in weeks

  • Work with the team's engineers and with Optum Health engineering teams: set direction, write the specifications and evaluations the build is held to and review what ships

  • Build prototypes, analyze AI coding and agent tools and continuously improve them

  • Partner with finance, technology, data, security, legal, privacy, compliance, care teams and other stakeholders to deliver products that are responsible, secure and enterprise-ready, including through Optum Health's AI review and governance process

  • Own product decision rights across the office's portfolio of bets: what to start, stop, and scale, with the evidence for each

Measurement & Value Realization

  • Define, with clinical and governance partners, what an AI feature must get right, how it is measured, the bar it must clear before it reaches users and the bar it must clear before it takes on more autonomy

  • Establish baselines before launch for operational, clinical and financial outcomes, such as access, time to care and cost, so the change can be attributed

  • Measure whether each patient got the right care, not only whether a proxy metric moved

  • Report what changed since the last period, including results that show something did not work, and turn results into decisions to stop, change, or scale

  • Build the value case for scaling each product, and partner with finance to validate it

  • Represent the office's product bets to Optum Health executives and market leaders, with the evidence for and against each

Adoption & Scale

  • Develop change management and adoption plans with the deployment manager, so the people affected understand the purpose, impact, readiness requirements and expected value of each product

  • Write down what the team learns each week so it is reviewed on cadence and turned into decisions

  • Hand proven products to scaled delivery teams, and write the playbook so the next team can stand up the same product from what is written down, without you

  • Raise the AI fluency of the market teams you work with, helping the people closest to the work use and build with AI safely

  • Set the standard for product practice across the office: how problems are written, how bets are sized, and how results are reported, and hold your own work to it first

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including senior product roles, shipping software products used by operational, clinical or frontline users

  • 10+ years of experience in the healthcare industry and/or within a large, complex, matrixed organization

  • 10+ years of demonstrated business acumen: builds a business case, defines metrics, writes SQL or equivalent and reads a rollout result without an analyst in the room

  • Prior executive level experience having shipped an AI, machine learning or large language model feature to production and measured what it changed

  • Previous experience using AI tools in your work

  • Formally built with AI tools: an agent, automation or large language model tool you designed, built and ran

  • Able to work at the enterprise level and at a single market's level, and to tell which one a given decision belongs to

  • Has shipped products with engineering teams both inside and beyond their own team

  • Exceptional communication skills, including with executive-level audiences; solid writing: decisions, findings, and disagreements in this office are written down, so the writing is the work

  • Proven ability to build cross-functional relationships at all levels of the organization and lead toward shared goals without formal authority

  • Working proficiency in the tools this office builds with: GitHub and AI coding and agent tools, alongside the analytics and presentation tools executives use

  • Works as a senior individual contributor: owns hard problems end to end, working across functions to deliver them

  • Has owned product strategy for a portfolio or a major product line and taken it to executives for decision

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with care delivery, care coordination, patient access, or scheduling products

  • Experience with electronic health record integration (Epic, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks) and healthcare data standards such as FHIR and HL7

  • Experience taking an AI capability through an enterprise governance or review process in healthcare

  • Experience building a zero-to-one product inside a large organization, or at an early-stage company

  • Familiarity with value-based care and how care patterns affect cost and quality

*All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy.

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $200,400 to $343,500 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. Together, we are shaping the future of healthcare by harnessing technology and innovation to make care simpler to navigate, more affordable and more connected for the people we serve. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, valued, heard and respected, empowering people to bring their authentic selves to work and strengthening our collective impact through diverse talents, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

title: Senior Shopify Developer

Application Development & Maintenance

  • Dedicate a significant portion of time to new app development alongside the maintenance and enhancement of existing applications
  • Write clean, tested, and documented code while submitting clear pull requests for team collaboration

Technical Strategy & Platform Management

title: Kaqchikel (Mayan) Language Expert - AI Trainer
description:
Are you a Kaqchikel language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful tools for communication, education, and cultural preservation. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can accurately capture Kaqchikel vocabulary, grammar, dialectical variations, and cultural context—helping preserve Mayan knowledge and support authentic linguistic interactions. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for Kaqchikel language specialists who live and breathe regional dialects, phonetics, syntax, idiomatic expressions, oral traditions, and cultural references. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like contextual interpretation, tone and meaning, dialectical distinctions, semantic accuracy, and cultural nuance—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model in Kaqchikel across a wide range of topics, verify linguistic accuracy and cultural relevance, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A Master's degree in Linguistics, Indigenous Studies, Translation, or a related field is ideal; professional experience in teaching, translation, language documentation, or community work signals fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your Kaqchikel expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.
