  • Create, modify and optimize MSI packages and MST transforms from vendor installers or legacy installations.
  • Convert standard .exe installers and legacy installations into clean, silent-install MSI packages using capture tools such as Repackager.
  • Write custom actions in PowerShell and VBScript to handle complex configuration or registry changes.
  • Debug installation errors, analyze log files, resolve file and registry conflicts, and test packages on clean virtual machines.
  • Edit and validate MSI databases at the table level in tools like AdminStudio to clear Internal Consistency Errors (ICEs).

Quest KACE SMA Administration

  • Manage day-to-day operation, updates and maintenance of virtual and physical Quest KACE SMA appliances.
  • Manage the KACE Agent across network-connected devices through its full lifecycle, from deployment to troubleshooting.
  • Package, test and remotely deploy applications and scripts (KScripts, PowerShell, VBScript or Shell).
  • Design “Verify” and “Remediation” logic that automatically fixes endpoint compliance issues.
  • Run discovery scans to inventory hardware, network peripherals and software.
  • Use the software catalog to track application usage, reconcile licenses and produce compliance audits.
  • Build and manage Smart Labels with advanced filtering and LDAP queries to target updates at specific user groups, offices or device types.
  • Design custom SQL and wizard-generated reports on hardware lifecycles, patch levels and software compliance.
  • Configure, maintain and improve KACE Service Desk ticketing workflows, queues and knowledge bases.

HCL BigFix Administration

  • Maintain BigFix architecture, including core servers, relays and database components.
  • Monitor system health and tune the relay hierarchy for efficient bandwidth use.
  • Troubleshoot agent connectivity and quickly resolve deployment failures.
  • Write and test Fixlets and tasks for custom software deployments.
  • Manage third-party application updates to minimize security vulnerabilities.
  • Produce thorough compliance reports for leadership and audit teams.

Collaboration Tools

  • Manage the IT Services SharePoint site, including document libraries, lists, metadata columns and item-level permissions.
  • Manage the Power Automate workflows behind internal IT processes.
  • Connect SharePoint and Power Automate to Power Apps and external REST APIs.
  • Monitor flow run histories and fix integration errors.

Security and Compliance

  • Monitor Security Operations Center (SOC) Mitigation Action Requirement (MAR) announcements and remediate vulnerabilities as required.
  • Run daily system and patch compliance checks to keep systems current on critical security patches.
  • Attend bi-weekly BigFix meetings to stay ahead of upcoming changes.

Software Engineering and Team Leadership

  • Troubleshoot production problems with software applications.
  • Research, test, build and coordinate the integration or conversion of new products based on client requirements.
  • Design new software products or major improvements to existing ones.
  • Solve systems integration, compatibility and multi-platform problems.
  • Work with project teams and end users to define application requirements, and analyze the feasibility of potential future projects for management.
  • Help evaluate and recommend application software packages and integration and testing tools.
  • Resolve software problems and respond to suggestions for improvements.
  • Assign, direct and review the work of other developers on the team.
  • Help write software user manuals.

Required Skills:

  • 5+ years of dedicated Windows application packaging and software distribution, with proficiency in Flexera AdminStudio
  • 3+ years of PowerShell and VBScript
  • 3+ years of web application development and maintenance
  • 3+ years building and maintaining Power Automate workflows
  • 3+ years of hands-on administration in the Quest KACE SMA (K1000) Administrator Console, along with BigFix administration experience
  • Deep administrative understanding of Windows Server and client platforms, Active Directory and Group Policy
  • Core networking knowledge, including DHCP, DNS and TCP/IP
  • Highly proficient in writing PowerShell, VBScript or Bash scripts to support custom KScripts in KACE
  • Skilled at writing custom Relevance queries for targeting and filtering, and creating BigFix Action Scripts for automation and configuration
  • Basic knowledge of MS SQL Server administration as it relates to BigFix
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a disciplined approach to change management
  • Ability to independently manage and prioritize your own and your team’s workloads
  • Excellent customer service, verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate at every level of the organization

Preferred Skills:

  • Advanced expertise using AdminStudio for complex application packaging
  • Hands-on experience optimizing Quest KACE SMA and HCL BigFix at the enterprise level
  • Track record of troubleshooting complex application errors in legacy and modern Windows environments
  • Hands-on experience configuring SharePoint Online and Microsoft Power Automate
  • Excellent technical documentation skills

title: Associate, Asset-Backed Securitization

The Associate will work with ABS team members in support of non-mortgage securitization origination, with a focus on execution of asset-backed securitization loan facilities. The Associate will report to the Head of ABS and the role will be based in Stamford, CT.

Responsibilities include:

  • Manage process required for execution of material ABSL transaction amendments and participate in ABSL portfolio reviews and credit meetings.
  • Present internal business and credit partners a summary of client’s business, the transaction structure, key risks and cash flow stress scenarios
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with credit and portfolio management partners as well as related sector focused investment banking colleagues.
  • Establish relationship and work with external parties including clients, lawyers, and rating agencies

Experience

  • 3-5 years of asset-backed securitization lending and Term ABS experience at a commercial or investment bank
  • Advanced analytical, securitization loan structuring, underwriting, credit, and presentation skills
  • Experience reviewing and summarizing deal documentation
  • Experience coordinating communication with lawyers, clients and other external parties to structure and execute transactions
  • Familiarity with securitization legal documents for revolving ABSL facilities backed by traditional and esoteric assets classes
  • Knowledge of the Term ABS market and transactions backed by traditional and esoteric assets. Familiarity with Digital Infrastructure Term ABS a plus
  • Strong PC Proficiency, Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word and PowerPoint), Bloomberg and Credit Research Tools
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to coordinate multiple projects and satisfy deadlines
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time management skills required

Education/ Licenses

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or Economics
  • FINRA Licensing (Series 79 and/or 7 and 63) preferred

Hours and Work Schedule

Hours per Week: 40+

Work Schedule: Monday - Friday

Pay Transparency

The salary range for this position is $125,000 to $175,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the budget, work location, and relevant skills and experience. ​

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. title: Principal Software Engineer in Test  — C#.NET Distributed Systems
description:
Principal Software Engineer in Test — C#.NET Distributed Systems

Hyderabad, India | Hybrid — 3 days onsite

Role Overview

Nasuni is expanding the DryvIQ engineering team in Hyderabad. DryvIQ brings intelligent content discovery, classification, sensitivity detection, and policy-driven governance to enterprise unstructured data across cloud and on-premises repositories.

We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer in Test (SDET) to lead the evolution of test automation architecture and engineering quality across Nasuni's DryvIQ Kubernetes-based distributed application environment.

This is a hands-on principal engineering role with C#/.NET as the primary automation development stack. You will own critical architectural decisions, modernize and scale established automation frameworks, and establish engineering practices that improve reliability, testability, and release confidence across teams.

We're looking for someone who can combine deep software engineering expertise with sound technical judgment and the ability to influence others. You do not need to have built an automation framework from scratch. What matters is demonstrated ownership of complex automation systems and measurable improvements to their architecture, scalability, and effectiveness.

What You'll Do

  • Own the technical direction and architecture of established C#/.NET automation frameworks, improving scalability, reliability, maintainability, and execution efficiency.
  • Design and implement reusable test libraries, API clients, fixtures, test-data capabilities, diagnostics, and shared automation infrastructure.
  • Define risk-based testing strategies across APIs, microservices, asynchronous processing, integrations, system workflows, and end-to-end scenarios.
  • Establish automated validation for Kubernetes-based distributed applications, including deployments, upgrades, service dependencies, recovery, concurrency, and failure scenarios.
  • Lead test architecture reviews and influence product designs to improve observability, testability, and defect prevention.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to strengthen CI/CD quality gates, execution parallelism, environment reliability, and actionable release feedback.
  • Lead root-cause investigations of difficult cross-system failures using logs, metrics, traces, Kubernetes evidence, and application behavior.
  • Drive improvements in flaky-test reduction, coverage of critical product risks, test execution performance, and diagnostic effectiveness.
  • Establish reusable engineering patterns and help other teams adopt them through code reviews, pairing, technical guidance, and collaboration.
  • Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test design, code development, debugging, and analysis, independently validating correctness, security, and suitability.
  • Develop robust validation approaches for AI-enabled or non-deterministic product behavior, where applicable.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • 9+ years overall Software Engineering Experience with a a focus on QA Automation and Tools Engineering.
  • Deep hands-on programming and automation development expertise in C# and .NET.
  • Proven experience owning significant architectural improvements to established automation frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of software design, reusable components, asynchronous programming, debugging, and maintainable test-code architecture.
  • Hands-on experience validating Kubernetes-based, containerized, distributed applications, including microservices and asynchronous workflows.
  • Experience designing automated API, integration, system, and end-to-end testing with sound judgment about appropriate testing layers.
  • Experience improving CI/CD automation reliability, execution efficiency, test infrastructure, and engineering quality feedback.
  • Advanced root-cause analysis skills using logs, metrics, Kubernetes/container evidence, APIs, and system diagnostics.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership across teams, including influencing engineering decisions, establishing standards, and mentoring engineers.

Preferred

  • Python/PyTest experience, especially reusable utilities, tooling, fixtures, or shared libraries.
  • AWS or Azure, including EKS, AKS, or comparable Kubernetes environments.
  • Enterprise connectors, SMB/NFS, S3, Azure Blob, or cloud/on-premises data integrations.
  • Experience with performance, resilience, fault-injection, or failure-recovery testing.
  • Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or comparable UI automation tools.
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering workflows with disciplined validation.

Ideal

  • Experience leading automation modernization for a complex enterprise SaaS product.
  • Demonstrated cross-team adoption of automation frameworks or engineering standards.
  • Experience with enterprise storage, content management, data governance, or security platforms.
  • Experience validating AI-enabled classification, sensitive-data detection, or other non-deterministic functionality.

About Nasuni

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams—and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world's unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits.

As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform—turning massive file stores into secure, actionable, AI-ready data for intelligent automation, analytics, and global collaboration.

Why Work at Nasuni — Hyderabad

With Vista Equity Partners' backing, our Hyderabad team benefits from access to a global ecosystem of software leaders, cross-portfolio learning, leadership programs, and AI innovation communities—combining the pace of a growing product company with the scale and resources of a global technology investor.

In this role, you'll help evolve and scale the automation foundation for an increasingly important enterprise product. You'll work at the intersection of cloud, Kubernetes, distributed systems, AI, content intelligence, data governance, and enterprise infrastructure while collaborating with DryvIQ and Nasuni engineering teams globally.

Benefits at Nasuni Hyderabad

As part of our commitment to your well-being and growth, Nasuni offers competitive benefits designed to support every stage of your life and career:

  • Competitive compensation programs
  • Flexible time off and leave policies
  • Comprehensive health and wellness coverage
  • Hybrid and flexible work arrangements

  • Professional development and learning support

title: Senior GNC Engineer (Navigation)
description:
Why Castelion, Why Now

Castelion is moving incredibly fast to develop and deliver advanced defense systems at a time when execution matters more than ever. We believe focus, ownership, and excellence are decisive advantages - and we're building a world-class team to turn bold ideas into real capability.

This is a rare opportunity to join at an early stage, where you'll have significant ownership, collaborate with exceptional teammates, and make a direct, measurable impact on our mission and the future of the company - regardless of your function.

Senior Avionics Test Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Avionics Test Engineer to architect and execute the full suite of hardware test capabilities needed to move our avionics and control systems from prototype to production. In this role, you will own test requirements, automated test equipment (ATE) development, integration, validation, and performance characterization across domains including power electronics, digital interfaces, RF assemblies, motion control, and flight avionics.

You will design fixtures, build automated test stations, support DVT and qualification, and define the test performance envelope for components, circuit cards, and integrated sub-systems. This role blends hands-on lab work with systems-level reasoning and close collaboration with electrical, controls, software, and mechanical engineering teams.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute test plans at component, subassembly, and integrated system levels
  • Design and build test fixtures, HIL environments, and automated test rigs
  • Validate hardware performance across electrical, digital, mechanical, and RF metrics
  • Instrument and log tests to ensure precision and traceability
  • Lead failure analysis and root-cause investigations
  • Support hardware teams by feeding test results back into design cycles
  • Drive qualification and environmental test campaigns (thermal, vibe, EMI)
  • Deploy and validate automated test equipment for boards and sub-systems

Basic Qualifications

  • B.S./M.S. in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Aerospace, or related
  • Experience testing high-power subsystems, high-speed digital interfaces, actuators, or RF hardware
  • Hands-on experience developing automated test equipment using instruments such as oscilloscopes, DMMs, power supplies, loads, switch matrices, network analyzers, etc.
  • Familiarity with embedded control systems and interfaces (CAN, RS-422/485, SPI, Ethernet)
  • Experience with instrumentation control and data acquisition (Python, C++, protobufs, scripting)
  • Ability to work independently and lead cross-functional test integration

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience in RF testing fundamentals or more advanced knowledge of Radar architecture
  • Experience with software development for test automation for digital, power, and RF electronics (Python preferred)
  • Experience controlling test instrumentation using SCPI, VISA, or PyVISA commands
  • Experience developing GUIs or dashboards
  • Experience in writing custom scripts for data analysis & database creation
  • Experience writing software for Environmental Chambers and/or RF Chambers
  • Exposure to flight-like test environments, including environmental stress screening (ESS)
  • Experience with fault injection, failure mode testing, and reliability qualification for mission-critical systems
  • Working knowledge of C/C++ or Python for custom test tooling or embedded systems debugging
  • Background supporting flight test or launch operations.

title: Legal Officer | APEP
description:
Legal Officer | APEP

  • Commencement: November 2026

  • Long term role, based in Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea

  • Open to PNG Nationals

About the Program

The Australia PNG Economic Partnership (APEP) is a multi-sectoral investment to assist GoPNG to create a stable and more prosperous country. The investment is one of the coordination points from which Australia delivers its economic development aid to PNG under the PNGAus Partnership. The Australian Government is committed to delivering the Partnership in accordance with the principles of integration and alignment with PNG’s economic sector policies, systems and processes.

The Partnership’s overarching policy objective is to assist PNG in its efforts to achieve sustained growth, capable of lifting the standard of living of all citizens, while also ensuring Australia maintains its reputation as PNG’s economic partner of choice.

The Partnership incorporates gender equality, disability, social inclusion (GEDSI), women’s economic empowerment (WEE), climate change and economic dialogue and open government as cross-cutting objectives for all engagement areas

It has the following four End of Program Outcomes (EOPOs):

  • EOPO 1 - Safeguard Macroeconomic Stability

  • EOPO 2 - Support More Efficient and Inclusive Markets

  • EOPO 3 - Foster Inclusive Agricultural Growth and Expanded Livelihoods

  • EOPO 4 - Catalyse Economic Research and Dialogue

Each of the four EOPOs is supported by a Team Lead and other program staff that design and manage implementation of activities in accordance with the APEP Program Logic

About the Opportunity

The Legal Officer will support contracting and compliance activities and in-house legal advisory service in consult with the Manager, Legal and Contracts.

The Legal Officer is regularly required to provide legal advice including but not limited to commercial law, company law, contract law, and employment law issues. The Legal Officer works very closely with program Procurement and Finance teams and the Legal and Contracts Community of Practice (CoP) Lead to support compliance with corporate and program specific Operations Manual relevant policies and procedures and has financial management system contract approval delegations.

  • Advise on legislative compliance and assist in the management and advancement of the compliance framework for Abt Associates Papua New Guinean program operations as required by the program Executive Team from time to time;

  • Support program procurement with complex tender processes as required, while ensuring compliance with applicable procurement standards and requirements (including the Australian Commonwealth Procurement Rules) and the program Operations Manual;

  • Support program contracting due diligence in accordance with program head contract requirements and DFAT guidance including relevant list checks, company registrations and coordinating Safeguarding assessments;

  • Support in-country program contracting across a range of areas including construction, minor works, human resources, subcontracting and grants. Contracting services include advisory, drafting and negotiations;

  • Support program grant contracting matters and compliance with the Commonwealth Grant Rules and Guidelines and the program Operations Manual;

  • Support the maintenance of the in-country program Contracts and Grants Registers, Brisbane contract register and other program compliance registers and assist with associated reporting;

  • Act as a Fraud Control Officer and support on fraud reporting, mitigation and training in the program as and when the need arises;

  • Support program compliance training activities, including staff training, risk analysis and mitigation and reporting across all team responsibilities in the program;

  • Promote value for money principles across all aspects of program operations;

  • Support the advancement of process and systems improvements for contracting and compliance activities and assist with development of contracting and procurement templates and tools where required;

  • Work closely with the Brisbane based teams on in-country contracting procedures and reporting;

  • Support other Abt Associates managed programs in PNG when required;

  • Build effective relationships with the Abt Associate’s clients, staff, contractors, and stakeholders and provide education, training and capacity building;

  • Provide Commissioner of Oaths services; and other duties as required,

Key deliverables

  • Support the Legal and Contracts Manager and PNG Programs with an efficient and high standard of contracting and legal support;

  • Support the Legal and Contracts Manager and contribute to and help maintain a corporate risk management framework to ensure all corporate risk, program risk, and fraud issues are proactively identified, reported and managed following corporate and DFAT policies and procedures;

  • Ensure the accurate and up to date maintenance of program specific contract, grants, fraud registers and other registers as directed.

  • Reporting against the Abt PNG Operations Manual and PNG Program Head Contract as required by key program and corporate stakeholders; and

  • Effective management of relationships with the PNG Contracts and Legal team, APEP Executives and program staff.

Key working relationships

  • Legal and Contracts Manager

  • Legal and risk staff across Abt PNG programs

  • Key Abt PNG Shared t Services staff including Procurement, HR and GEDSI.

  • Program Executives and Senior Management team

  • Abt Associates Brisbane Head Office Corporate teams.

About You

For applications to be considered, a response to the key selection criteria below must be provided.

  • Bachelor of Law Degree and admission to practice law in Papua New Guinea

  • Has a minimum of 1 – 3 years relevant experience

  • Current Restricted Practicing Certificate or the ability to obtain one

How to Apply

  • Please ensure to address the Key Selection Criteria (About You) in your cover letter, and submit your application online, along with your CV as a single document.

  • Applications must be submitted personally by individuals only. Applications submitted by a company or organisation will not be accepted.

  • The successful applicant will be engaged through an employment agreement determined by Abt.

We welcome and thank all applications; however, only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Closing Date: 28 October 2026 (Midday local time) #LI-AUSBRIT

Abt Global is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to upholding high standards of Child Protection, Anti-bribery and Fraud Protection.

We encourage applications from experienced and capable women, and people with disabilities.

Abt Global is a mission-driven, global leader with a proven track record in complex program implementation in the international development sector. We offer bold solutions and technical excellence in Health, Economic Growth, Governance, Research & Evaluation, Environment & Energy, Gender Equality & Social Inclusion. Working with our many partners, we have driven measurable social impact for more than 55 years, to achieve our mission of improving the quality of life and economic well-being of people worldwide. title: Data Analytics Intern
description:
Arm’s Silicon Quality Analytics & Insights team helps teams make better decisions by turning complex data into clear, reliable insights. We work with colleagues across Arm to improve data quality, automate analytics and communicate findings that support quality and continuous improvement.

As an intern, you’ll contribute to this work while building practical experience in data analysis, AI-enabled automation and machine learning. With support from experienced colleagues, you’ll learn how to turn a business question into an analytical solution, evaluate the results and communicate insights to stakeholders and business partners.

What you could be doing as a Data Analytics Intern?

Data Discovery. You could help explore datasets to identify trends, investigate unexpected results and answer questions from our engineering and business teams. Working alongside colleagues, you’ll learn to use Codex, SQL and Python to prepare and analyse data, understand how different sources fit together and check for missing or inconsistent information.

AI and Automation. You’ll explore how AI can automate repetitive analytical tasks, from preparing and validating data to developing reusable workflows. With guidance from the team, you’ll use AI-assisted development tools to build and improve solutions, while learning to test their outputs and check that they are accurate and reliable.

Machine Learning. You could also apply machine learning algorithms to real data challenges—for example, detecting unusual patterns, grouping similar records or predicting trends. You’ll develop experience in selecting suitable approaches, evaluating model performance and understanding the limitations of your results. Projects will reflect your experience and learning goals, with support as you build your skills.

Communication. Sharing what you discover will be an important part of your work. You’ll help create Tableau dashboards and visualisations, discuss findings with stakeholders and business partners, and explain how your analysis could inform decisions. As your confidence grows, you’ll take responsibility for a manageable piece of work, from understanding the question to presenting the outcome.

We are looking for individuals who:

Are currently studying towards a Bachelor’s, Master’s or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a related subject. We also welcome students from other degree backgrounds who can demonstrate relevant skills through coursework or projects.

You’ll bring an interest in using data, AI and machine learning to solve practical problems, an analytical approach and a willingness to learn. Some experience working with data through your studies, personal projects or previous work will help you get started. You should be comfortable asking questions, checking details and collaborating with others.

Qualities that will help your application stand out:

  • Familiarity with Python or SQL for preparing, exploring and analysing data.
  • An understanding of basic statistics or machine learning concepts, with opportunities to demonstrate these through coursework or projects.
  • Curiosity about using AI-assisted tools to develop solutions and automate repetitive tasks, with an interest in checking and improving their outputs.
  • Experience creating visualisations using Tableau, Power BI, Python or similar tools, and explaining findings to others.
  • Examples of learning unfamiliar tools, investigating data quality issues or improving a process through a university or personal project.

You do not need experience with every tool listed. We’re interested in your potential and how you approach learning and problem-solving. Previous semiconductor industry experience is not required.

Additional Information:

This is a 12 month internship starting June 2027.

We encourage early applications as we review them on a first come/first served basis.

Arm Internships require you to be enrolled in a higher education degree and be returning to your course after your internship/placement.

Please note we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the country where the internship is based, without relying on sponsorship by Arm, for the full duration of the internship.

Working on interesting new projects with leaders in the field is exciting, but we also know how important it is to receive support. title: Senior Rust Engineer
description:
This is a remote position.

The company provides a security framework embedded at the blockchain base layer that is designed for dApp developers, and enforces verifiable, on-chain security assertions to prevent hacks and vulnerabilities. Their system provides proof of provenance mechanisms for preemptive exploit validation, and an Assertion Registry for managing and monetizing security rules.

Their infrastructure provides a transparent, decentralized approach to blockchain security, allowing developers to define and enforce security protocols with resilience and ease.

They’re looking for a SeniorRust SEngineer to join their team andwork on bleeding-edge infrastructure that safeguards the crypto industry.

By joining the team, You will play a crucial role in shipping cutting-edge features that extend the EVM to enable security rules to be checked after every state transition, right at the heart of the company's infrastructure, as well as contribute to core open-source crypto infrastructure and the ability to solve novel and complex problems.

MISSIONS

  • Design, drive and own complex features throughout the whole lifecycle with strong focus on performance and benchmarking. Particularly in extending the EVM with security-focussed precompiles or improving its performance with parallel processing optimizations.
  • Collaborate & communicate effectively across teams.
  • Emphasis on fast iteration cycles driven by performance benchmarking and robust testing practices.
  • Ability to context-switch between delivering features, supporting bug fixing, and reviewing work
  • Share innovative ideas to contribute to the team roadmap and consistently raise the bar for others with impactful contributions.

Profil

The ideal candidate has a T-shaped skillset, a wide range of technical breadth, and deep knowledge in a specific area across the stack (EVM, performance, database, optimization, debugging).

You are able to support the team with shipping robust and performant code,fast.

  • Proven track record of shipping & maintaining complex and performant Rust code to production.
  • A deep understanding of the Rust language and ecosystem. Rust being your primary language
  • Deep understanding of the Ethereum ecosystem, particularly EVM and the Execution layer, and real life experience with Ethereum infrastructure
  • Engineers with a strong sense of ownership, a passion to improve existing systems, and the ability to work autonomously and solve problems independently.

This position will support the development, optimization, scale-up, and commercialization of dietary supplements in capsules, tablets, powders, and gummies.


The ideal candidate has experience developing products for commercial manufacturing and enjoys solving practical formulation and processing challenges. Experience with multiple delivery formats is valuable, with a particular preference for candidates who have strong experience in either:

  • Tablet formulation, compression, and tablet coating; or
  • Gummy formulation and processing.

Candidates are not expected to be experts in every delivery format.

  • Develop new dietary supplement formulations in capsules, tablets, powders, and gummies from initial concept through commercial production.
  • Select appropriate active ingredients, excipients, flavors, colors, sweeteners, coating systems, and processing aids based on product requirements.
  • Evaluate raw-material characteristics such as particle size, density, flow, compressibility, hygroscopicity, solubility, compatibility, and organoleptic properties.
  • Design and conduct laboratory and pilot-scale trials to evaluate formulation performance and manufacturing feasibility.
  • Develop formulations that meet target potency, serving-size, dosage-form, sensory, stability, cost, and label-claim requirements.
  • Troubleshoot formulation and processing issues, including poor powder flow, segregation, sticking, picking, capping, lamination, friability, hardness, disintegration, coating defects, gummy texture, setting, depositing, flavor, and stability.
  • Optimize formulations and manufacturing processes to improve product quality, consistency, throughput, yield, and scalability.
  • Operate or support the operation of development and pilot equipment, including tablet presses, tablet coaters, blenders, mills, encapsulation equipment, powder-processing equipment, and gummy-processing equipment, as applicable.
  • Prepare formulas, processing instructions, trial protocols, technical reports, specifications, and manufacturing documentation.
  • Establish critical process parameters and clearly communicate processing requirements to Manufacturing.
  • Lead or support the transfer of formulations from laboratory development to pilot and commercial-scale production.
  • Provide hands-on support during first production runs, validation batches, troubleshooting trials, and product rework activities.
  • Investigate formulation deviations, manufacturing failures, and out-of-specification performance using structured root-cause analysis.
  • Recommend and evaluate alternate raw materials, suppliers, and excipient systems when needed.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Purchasing, Inventory Control, Planning, and other departments throughout the product-development process.
  • Maintain complete and accurate records in accordance with company procedures and cGMP requirements.
  • Support continuous-improvement projects related to formulation practices, manufacturing processes, laboratory capabilities, and departmental procedures.
  • Manage multiple development projects and priorities while meeting established timelines.

title: Manufacturing Supply Chain Coordinator
description:
Dawn Aerospace is building scalable space transportation. We're developing advanced spaceflight systems and creating a future where access to space is more frequent, sustainable, and affordable.

We're looking for a Supply Chain Coordinator to support the flow of materials, components and hardware through our manufacturing operation. This is not a traditional purchasing or logistics role. You'll work at the centre of an aerospace production environment where traceability, quality, supplier performance and execution matter.

About the Role

Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality and Finance, you'll ensure the right materials are available at the right time while maintaining the standards and records required to build flight hardware.

You'll be responsible for:

  • Managing purchase orders and supplier deliveries.
  • Maintaining accurate inventory, material and procurement records.
  • Supporting material traceability, serialisation and configuration control.
  • Monitoring supplier performance and escalating delivery or supply risks.
  • Ensuring part numbers, revisions and manufacturing records remain accurate.
  • Supporting the movement of hardware through production.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve purchasing, inventory and supply chain processes.

What We're Looking For

We're particularly interested in people who have worked in high-reliability manufacturing environments where quality, traceability and documentation are critical.

Ideal backgrounds include:

  • Aerospace
  • Defence
  • Aviation or MRO
  • Electronics manufacturing
  • Medical devices
  • Motorsport
  • Automotive OEMs or Tier 1 suppliers
  • Precision engineering
  • Semiconductor or advanced manufacturing

You will likely have:

  • 3+ years' experience in supply chain, procurement, materials planning, inventory control or manufacturing operations.
  • Experience working with ERP/MRP systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Experience managing controlled documentation, revisions or serialised products.
  • An understanding of traceability, supplier quality and regulated manufacturing environments.
  • The confidence to identify risks, escalate issues and drive actions through to completion.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-performance team.

Experience supporting aerospace, defence, export-controlled or other highly regulated industries would be highly regarded.

Why Dawn Aerospace?

  • Work on hardware destined for flight.
  • Join one of New Zealand's fastest-growing aerospace companies.
  • Learn from world-class engineers, technicians and operational leaders.
  • Take ownership and see the direct impact of your work.
  • Help build the systems and supply chain that enable scalable space transportation.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Dawn Aerospace, we believe that diverse teams build better solutions. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences are valued and supported to do their best work.

About Dawn Aerospace

Dawn Aerospace is a space transportation company with a purpose.
Our mission is to enable the next generation of space users by providing more sustainable and scalable ways to access and move around in space. We believe this access, in the form of a transportation network, will fundamentally change what’s possible from space. We currently focus on three areas of space transportation:

  • In-space propulsion
    We're a leading supplier of turnkey green propulsion systems for various classes of satellites. Our systems utilise safe, accessible propellants and we have over 170 of these propulsion units on more than 40 operational satellites already. A further 200 units are in production.
  • In-space servicing
    Coupled with our propulsion expertise, we are ensuring that our customers' satellites are refuellable. In the coming years, Dawn will offer a refueling service to enable life extension of customer satellites. This new market is aligned with our sustainability goal to ensue a clean and safe space for everyone!
  • Spaceplane
    We are developing the fastest and highest-flying aircraft ever to take off from a runway, combining the extreme performance of rocket propulsion with the reusability of conventional airplanes to enable high-frequency, low-cost access to sub-orbital space.

Our international teams are distributed across four locations: the Netherlands, France, New Zealand, and the USA.

Apply for this Job

Important!

If you think you have what it takes but are unsure that you check every box, we still want to hear from you.

title: Quality Assurance & AI Optimization Analyst - Sioux Falls, SD
description:
Employment Type: Full-Time, Exempt


Location: Sioux Falls, SD or Sandy, UT, (On-Site)


Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM


Improve Quality. Identify Insights. Help Advance AI-Assisted Auditing.


1. Do you notice patterns, inconsistencies, and opportunities that others may overlook?

2. Do you enjoy analyzing information, improving processes, and helping teams perform at their best?

3. Are you interested in the potential of artificial intelligence, while recognizing when human judgment remains essential?


If you answered yes to any of these questions, ECG may have the opportunity you have been looking for.


About Expansion Capital Group (ECG)

ECG provides financing solutions that help small businesses access the capital they need to grow. Our team specializes in efficient, non-traditional lending while balancing speed with strong credit discipline and a commitment to doing things the right way.


ECG is seeking a Quality Assurance & AI Optimization Analyst to support quality assurance across our Merchant Support, Renewals, Direct Sales, and Underwriting teams.


In this newly created role, you will conduct quality audits, help improve quality standards and scorecards, validate AI-generated evaluations, and support ECG’s responsible expansion of AI-assisted quality auditing. You will partner with department leaders and business and technology resources to strengthen audit consistency, reduce manual review work, and improve operational processes without sacrificing accuracy or appropriate human oversight.


This is an opportunity to do more than conduct audits. You will help improve how ECG uses quality data, technology, and human judgment to strengthen consistency, identify risks, and support better business decisions.


What You’ll Do

  • Conduct quality audits across Merchant Support, Renewals, Direct Sales, and Underwriting.
  • Evaluate interactions for compliance with policies, procedures, customer experience standards, documentation requirements, and department expectations.
  • Help develop and refine AI-assisted quality auditing capabilities within Talkdesk.
  • Translate quality standards, scorecards, policies, procedures, and business requirements into objective and measurable evaluation criteria.
  • Compare AI-generated quality results with human reviews to evaluate accuracy and consistency.
  • Identify inaccurate, inconsistent, or incomplete AI evaluations and recommend improvements to auditing criteria.
  • Establish guidelines for determining when interactions require additional human review.
  • Partner with department leaders to develop, maintain, and improve quality assurance scorecards.
  • Help establish calibration processes among human reviewers, department leaders, and AI-generated evaluations.
  • Determine which quality criteria may be appropriate for automated evaluation and which should remain subject to human review.
  • Identify recurring quality issues, process gaps, training opportunities, and operational risks.
  • Track quality results and identify trends by department, process, interaction type, and quality category.
  • Provide department leaders with clear reporting on significant trends and recurring areas of concern.
  • Investigate the root causes of recurring quality concerns and partner with operational leaders on corrective actions and process improvements.
  • Evaluate Talkdesk and other technologies that may improve or automate quality assurance processes.
  • Participate in the testing and implementation of new quality assurance tools, integrations, and workflow improvements.
  • Document quality assurance rules, evaluation criteria, testing results, business requirements, and process changes.

What You’ll Learn

  • How quality assurance practices operate across multiple ECG business departments.
  • How AI-assisted auditing can support accurate, consistent, and scalable quality reviews.
  • How measurable evaluation criteria are developed and tested using established standards and business requirements.
  • Quality assurance calibration methods involving human reviewers, department leaders, and AI-generated evaluations.
  • How quality data and performance trends can identify operational risks, training needs, and process improvement opportunities.
  • Contact center and quality assurance technology, including Talkdesk.
  • How to evaluate opportunities for automation while maintaining responsible human oversight.
  • How to collaborate across operational departments and with business and technology resources.

Why Join Us

  • Emerging Technology: Help ECG evaluate and responsibly expand the use of AI-assisted quality auditing.
  • Meaningful Impact: Improve the accuracy, consistency, and efficiency of quality reviews across multiple operations departments.
  • Established Quality Foundation: Build upon and support ECG’s existing quality assurance practices while expanding quality oversight within operations.
  • Cross-Functional Exposure: Partner with leaders and team members across Merchant Support, Renewals, Direct Sales, Underwriting, and other business areas.
  • Continuous Improvement: Turn quality findings and performance trends into recommendations that improve training, processes, and operations.
  • Responsible Innovation: Help determine where technology can improve quality reviews and where human judgment should remain essential.
  • Growing Organization: Expand your experience within a financial services company committed to responsible innovation and continuous improvement.

What We’re Looking For


Strong candidates typically have experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Quality assurance or quality auditing.
  • Operations, compliance, customer service, sales operations, or underwriting.
  • Reviewing interactions for compliance with established standards and expectations.
  • Developing or applying quality assurance scorecards.
  • Quality calibration and evaluation consistency.
  • Identifying trends, discrepancies, process gaps, and areas of operational risk.
  • Analyzing quality results or performance data.
  • Contact center, call-monitoring, or quality assurance technology.
  • Process improvement and workflow evaluation.
  • Translating policies, procedures, and business requirements into measurable criteria.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Are

  • Analytical and naturally curious.
  • Highly detail-oriented and committed to accuracy.
  • Comfortable identifying and challenging inconsistent results.
  • Interested in AI-enabled software and emerging technology.
  • Able to balance innovation with appropriate human oversight.
  • Organized and consistent in how you evaluate information.
  • Comfortable working with employees and leaders across multiple departments.
  • An effective written and verbal communicator.
  • Resourceful and adaptable when processes or technology change.
  • Accountable and committed to following through.
  • Able to recognize when a concern should be validated or escalated.

Work Environment

  • This is an in-office position located in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, or Sandy, Utah.
  • The regular schedule is Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
  • The position operates in a professional office environment using standard office equipment, business systems, and quality assurance technology.
  • The position is primarily sedentary but may occasionally require standing, walking, reaching, or lifting light office materials.
  • Occasional evening or weekend work may be required based on business needs.

Equal Opportunity Employer


Expansion Capital Group is an equal opportunity employer and considers all applicants without regard to protected characteristics.

title: Treatment Court Coordinator, St. Louis County, Duluth
description:
Are you interested in learning how you can serve your community and learn about the justice system?
Do you have a desire to help others in their recovery journey?

Join the Sixth Judicial District as a Treatment Court Coordinator! The Sixth Judicial District seeks to fill a part-time (anticipated 32 hours per week) exempt Treatment Court Coordinator position located in St. Louis County, Duluth, serving the DWI Court. This is responsible, professional work coordinating and supervising the activities of a Treatment Court.

Work involves the performance of extensive planning, organizing, coordinating and monitoring the activities of the Treatment Court. This position works collaboratively with judges and may take part in statewide work groups and/or team meetings to promote best practices, efficiency, and effective operations on a system wide basis.

What You Will Do
The following are examples of major job duties expected of this position:

  • Plans, implements, administers, and monitors the day-to-day activities of a Treatment Court.
  • Serves on Treatment Court teams.
  • Secures funding to support ongoing Treatment Court operations.
  • Directs and maintains an accounting and auditing system with respect to program funds.
  • Writes grant proposals; plans and prepares budgetary estimates and justifications.
  • Coordinates and approves expenditures and oversees fiscal contractual obligations.
  • Organizes and coordinates training for team members and treatment court partners such as substance abuse or mental health treatment providers.
  • Maintains cooperative relationships with treatment agencies, community organizations, the Probation Department, and the Department of Human Services.
  • Attends and participates in conferences, meetings, and committees as the Treatment Court representative.
  • Attends case staffings and court hearings.
  • Consults with treatment court judges on a wide range of organizational and managerial issues including, but not limited to, internal and external quality assurance, efficiency, and policy.
  • Monitors and supervises Treatment Court services, including participant referrals and screening and determining the need for additional court services and assessing appropriate services for individual participants; uses discretion in interpreting treatment court policies and procedures and completes participant case reviews, including compiling and evaluating information from other team members to inform Treatment Court team decisions.
  • Facilitates community presentations, assists in docket development, promotes team integrity, develops community resources, monitors quality assurance, develops agendas, and collects data.
  • Serves as liaison by representing the Treatment Court team, serving as the point of contact for information about the Treatment Court, and coordinating services for participants and the court between team members, steering committee, with the general public, and court administration.
  • Provides guidance, assistance to participants, and updates on policy changes.
  • Administers evaluations, reviews participant files, and may conduct initial screenings in order to identify the nature and severity of substance abuse, mental health, or other problems central to the Treatment Court.
  • Prepares reports to court, state, and county agencies. Oversees collection of performance and outcome data.
  • Collaborates with judges, lawyers, police, and sheriff to coordinate programs for participants.
  • Provides education and community awareness for the Treatment Courts.
  • Supports other Sixth District Treatment Court Coordinators in backup court coverage and sharing of ideas.

What You Must Have
The Minnesota Judicial Branch recognizes the diverse set of skills, strengths, and attributes that an individual may bring into a role. If you have any combination of the experience, training, and education required for this position, apply today!

  • Possession of a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university with major course work preferably in criminal justice, sociology, psychology, social work, or related field.
  • Experience in court systems and/or relevant Treatment Court area required, i.e. working with people affected by chemical dependency and/or mental illness, etc.

What You Will Bring

  • Considerable knowledge of the habits and actions of people with alcohol and other drug problems, or other problems for which the treatment court is intended to address.
  • Ability to establish rapport with justice-involved individuals experiencing alcohol and other drug problems and/or mental health issues.
  • Knowledge of programs and resources available for chemical dependency or people affected by mental illness and drug court ancillary services.
  • Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively on a team.
  • Ability to manage, organize, and prioritize tasks and team relationships/dynamics.
  • Ability to operate within policy and budget expectations.

What You Will Earn
The anticipated starting hourly rate for this position is no less than $31.84 for external hires, with a full future earning potential of $31.84-$49.30 per hour. This position is exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act and is eligible for State of MN employee benefits.

Working Conditions
Work is performed primarily in an office setting or a courtroom under the general supervision of district administration and may take work direction from judges following Minnesota statutes, court rules and policies, and generally accepted professional guidelines and procedures. Work involves contact with persons who may be angry, abusive, or threatening.

Supplemental Information
The Sixth Judicial District serves Minnesota's Arrowhead Region, including the counties of Carlton, Cook, Lake, and St. Louis (Duluth, Hibbing, and Virginia).

Logistics

This is a part-time (anticipated 32 hours per week) exempt position classified as Treatment Courts Coordinator within the Minnesota Judicial Branch job classification system. Work will be performed at the St. Louis County Courthouse, located at 100 North 5th Avenue West, Duluth, MN. This position may be working in a hybrid role consisting of a combination of remote and in-person work. When working remotely, access to reliable internet connection is required.

This position is posted for internal and external application simultaneously. In addition to completing the online application, all applicants must upload and attach a cover letter. Final candidates may be requested to prepare a brief writing sample.

  • Deadline to apply: October 22, 2026, at 11:59 p.m.
  • Applications will be reviewed daily.

title: MATERIAL CONTROLLER
description:
ALONG WITH YOUR RESUME YOU MUST UPLOAD A COPY OF YOUR CURRENT CDL OR CDL PERMIT. IF YOU DO NOT PROVIDE YOUR LICENSE, YOUR WILL BE DEEMED AS UN-QUALIFIED.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or GED with at least two years warehouse experience is required. Applicant must have the ability to read and write parts names and other Storeroom-related information. Should be able to demonstrate proficiency in keyboard data entry to meet the Enterprise Asset Management (EAM/FASuite) and Oracle input requirements. Must be able to demonstrate ability to enter data accurately at an acceptable rate. Must be able to perform basic arithmetic functions, such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Floating relief requirements apply.

INTERVIEW SELECTION PROCESS:

The selection process may include one or more components to demonstrate applicants’ knowledge, skills and abilities in job-related areas. These may include exercises such as practical demonstrations, written communications, oral interview and/or competency assessments.

SUMMARY

Receives, records, stores, and issues materials and equipment in MARTA's Materials Storerooms in support of MARTA Bus, Rail, Facilities Maintenance and other MARTA operations. Assists maintenance personnel in the identification, nomenclature, selection and ordering of parts and materials. Compiles and maintains records of quantity, cost and type of material. Uses motor vehicles and storeroom material handling equipment such as forklifts, pallet jacks, pneumatic material elevator, pallet puller, etc. Prepares and submits/inputs correct documentation for each transaction either manually or via computerized terminal. May deliver parts and/or materials using cargo trucks, light trucks or similar vehicles. Maintains inventory record location files, and other documentation to ensure proper accountability and accessibility. Performs basic warehouse safety and housekeeping procedures.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

(These duties are not to be construed as exclusive or all-inclusive, and do not include marginal functions of the position that are incidental to the performance of the essential job functions.)

  1. Assists other stores personnel; receives specific directions and instructions.

  2. Receives new and rebuilt materials from vendors and performs administrative receipt inspection to include ensuring correct count and type; places in designated bins or other storage facilities.

  3. Selects, prepares, and processes and ships parts and other materials for transfer to other stores locations.

  4. Assists maintenance personnel with identification of new/replacement parts; issues necessary items, and records usage as appropriate.

  5. Prepares and submits accurate documentation on actions taken in accordance with established procedures to ensure proper accountability.

  6. Performs safety and housekeeping functions as required to maintain safe and neat working areas.

  7. Maintains computerized inventory/location records, reviews records for accuracy, takes corrective action as necessary; brings situations which are beyond individual's scope of authority to correct, to the attention of supervisor; periodically reviews location accuracy and related storeroom functions.

  8. Observes and conducts strict property control to ensure materials are used only for official Authority purposes; reports potential violations to Supervisor or higher-level management; ensures that only authorized personnel gain access to storage areas.

  9. Observes storage areas for overflows, mixed stock, incorrect/incomplete bin placement, incorrect signage/markings; makes on-the-spot corrections.

  10. May gather and process materials for reclamation.

  11. Participates in complete and cyclic inventories to maintain high degree of accountability.

  12. May deliver parts and other materials using cargo trucks, light trucks or other similar vehicles.

  13. Performs related duties as assigned.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Must possess a current, valid State of Georgia issued CDL license [Class B] or a current, valid State of Georgia issued Commercial Driver Learner’s (CDL) Permit (Class B) is required. Individuals hired with a valid State of Georgia issued Commercial Driver Learner’s Permit must obtain a valid State of Georgia issued Commercial Driver’s License (Class B) within three (3) weeks of their date of hire.

A minimum of two years’ driving experience. A maximum of one (1) moving violation, with a maximum of three (3) points on Motor Vehicle Report (MVR) within a rolling 24-month period. DUI violations are not allowed.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand. The employee frequently is required to walk; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, or crouch. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 60 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus and distinguish colors. Employee must pass a hearing test.

SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS

  1. Must successfully pass a forklift operator's proficiency test within 90 calendar days of hire.

  2. Must obtain a passing score on the Skills Check Test that includes Industrial Math and basic reading comprehension skills.

  3. Independently responsible to control and provide security for a high dollar inventory that includes sensitive items; therefore, individuals must undergo a criminal background check and have an acceptable credit report.

  4. Must possess valid State of Georgia issued CDL license or valid State of Georgia issued Commercial Driver Learner’s (CDL) Permit at time of application for position.

  5. Subject to random drug and alcohol testing.

  6. Must pass physical examination required by MARTA. MARTA is a Drug-Free Workplace. Participation in MARTA's Drug & Alcohol Program is a condition of employment. Failure to adhere to MARTA's Drug & Alcohol Program will result in termination. Every MARTA employee is responsible for reading and observing the requirements of the Drug & Alcohol policy. This position has been identified as SAFETY SENSITIVE.

The following applies to internal applicants ONLY:

All internal applicants will have a record evaluation check to determine whether they are eligible to advance to the interview process. Candidates will be automatically disqualified for consideration if their employment record for the twelve (12) months preceding the date of the posting reflects any of the following:

· A combined total of three (3) occurrences and/or lose outs (tardies)

· Any instances of absence without leave (AWOL)

· Any disciplinary actions

· Any valid customer complaints

· Employee has not successfully completed probationary period as a new hire

Record evaluation will be conducted based on the twelve months preceding the initial date of the posting. Candidates must remain in good standing once selected through the job screening and offer process. Failure to remain in good standing based on the criteria listed above will disqualify any candidate.

AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES ACT
If you are a qualified individual with a disability, you have a right to request that MARTA make reasonable accommodations in order to help you accomplish your work, which must still be performed in all its essential functions.

MARTA is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

title: CRA II (Sponsor Dedicated)
description:
CRA II (Sponsor Dedicated)

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required. For Real World Late Phase, the CRA II will use the business card title of Site Management Associate II. Additional responsibilities include:Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out. Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs.Chart abstraction activities and data collection
    Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff. The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff. Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager. Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations.

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis

Pursuant to our Employee Privacy Notice, Syneos Health can provide the Sites with the information necessary for you to gain such access. Further, a Site may ask you for additional information beyond that which Syneos Health has in its possession. You are required to comply with any such Site requests as a condition of your employment with Syneos Health. Please note that failure to provide requested information may result in a Site barring you from entry, which could put your ongoing employment at risk.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

title: Aws devops / platform engineering lead
description:
AWS Dev Ops / Platform Engineering Lead – Johannesburg.

This is not a Dev Ops role where you sit on the sidelines reviewing architecture diagrams. You’ll be leading the AWS Dev Ops and platform engineering capability while staying firmly hands-on.

Around half your time will be spent in engineering delivery across AWS environments, migrations, modernisation projects and managed services.

The other half will focus on leading and developing the Dev Ops team, owning delivery standards, supporting customers and making sure the work gets done properly.

You’ll be responsible for the technical direction of the team, but you’ll still be expected to design solutions, review code, solve complex production issues and step into high-pressure incidents when needed.

The environment suits someone who enjoys both the technical and leadership sides of the job and does not want to choose between the two.
Core tech: AWS, Terraform, Cloud Formation, Kubernetes, EKS, Docker, Helm, Git Hub Actions, Git Lab, Linux, Python/Bash, Cloud Watch and Cloud Trail.

Salary: Up to R150k CTC per month.

Duties and Responsibilities Lead and develop the Dev Ops engineering team, including hiring, onboarding, performance management and day-to-day work allocation. Mentor engineers through technical reviews, code reviews, pairing and structured development plans. Build capability within the team and create clear AWS certification and career development pathways. Own the technical delivery of Dev Ops workstreams across customer projects. Produce realistic technical estimates and ensure delivery remains within agreed scope and effort. Lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable AWS architectures. Define Dev Ops, Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD standards across projects. Design AWS landing zones and multi-account environments using AWS Organizations and Control Tower. Lead Terraform architecture, reusable module design and automation standards. Design and manage container platforms using Kubernetes, Amazon EKS and ECS. Build and maintain containerised workloads using Docker and Helm. Design CI/CD and Git Ops pipelines using tools such as Git Hub Actions and Git Lab. Implement monitoring, logging, alerting and observability across production environments. Design backup and disaster recovery solutions, including RTO, RPO and DR testing. Support AWS migrations and application modernisation projects. Ensure AWS environments align with Well-Architected principles. Implement and maintain AWS security controls across IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, Guard Duty, Security Hub and related services. Embed security into CI/CD pipelines through policy-as-code, infrastructure scanning and secrets scanning. Support environments operating under compliance requirements such as POPIA, GDPR, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, NIST and HIPAA. Act as the escalation point for complex AWS production issues. Lead P1 and P2 incident response, root cause analysis and post-incident reviews. Establish and manage on-call and support rotations to ensure SLA commitments are met. Advise customers on AWS optimisation, resilience, reliability and cost reduction. Participate in architecture workshops and technical discovery sessions with customers. Produce technical designs, estimates, proposals and input into Statements of Work. Communicate technical risks, decisions and delivery status clearly to customers and internal stakeholders. description:

By ensuring timely and accurate enrollment of healthcare providers with commercial and government payers, this position directly contributes to the financial health of the organization and uninterrupted access to care for patients. Effective payer enrollment minimizes delays in reimbursement, supports provider scheduling, and ensures compliance with payer-specific and regulatory requirements. title: Vil du lave kærlige måltider sammen med frivillige?
description:
Er du stærk i et køkken og glad for at arbejde med mennesker? Vil du bruge din faglighed til at gøre en forskel for familier og personer ramt af livstruende sygdom – og skabe en god hverdag for de frivillige, der laver måltiderne sammen med os?

Det Kærlige Måltid søger en køkkenansvarlig til vores køkken i Aarhus. Du får ansvar for den daglige køkkendrift og for, at vi sender velsmagende og nærende måltider af sted til vores modtagere. Du får også en vigtig rolle i at guide og engagere de frivillige, som er hjertet i vores arbejde.

Hos os er det gode måltid kerneopgaven. Men måden, vi skaber det på, betyder lige så meget. Vores frivillige kommer med forskellige erfaringer, aldre og baggrunde. Nogle kender køkkenet rigtig godt, mens andre er nye og skal lære undervejs. Som køkkenansvarlig skal du kunne sætte en tydelig faglig retning og samtidig skabe plads til, at alle kan bidrage og føle sig som en del af fællesskabet.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan både mad og mennesker

Du har en stærk køkkenfaglig baggrund og kan omsætte din viden til måltider, hvor smag, ernæring og kvalitet går hånd i hånd. Du arbejder struktureret og holder fast i kvaliteten, også når der er travlt, eller råvarer og planer ændrer sig. Du har blik for sæsonens råvarer og kan få mest muligt ud af det, vi har til rådighed.

Du holder af at lære fra dig og er god til at forklare og vise, hvordan en opgave skal løses. Du møder de frivillige med tålmodighed, respekt og nysgerrighed. Du kan stille krav og give konstruktiv feedback på en måde, der gør mennesker trygge og giver dem lyst til at komme igen.

Du trives med et tæt samarbejde med vores faglige koordinator og projektkoordinator og med kolleger og ledelse på tværs af organisationen. Du deler viden og tager udfordringer op i tide. Du har også lyst til at sparre med de køkkenansvarlige i Aalborg og Odense – både for at dele det, der fungerer hos jer i Aarhus, og for at lære af deres erfaringer.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at

  • planlægge og gennemføre produktionen af måltider i Aarhus, herunder menuplanlægning, indkøb og tilpasning af produktionen til behovet
  • sikre god smag og kvalitet samt fødevaresikkerhed, egenkontrol og køkkenhygiejne
  • bruge råvarer og økonomiske ressourcer med omtanke og arbejde for at mindske madspild
  • skabe struktur på køkkenvagterne, fordele opgaver og guide de frivillige, så de kan bidrage med det, de hver især kan, i samarbejde med vores faglige koordinatorer som er ansvarlige for de frivillige
  • tage varmt og professionelt imod gæster og samarbejdspartnere og fortælle om maden, de frivilliges indsats og hverdagen i køkkenet
  • bidrage til at udvikle vores måltider, arbejdsgange og samarbejde på tværs af organisationen.

Du behøver ikke tidligere at have arbejdet i en organisation med frivillige. Det afgørende er, at du har lysten og evnen til at skabe gode resultater sammen med mennesker, der ikke er fagfolk i et køkken.

Stillingen er fuldtid og tidsbegrænset til to år med mulighed for forlængelse.

Du får mulighed for 1 ugentlig hjemmearbejdsdag, når køkkenet er lukket (fredag).

Arbejdssted er TRÆ, Kalkværksvej 3, 8000 Aarhus C.

Vil du være med?

Send en kort ansøgning, hvor du fortæller om dig selv, din køkkenfaglighed og din motivation for at arbejde hos Det Kærlige Måltid og med frivillige. Vedhæft også dit CV.

Send din ansøgning til job@detkaerligemaaltid.dk senest søndag den 18. oktober 2026.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Det Kærlige Måltids direktør og stifter, Charlotte Thyberg, på +45 40 35 68 39 eller charlotte@detkaerligemaaltid.dk.

Om Det Kærlige Måltid

Siden 2019 har frivillige i Det Kærlige Måltid tilberedt og leveret gratis måltider til familier og personer ramt af akut livstruende sygdom eller fysisk traume. Vi begyndte i Aarhus og har siden åbnet køkkener i Aalborg og Odense, så vi kan hjælpe endnu flere.

Bag måltiderne står et stærkt fællesskab af frivillige, som gerne vil gøre en forskel for mennesker i en svær livssituation. I køkkenet handler det derfor både om maden, om fællesskabet og om glæden ved at bidrage med det, man kan.

De frivillige er med i køkkenet mandag til onsdag, hvor vi klargør, tilbereder, pakker og leverer måltider. Om torsdagen inviterer vi løbende skoleelever og virksomheder ind til Det Kærlige Skolekøkken og Teambuilding Med Mening. Hver uge leverer vi desuden suppe til brugerne af Værestedet i Aarhus.
